Why SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne is a global software and cloud solutions provider and distributor, powered by around 12,000 people across more than 70 countries. But what really makes us SoftwareOne is our people: curious minds, different perspectives, and talented teams working together to solve real challenges and create meaningful impact. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to grow, explore new possibilities, and build a career that’s uniquely yours, while helping shape what’s next in technology.


The role

  • Are you eager to champion automated quality engineering across high-throughput marketplace platforms?
  • Do you want to pioneer modern AI-driven testing practices that elevate platform reliability?
  • Are you looking for the autonomy to innovate within a collaborative, distributed European engineering team?

Practical Information

Location: Spain, Poland, United Kingdom, Ireland, or Serbia | Reports to: HEAD of QA (CTO & platforms) | Work Arrangement: Remote | Visa Requirements: EU citizenship or valid work permit required | Language Requirements: Professional proficiency in English | Learn more: softwareone.com

As our new QA Engineer, you will join the QA Department within the Marketplace Platform team, driving product reliability and customer satisfaction across our digital solutions. Partnering with development, product, and support teams, you will raise engineering standards, embed a quality-first culture, and ensure seamless delivery across the software lifecycle. In this fully remote role, you will lead the evolution of our quality practices through modern automation and AI-driven testing, with the autonomy to experiment, innovate, and transform how we validate platform performance, complex business logic, and emerging AI capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for distributed cloud platforms.

  • Define comprehensive testing strategies, managing functional and non-functional test execution, test data, and reporting.

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams in technical design discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Establish, track, and analyze meaningful quality metrics to optimize platform reliability, test coverage, and execution speed.

  • Explore and implement AI-powered testing tools to enhance test generation, maintenance, and defect analysis.

  • Validate complex web applications, REST APIs, and emerging AI features, addressing output reliability and potential edge cases.


What we need to see from you

Essential

  • Demonstrated background in software quality engineering, test automation, or SDET roles across distributed architectures.
  • Hands-on expertise with modern test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or WebdriverIO.
  • Consistent proficiency with REST API testing, Git-based version control, and collaborative code review workflows.
  • Practical coding proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, or C#, with familiarity with Azure or AWS and working knowledge of relational (MS SQL Server) and document (MongoDB) databases.

Desirable

  • Experience integrating automated quality checks into CI/CD deployment pipelines.
  • Hands-on exposure to AI coding assistants, LLM-based applications, or prompt evaluation testing methodologies.
  • Background working with B2B e-commerce, cloud marketplaces, or complex subscription platforms.

What we offer: 

Our company benefits vary based on your location, but always include:

  • Global company culture: We defined our 6 core values through our company culture (A culture of values, with benefits)
  • A mentor who supports your successful start and is at your side with advice and action
  • President’s Club: Recognition awarded by leadership and your peers
  • Lifelong education: A variety of training and development opportunities
  • Hire to Grow: We optimize our internal structures and feedback culture constantly to be your Employer of Choice, today and in future.

Job Function

CTO & Platforms
Accommodations

SoftwareOne welcomes applicants from all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you require reasonable adjustments at any point during the recruitment process, email us at .
Please include the role for which you are applying and your country location. Someone from our organization that is not part of the decision-making process will be in touch to discuss your specific needs and we will make every effort to accommodate you. Any information shared will be stored securely and treated in the strictest of confidence in line with GDPR.
At SoftwareOne, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Additionally, we encourage experienced individuals that have taken an intentional career break and are now prepared to return to work to explore our SOAR program.

Tooling Engineer - Remote Karachi | Islamabad
Job Description:

We're hiring a Tooling Engineer (Night Shift)

About the Company:

A leading engineering consulting company serving North American clients in the automotive industry. Our clients are automotive suppliers that manufacture sheet metal stamped and assembled components for major vehicle manufacturers such as Honda, Ford, Toyota, and others.

Job Overview

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Tooling Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for the design, development, and improvement of progressive stamping dies, welding and fabrication fixtures, assembly jigs, checking fixtures, and related production tooling for automotive and heavy manufacturing applications. This role requires strong 3D CAD capability, practical knowledge of tooling and manufacturing processes, GD&T, and problem-solving abilities, along with strong written and verbal communication skills in English to collaborate with cross-functional teams and support our North American-based clients.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Stamping Tooling - Automotive:

  • Develop progressive stamping strip layouts for automotive sheet-metal components, considering part geometry, forming requirements, material flow, and production feasibility.
  • Plan station sequencing, nesting, material utilization, carrier strips, scrap webs, pilot positioning, and progression through cutting and forming operations.
  • Perform basic engineering calculations including tonnage, cutting and forming forces, center of pressure, and die balance.
  • Design and detail punches, die blocks, strippers, pads, guides, pilots, retainers, and other progressive die components.
  • Support die tryout and troubleshooting activities, including spring-back correction, clearance adjustments, dimensional improvements, and production-related tooling issues.

2. Welding & Assembly Tooling - Automotive:

  • Design spot and MIG welding fixtures, assembly jigs, checking fixtures, and gauges for stamped automotive components and assemblies.
  • Develop robust locating schemes using component datums, RPS principles, net pads, locating pins, and pin-and-slot arrangements.Design mechanical and pneumatic locating and clamping systems while considering part loading and unloading, weld gun access, weld sequence, operator ergonomics, and maintainability.
  • Apply GD&T and dimensional requirements to ensure repeatable part location,
  • orientation, and assembly accuracy.
  • Support fixture tryout, buy-off, first-article inspection, dimensional validation, and required design modifications.

3. Fabrication & Machining Tooling - Heavy Machinery:

  • Design weld fixtures, assembly jigs, and machining fixtures for large fabricated structures such as frames, booms, buckets, tanks, and agricultural implements.
  • Develop rigid tooling solutions for large and heavy weldments while considering welding distortion, pre-camber, weld sequence, thermal effects, and dimensional stability.
  • Incorporate positioners, crane access, lifting and handling requirements, operator access, and safe loading and unloading into tooling designs.
  • Develop practical, modular, and adjustable tooling for high-mix, low-volume fabrication environments.

4. Tooling Design & Documentation:

  • Develop complete 3D CAD models and 2D manufacturing drawings for dies, fixtures, jigs, gauges, and related tooling components.
  • Apply GD&T, fits, tolerances, and basic tolerance stack-up principles to achievedimensional accuracy and repeatability.
  • Select appropriate standard tooling components, locating devices, clamps, cylinders, fasteners, and commercially available components where applicable.
  • Maintain accurate tooling documentation and incorporate revisions based try out, manufacturing, quality, and production feedback.

5. Tooling Optimization & Continuous Improvement:

  • Review existing tooling and identify opportunities to improve cycle time, ergonomics, accessibility, reliability, maintainability, quality, and manufacturing cost.
  • Troubleshoot tooling-related production and dimensional issues, identify root causes, and develop practical corrective actions.
  • Support tooling standardization, cost-reduction, and continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing operations.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Project Support:

  • Work closely with manufacturing, production, quality, maintenance, machining, welding, tool rooms, and other engineering teams throughout tooling design, tryout, and implementation.
  • Communicate tooling concepts, technical requirements, design changes, and project status clearly to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage multiple tooling projects and design revisions simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining a high standard of work.

Qualification & Required Competencies:

  • Education: DAE in Mechanical or Tool & Die Making from a recognized board; or B.Tech / BS / BE/ BSc in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Experience: 2-4 years of relevant experience in tooling design, fixture design, die design, fabrication, automotive manufacturing, or heavy machinery.

Technical Skills:

  • Proficiency in 3D CAD software such as SolidWorks, Creo, CATIA, and Fusion 360.
  • Strong understanding of engineering drawings, GD&T, fits, tolerances, and basic
  • tolerance stack-up.
  • Good knowledge of progressive stamping, sheet-metal forming, welding, machining, and fabrication processes.
  • Practical understanding of fixture locating and clamping principles, RPS/datums,
  • progressive die components, and tooling design fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with pneumatic clamping systems, standard tooling components, and tooling tryout or buy-off activities is preferred.
  • Problem-Solving and Analytical Skills: Ability to troubleshoot tooling, dimensional, and production issues and develop practical, manufacturable solutions.
  • Communication and Teamwork: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English to collaborate with cross-functional teams and communicate technical information clearly.
  • Project Management: Ability to manage multiple tooling projects and design revisions while meeting deadlines and maintaining a high standard of work.

Additional Information:

  • Working Hours: 4:00 PM to 1:00 AM PKT (Monday to Friday) to support our North American-based clients.
  • Salary: Market Competitive
  • Benefits: performance-based bonus at the end of the year
  • Location: Remote Karachi - Islamabad.

Role Title: STEM Expert – Chemistry & Computational Chemistry (PhD)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (Worldwide)

Job Summary: In this role, you’ll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Design, evaluate, and critique chemistry and computational chemistry problems, workflows, and reasoning chains to support AI benchmarking initiatives.
  2. Provide expert-level insights on reaction mechanisms, synthesis planning, spectroscopy analysis, molecular simulations, and electronic structure methods.
  3. Assess and optimize experimental protocols, simulation parameters, and software configurations for accuracy and reproducibility.
  4. Analyze chemical, spectroscopic, and simulation data and provide actionable recommendations.
  5. Leverage domain knowledge to guide the development and validation of chemistry-related AI models and tools.
  6. Communicate complex scientific concepts clearly, both in writing and verbally, to technical and non-technical collaborators.
  7. Document findings, methodologies, and best practices to ensure knowledge transfer across the customer’s team.

Areas of Expertise (we welcome applicants from any of the following):

  1. Organic synthesis & reaction mechanisms
  2. Inorganic & organometallic chemistry
  3. Physical & theoretical chemistry
  4. Analytical chemistry & spectroscopy
  5. Computational chemistry & molecular dynamics
  6. Cheminformatics & drug discovery
  7. Materials science & polymer chemistry

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  1. PhD in chemistry, computational chemistry, chemical biology, materials science, or a closely related field.
  2. Hands-on research lab experience, including wet lab experience for experimental subfields, or extensive simulation-heavy research for computational subfields.
  3. Deep expertise in at least one of the areas listed above.
  4. Professional written and spoken English (C1 or higher).
  5. Proficiency in Python and/or industry-standard tools in your subfield (e.g., Gaussian, ORCA, Psi4, GROMACS, LAMMPS, RDKit).
  6. Excellent quantitative, analytical, and scientific reasoning skills.
  7. Outstanding written and verbal communication abilities, with the ability to clearly document and explain technical concepts.
  8. Track record of rigorous scientific problem-solving in complex chemistry domains.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Academic experience (postdoc, research scientist, faculty, or equivalent), strongly preferred.
  2. Peer-reviewed publications, patents, or contributions to open-source scientific software.
  3. Experience with AI/ML-assisted chemistry workflows or benchmarking.
  4. Background in drug discovery, reaction prediction, or retrosynthesis.

Role Title: Music & Sound Annotation Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Music & Sound Annotation Experts to contribute to a customer's project at the forefront of music and audio technology.

Your ears are the ground truth. You'll listen to short field recordings and document exactly what's audible — instruments, tempo, key, background sounds, crowd reactions — through a structured web platform built for this project. Later phases involve grading AI model answers against what you actually heard.

What you'll do

  1. Listen to 30–90 second field recordings (headphones, your own quiet workspace) and complete structured annotations: which instruments are present, tempo and key, timestamps of background events (traffic, sirens, applause), scene details
  2. Compare paired recordings of the same song captured at different locations and judge what stayed the same and what changed
  3. In later phases: review AI model descriptions of clips and mark what's correct, wrong, or invented, with a brief written explanation
  4. Attend a paid onboarding/calibration session and a short weekly sync

Who we're looking for (any of these backgrounds)

  1. Working or gigging musicians, session players, producers, or mixing engineers
  2. Music educators, ear-training instructors, band/choir directors, conservatory students or graduates
  3. Location sound recordists, sound designers, foley artists, or podcast/documentary audio editors

Requirements

  1. 3+ years of hands-on music or audio experience
  2. Strong analytical listening: you can pick individual instruments out of a busy, noisy, real-world mix — not just studio recordings
  3. Can identify tempo (within a few BPM) and musical key (relative pitch with a reference is fine)
  4. Comfortable with detail-oriented, repetitive annotation work in a web platform — dropdowns, timestamps, short structured notes
  5. Clear written English for brief, evidence-based notes (e.g., "accordion enters around 0:12")
  6. Quality headphones, quiet workspace, reliable internet
  7. Available 20–25 hrs/week for the engagement window

Aerodynamics Expert (MSc. or PhD)

Pay: $80–$120/hour

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you can choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

We are looking for a highly skilled Aerodynamics Expert to contribute to an AI training project involving computational fluid dynamics, aerodynamic analysis, engineering simulation, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks that can be completed through programmatic, command-line-based workflows. A representative task may require analyzing an airfoil, preparing a computational domain and mesh, defining appropriate boundary conditions, running a CFD simulation, calculating lift and drag, and determining whether the resulting flow field is numerically and physically valid.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Solve and validate aerodynamic and fluid-dynamics problems.
  2. Translate physical requirements into computational models and solver-ready cases.
  3. Create or modify geometries, computational domains, and meshes.
  4. Define appropriate initial conditions, boundary conditions, fluid properties, and solver settings.
  5. Run CFD and aerodynamic-analysis workflows using command-line-accessible tools.
  6. Use Python to automate preprocessing, simulation execution, parameter sweeps, postprocessing, and validation.

Required Qualifications

  1. An MS or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering with an aerodynamics, fluid dynamics, or thermofluids specialization; or
  2. A BS in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering plus at least 1–2 years of aero-specific professional or research experience.
  3. Strong understanding of fluid mechanics and applied aerodynamics.
  4. Experience formulating and executing CFD or aerodynamic analyses.
  5. Practical proficiency with Python.
  6. Experience with at least one engineering tool or library that can be operated through a CLI, scripting interface, configuration files, or programmatic API.
  7. Ability to select and justify modeling assumptions, boundary conditions, mesh strategies, and solver settings.
  8. Ability to diagnose non-convergence, unstable solutions, incorrect results, and physically invalid outputs.
  9. Ability to communicate technical reasoning and engineering trade-offs clearly.

Relevant tools may include Python,OpenFOAM, SU2, Gmsh, FEniCSx, Elmer, CalculiX, SciPy, or similar programmatic engineering software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.

Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter, solver APIs, mesh-processing libraries, or domain-specific scientific packages. No single library is mandatory.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

At Remote Talent LATAM, we connect top Latin American talent with leading U.S. marketing agencies. We guide businesses and candidates through every step of the hiring process, ensuring the perfect match in skills, culture, and goals. While we’re not direct employers, we act as a trusted partner, bridging the gap between exceptional talent and growing opportunities.

About the Client

Our client is a fast-growing U.S. digital marketing agency specializing in medical and aesthetic practices, including dermatologists, plastic surgeons, med spas, and healthcare providers.

They work with 80+ active clients across North America, providing services such as paid advertising, web design, local SEO, and patient retention.

About the Role

We are seeking an exceptional Head of Web Design (AI-First Design Engineer) to take full ownership of the agency's web department. Reporting directly to the Founder, this is an executive player-coach seat: you will lead brand discovery with practice owners, craft visual identities, and directly design and build high-converting websites using an AI-first workflow, while leading and modernizing an internal web team.

In this role, you bridge the gap between creative director, client-facing brand consultant, and front-end design engineer. You don't simply draft wireframes and toss them over a wall to developers, you take projects from initial discovery all the way to pixel-perfect, interactive production using modern visual builders or AI-assisted code. Your primary objective is ensuring clients fall in love with a digital home that genuinely represents their brand, driving measurable patient bookings and rapid deployment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead brand discovery calls with practice owners, turning founder stories, ideal patient profiles, and aesthetic tastes into written brand narratives and distinct visual directions within 3 to 5 business days.
  • Personally design and build complete client websites from scratch to live launch with high fidelity, interaction, and responsiveness, choosing the optimal platform per client (WordPress/Elementor, Webflow, Framer, Wix Studio, or AI-coded stacks).
  • Direct authentic photography and generate custom, art-directed AI imagery (using tools like Midjourney or Flux) for treatments, textures, and clinic scenes that avoid looking generic or stock-like.
  • Partner hand-in-hand with the internal SEO Lead to co-own site architecture, balancing high-converting UX with technical search intent, schema, internal linking, and fast page speeds.
  • Design custom brand identities, logos, and comprehensive brandbooks as paid client offerings.
  • Lead, mentor, and evaluate the web department (overseeing seats including a Senior Web Developer, AI Web Creative Director, and Web Delivery Lead) with full hiring and team structuring authority within budget.
  • Retrain and elevate the web department to operate with AI-first production tools and workflows, scaling capacity to ship 4 to 6 client sites per month.
  • Triage and clear existing operational backlogs, establishing a permanent intake, QA, and delivery system to keep projects moving on schedule.
  • Enforce launch scorecards for every new build, validating client satisfaction, speed benchmarks (Core Web Vitals), indexing health, and active conversion/booking tracking.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience designing and building websites end-to-end, with a proven track record leading a small production or design team (2 to 4 people).
  • True Design Engineer execution: ability to conceptualize high-end designs in Figma and build them out directly with motion and interaction in Webflow, Framer, WordPress (Elementor), Wix Studio, or clean AI-assisted code.
  • Power-user mastery of modern AI workflows (such as Claude, Midjourney, Flux, v0, and Figma AI) integrated naturally into daily production.
  • Professional verbal and written English with the executive presence to command brand discovery calls, read client nuances, and present concepts persuasively to U.S. medical founders.
  • Proven creative craft and design range, capable of moving smoothly between luxury editorial, warm community-focused, and clinical-modern aesthetics
  • Solid foundation in UX conversion optimization and SEO essentials (semantic site structures, mobile responsiveness, Core Web Vitals, and conversion paths).

Benefits

  • Salary: Competitive compensation ranging from $5,000 to $7,000 USD per month, based on design engineering depth and leadership experience.
  • Executive Impact: Direct leadership of the agency's web division with full authority over team structure, hiring, and tooling.
  • Contract: Independent Contractor
  • PTO: 2 weeks of paid time off + 1 week of sick leave annually.

Eligibility Criteria

  • This position is only open to candidates residing in Latin American (LATAM) countries, such as: 🇦🇷 🇧🇷 🇨🇱 🇨🇴 🇨🇷 🇩🇴 🇪🇨 🇸🇻 🇬🇹 🇭🇳 🇲🇽 🇳🇮 🇵🇦 🇵🇾 🇵🇪 🇺🇾 🇻🇪
  • ❌ Applications from candidates outside LATAM (including the U.S. and other regions) will not be considered.
  • 📄 Resumes must be submitted in English.
  • 🚫 Applications that do not meet these criteria will be automatically rejected.

raw.description:
Tartutko rohkeasti toimeen uusien haasteiden edessä? Onko erinomainen asiakaspalvelu sinulle luontaista? Jos vastasit kyllä, hae meille palkanlaskijaksi Hoivatiimiimme!

Palkkahallinnon asiantuntijana Talenomilla

Tehtävässä huolehdit itsenäisesti sinulle nimettyjen asiakkaiden palkanlaskentaprosessista ja sen kehittämisestä toimien asiakkaiden luottohenkilönä palkka-asioissa. Toivomme, että sinulla on vähintään 2-3 vuoden kokemus palkanlaskennasta ja olet ehtinyt kartuttaa varmuutta itsenäiseen asiakasvastuuseen. Eduksesi katsotaan myös aiempi kokemus hoiva-alalta.

Arvostamme sitä, että hallitset palkanlaskennan prosessit kokonaisuutena, työskentelet järjestelmällisesti myös kiireen keskellä ja pystyt tuottamaan asiakkaalle lisäarvoa konsultoivalla otteella.

Nautit vuorovaikutuksesta, uskallat tarttua haasteisiin ja viet asiat loppuun saakka laadukkaasti sekä täsmällisesti. Lähestyt uusia asioita avoimesti ja innolla ja kehitätkin osaamistasi aktiivisesti. Osaat johtaa omaa työtäsi, priorisoida ja pitää useat kokonaisuudet hallinnassa samanaikaisesti. 

Työskentely tapahtuu pääasiassa suomeksi, mutta englannin kielen osaamisesta on etua tehtävässä. Katsomme eduksesi myös kokemuksen Mepco-järjestelmistä. Hoivatiimi ja sen esihenkilö työskentelevät pääasiallisesti Oulussa, mutta sinä voit työskennellä myös etänä toiselta paikkakunnalta.

Miksi valitsisit meidät?

Vaikka etsimme itsenäistä, oma-aloitteista ja vastuullista ihmistä, saat seuraksesi parhaat työkaverit ja heidän tukensa. Tiimisi auttaa sinua matkan varrella ja luo yhteenkuuluvuuden tunnetta. Yhteishenki onkin yksi tärkeimmistä voimavaroistamme ja arjessamme on tilaa naurulle sekä rennolle, positiiviselle hengelle. Talenomille jokainen on myös tervetullut omana itsenään. 

Meille henkilökohtainen kehitys on strateginen valinta. Tarjoamme monenlaisia koulutuksia, joiden avulla voit viedä osaamisesi seuraavalle tasolle. Jotta kehitys on mahdollista myös käytännössä, huolehdimme myös työntekijöidemme hyvinvoinnista ja jaksamisesta. Voit tutustua palkanlaskentaamme tarkemminurasivuillamme.


Liity joukkoomme ja nouse kanssamme palkkahallinnon huipulle!

Tehtävän palkkahaitari on 2300–3450 euroa määräytyen tehtävään valittujen aiemman kokemuksen sekä osaamisen perusteella. Hakuaika päättyy 29.11.2026, mutta haastattelut voidaan osittain aloittaa jo hakuaikana. Työn aloitusajankohta sovitaan valitun henkilön kanssa, mutta toivomme että pystyt aloittamaan tammikuun aikana.

Jäikö jokin vielä askarruttamaan? Voit olla yhteydessä Hanna-Leena Lauroseen, p. 0207 52 5164, tai Tiia-Maria Kreiviin, p. 0293 722131

Tehtävään valittavalta henkilöltä tarkastetaan luottotiedot.

Tietoa meistä

Talenom on ketterä taloushallinnon palvelutalo sekä yksi Suomen suurimmista tilitoimistoista. Mikä on salaisuutemme? Talenomilaiset ovat oman alansa ammattilaisia, tekijöistä parhaimpia. Meidät tunnetaan aktiivisesta otteestamme sekä ainutlaatuisesta palveluvalikoimastamme. Meillä on myös maan parhaimmat asiakkaat, joille voimme tarjota markkinoiden edistyksellisimpiä taloushallinnon ratkaisuja.

Työntekijät ovat meidän tärkein voimavaramme ja yksi tärkeimmistä tavoitteistamme on työntekijöiden hyvinvointi. Haluamme jatkuvasti kehittää toimintatapojamme saavuttaaksemme luottamuksen, ylpeyden ja yhteishengen työntekijöiden keskuudessa. Meille on myös myönnetty Great Place to Work –sertifikaatti osoituksena hyvästä työpaikasta ja suomalaisen työelämän suunnannäyttämisestä.

About Net at Work

Founded in 1996, Net at Work is one of North America’s largest technology advisors and solution providers for small and mid-size businesses. Our award-winning consultancy offers a rich portfolio of next-generation technology, industry expertise, implementation and managed services to help organizations derive value from the transformative benefits of technology.

Through the integration of ERP, HCM and/or CRM solutions, Net at Work offers unique, industry-specific solutions and operation platforms that enable companies to compete more effectively in today’s digital economy. For more information, visit www.netatwork.com.

About this Position

The Employee Experience Project Manager (PM) is responsible for the successful planning, coordination, and delivery of Human Capital Management (HCM) solutions for Net at Work clients. This role centers around client excellence—building trusted partnerships, maintaining high satisfaction levels, and driving long-term value. The PM works directly with clients to clarify business requirements, propose scalable solutions, and ensure smooth implementation. They serve as the key liaison between clients and internal teams, leveraging strong communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills. The PM also supports the sales team by contributing to project scoping and helping to expand client relationships through ongoing service opportunities.

Job Responsibilities

🔹 Client Relationship Management & Client Excellence

  • Serve as the trusted advisor and primary contact for clients throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Build strong, lasting relationships with client stakeholders, ensuring satisfaction and long-term engagement.
  • Maintain a proactive approach to client communications, providing strategic updates and anticipating needs.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to align project execution with client goals and desired outcomes.
  • Ensure a seamless handoff to post-implementation support teams, maintaining continuity and trust.
  • Identify opportunities for additional services or support, contributing to account growth and retention.

🔹 Project Planning & Initiation

  • Define detailed project plans, including timelines, milestones, budgets, and resource requirements.
  • Coordinate team onboarding and ensure readiness for project execution.
  • Share pre-kickoff materials (e.g., questionnaires, onboarding materials) with clients.
  • Lead internal and external project kickoff meetings.

🔹 Project Execution & Coordination

  • Direct project execution in alignment with defined schedules, budgets, and scope.
  • Coordinate and assign tasks across the project team to ensure timely delivery.
  • Monitor progress and make necessary adjustments to meet client expectations.
  • Track milestones and timelines, adjusting workflows and resources as needed.
  • Ensure smaller projects are progressing appropriately, even if formal meetings are not required.
  • Monitor third-party project status and follow up on closure timelines.

🔹 Client & Stakeholder Communication

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all project stakeholders internally and externally.
  • Conduct regular project status calls based on project size and complexity.
  • Send project status summary emails and post meeting recaps/status reports to the project folder.
  • Maintain an up-to-date project plan and communicate changes proactively internally and with the client.
  • Provide timely updates to clients and executive leadership.

🔹 Issue Management & Risk Mitigation

  • Monitor the “pulse” of open issues and tickets to ensure timely resolution.
  • Identify, analyze, and resolve issues that may impact project performance or deliverables.
  • Facilitate issue resolution to keep the project on track and within defined parameters.
  • Escalate risks appropriately and implement mitigation strategies.

🔹 Project Closure & Transition

  • Ensure completion of all deliverables and adherence to quality standards.
  • Conduct project closure and support transition meetings.
  • Capture lessons learned and contribute to continuous improvement efforts.

🔹 Process Improvement & Strategic Input

  • Provide strategic input for improving administrative and business processes.
  • Contribute to process analysis, redesign, and organizational effectiveness initiatives.

Job Requirements

  • BA or BS in Computer Science or related field, PMP Certification preferred
  • Strong project management background, proven success in delivering projects on time, on budget and in scope.
  • 4+ years’ experience in information systems development or implementation with progressively more complex responsibilities and accountabilities, with a focus on HRIS implementation and management.
  • Ability to effectively document business and technical designs
  • Strong understanding of HR and payroll processes, regulations, and best practices.
  • Successful track record of delivering on agreed-upon business objectives and performance on key metrics.

Customer Requirements

This job may require access to customer information, systems, and/or premises. As a result, this job may require customer approval for such access as an essential job function.

Core Values

  • Client Champion – Relentlessly exceed client expectations. Consistently anticipate needs to deliver valuable solutions and extraordinary outcomes.
  • Problem Solver – Smart, analytical, inquisitive, knowledge-seeker that thrives on a challenge.
  • Promise Keeper – Place high value on keeping our word and doing the right thing. Demonstrate honesty, integrity, and commitment.
  • Collaborative Integrator –Team player, unifier, relationship-oriented, win-win seeker, exemplify the concept of relationships through trust and unity.
  • Driven Intrapreneur – Exceed goals using independent creative thinking, optimism, self-confidence, and a can-do attitude.
  • Inspiring Coach – Help employees, clients and partners using knowledge, expertise, experience, and situational fluency.

Compensation and Benefits

Base salary range: $85,000-$115,000.

This position is also eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the Company's plan.

Please note that the quoted pay range for this job is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) experience, including industry or product-specific experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, and/or other applicable laws.

  • Short- and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts

  • Health Savings Accounts (with company contribution)

  • Legal Benefits
  • Identity Theft Protection
  • Pet Insurance

raw.description:
About the Company
Cytovale is a leading innovator in early sepsis detection, revolutionizing emergency care with its advanced IntelliSep technology. This system provides rapid, actionable insights into a patient's likelihood of having or developing sepsis through a quick 8-minute blood test. IntelliSep's unique capability to assess immune dysregulation enhances the triage and treatment of sepsis, promoting patient-centered care, operational efficiencies, and provider satisfaction. Cytovale is committed to successful implementation, clinical adoption, and continual improvement of healthcare outcomes.

Position Overview:
The Customer Success Executive (CSE) plays a critical leadership role in leading enterprise implementations of IntelliSep across health systems. As the overall implementation leader and program owner, the CSE orchestrates cross-functional implementation activities, drives implementation governance, aligns customer and internal stakeholders, manages implementation risks, and maintains accountability for successful implementation outcomes.

The CSE provides implementation leadership by orchestrating cross-functional execution across Medical Affairs, Field Application Scientists, Data Science, Sales, Customer Service, and other internal functions. While accountable for overall implementation success, the CSE leverages the expertise of functional teams responsible for technical, clinical, operational, and commercial execution within their respective areas of ownership.

Key Responsibilities:
Customer Leadership & Governance
  • Develop executive working relationships with executive sponsors, laboratory leadership, clinical stakeholders, information technology teams, and operational leaders
  • Establish governance structures and communication plans that maintain alignment across customer and Cytovale stakeholders
  • Lead executive communications, governance meetings, implementation updates, risk discussions, and customer business reviews.
  • Develop an understanding of each customer's organizational priorities, success metrics, workflows, and strategic initiatives
  • Balance customer priorities with Cytovale implementation best practices

Program & Implementation Leadership
  • Develop, own and maintain the integrated implementation project plan across customer and Cytovale workstreams, ensuring alignment of milestones, critical path activities, dependencies, implementation governance, resource planning and overall program execution
  • Lead execution of the integrated implementation plan by orchestrating cross-functional workstreams across Laboratory (FAS), Clinical (Medical Affairs), Technical Service & Support, Customer Service, Information Technology, Data Science, Sales, and other internal functions
  • Lead implementation governance meetings that align customer stakeholders and Cytovale functional teams on implementation priorities, project status, resource planning, risks, dependencies, and executive decisions
  • Identify implementation risks early, develop and maintain mitigation plans, coordinate cross-functional resources, proactively remove implementation barriers, and drive timely resolution of issues
  • Guide customer stakeholders through implementation by ensuring clear understanding of upcoming project milestones, responsibilities, dependencies, key decision points and implementation expectations
  • Lead organizational readiness planning with site leadership to align implementation activities, workflow integration, operational planning, change management, and go-live readiness
  • Maintain accountability for overall implementation execution by ensuring commitments are completed, milestones are achieved, dependencies are resolved, and implementation activities remain on schedule while enabling functional teams to execute within their areas of expertise
  • Track implementation milestones through governance meetings, action items, implementation documentation, decision tracking, and milestone reviews to ensure successful execution and launch readiness

Customer Success & Outcome Achievement
  • Align customer stakeholders and internal teams around implementation objectives, adoption goals, success metrics, and long-term operational outcomes
  • Monitor implementation progress, program health, adoption metrics, implementation KPIs, and overall implementation readiness throughout the customer lifecycle, ensuring successful transition from implementation to ongoing customer sucess
  • Lead recurring customer governance meetings, KPI reviews, executive business reviews, and success planning sessions
  • Coordinate with Medical Affairs, Data Science, and other functional teams to review implementation progress, adoption trends, customer feedback, and opportunities for continuous improvement
  • Lead executive-level customer escalations by coordinating cross-functional response plans, maintaining proactive executive communication, and ensuring timely resolution of implementation issues
  • Capture customer feedback, identify implementation trends, and drive continuous improvements to implementation processes and the overall customer experience

Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in healthcare, life sciences, nursing, business, engineering or a related field.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience leading enterprise healthcare technology implementations, implementation program management, customer success, clinical operations, laboratory operations, or other customer-facing leadership roles
  • Demonstrated success implementing complex medical technologies within acute care hospitals or integrated delivery networks
  • Proven experience leading enterprise implementations involving executive, laboratory, clinical, operational, and information technology stakeholders across multiple concurrent workstreams
  • Exceptional presentation, communication, executive facilitation, stakeholder management and influence skills
  • Strong enterprise implementation program management, organizational, governance, and problem-solving abilities, including experience developing integrated implementation project plans, managing critical path activities, facilitating governance meetings, tracking action items, and leading multiple complex customer implementations simultaneously
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional implementation programs through influence rather than direct authority in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office with the ability to independently develop executive presentations, implementation project plans, dashboards, implementation documentation, and customer-facing materials
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience leading enterprise implementation programs involving multiple concurrent workstreams, executive governance, organizational change management, and cross-functional stakeholder alignment
  • Demonstrated ability to build credibility and influence executive, clinical, laboratory, operational, and information technology stakeholders across complex healthcare organizations
  • Frontline experience in clinical care, healthcare technology, or hospital operations, with an understanding of how new technologies are implemented and adopted within hospital environments
  • Familiarity with laboratory operations, emergency department workflows, clinical implementation, healthcare information technology, and regulated healthcare environments
  • Experience interpreting operational or clinical data to measure adoption, program success, and organizational outcomes
  • Experience leading executive business reviews, customer governance meetings, and executive implementation reviews

Travel Requirements

This position requires some travel, approximately 10-20%, including travel to customer sites throughout implementation, post-live optimization, executive business reviews, and strategic customer engagements.

Location
This is a remote, field-based position.

Compensation
Competitive salary and benefits package, commensurate with experience.

raw.description:
Location: Fully remote
Company: Latvia-based startup
Compensation: We operate on a startup budget. Compensation will be discussed transparently during the hiring process and paid monthly in USD.
Engagement type: Full-time
Working hours: Flexible

About Us

We are a Latvia-based startup building a finance function that combines accurate accounting, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and practical AI automation.

We are looking for a finance professional who can personally manage our accounting, configure the systems supporting it and use AI agents to carry out the work more efficiently.

Job Description

You will personally perform and take ownership of our accounting and financial operations, using AI agents to support your work. Your responsibilities will cover daily bookkeeping, reconciliations, closing, financial reporting, cash planning and applicable Latvian tax reporting.

You will personally carry out the complete migration from QuickBooks to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, using AI agents to support your work. You will be responsible for all implementation tasks, from planning and data preparation through configuration, import, validation and go-live. No external implementation partners will be involved. As part of preparing and importing the data, you will review the complete accounting records for the past five years, identify gaps and errors, and reconcile the migrated data to the source records. You must be comfortable both doing the accounting and setting up the accounting system.

AI agents will assist with document processing, transaction preparation, matching, reconciliation and reporting. You will define their tasks, supervise their execution, investigate exceptions and verify their outputs. You remain responsible for the accuracy and completeness of the work.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform day-to-day bookkeeping, accounts payable and receivable, invoicing, expense accounting and bank reconciliations.
  • Complete month-end and year-end closing, balance sheet reconciliations, accruals and supporting documentation.
  • Set up, configure and maintain Business Central, including the chart of accounts, posting groups, dimensions, VAT setup, bank accounts, accounting periods and relevant financial workflows.
  • Personally execute the complete migration from QuickBooks to Business Central, including data extraction, account and tax mapping, cleansing, system configuration, trial imports, reconciliation and go-live. Review all accounting records for the past five years during migration preparation and import, investigate missing or incorrect entries, document corrections and preserve supporting documents and a traceable audit trail.
  • Prepare and manage applicable Latvian tax and statutory reporting, including VAT, corporate income tax, payroll-related obligations and VID/EDS processes.
  • Handle international customers, suppliers, contractors, foreign currencies and cross-border transactions.
  • Manage cash-flow forecasts, budgets, runway monitoring and management reporting.
  • Prepare payments and administer payroll and contractor payments within agreed approval controls.
  • Configure, instruct and supervise AI agents supporting accounting workflows; improve their performance through clear instructions, reliable source data and systematic verification.
  • Maintain traceability from original documents to accounting entries, resolve exceptions and protect confidential financial information.
  • Identify practical opportunities to reduce costs, improve financial controls and apply lawful tax efficiencies.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience personally performing the full accounting cycle for companies in one or more European countries.
  • Practical experience with accounting, taxation and statutory reporting in one or more European countries, and the ability to apply and verify Latvian requirements. Direct Latvian accounting and VID/EDS experience is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience independently setting up and configuring Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central for real accounting operations, with the ability to personally execute a complete accounting-system migration.
  • The ability to translate business requirements into appropriate accounting configuration and verify that postings, reconciliations and reports work correctly.
  • Practical experience using AI agents or AI-supported automation in finance or accounting, including supervising outputs and handling errors.
  • Strong spreadsheet and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate incomplete records and reconcile inconsistent data.
  • Independent working habits, ownership of deadlines and clear communication with the founder.
  • Professional working proficiency in English and the ability to work effectively with Latvian-language financial documents and reporting requirements.
  • A relevant accounting or finance qualification, or equivalent substantial practical experience.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building or improving the accounting function of a startup or small international business.
  • QuickBooks to Business Central migrations, Business Central implementations and comprehensive reviews and correction of historical accounting records.
  • Configuring integrations with banks, payment platforms, document systems and Microsoft 365.
  • Power Automate, Power BI, APIs or comparable tools used in practical finance workflows.
  • Accounting for digital services, subscriptions and international contractor relationships.
  • Preparing financial information for funding discussions or due diligence.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote role with direct collaboration with the founder.
  • Responsibility for both the accounting work and the systems supporting it.
  • The opportunity to shape how Business Central and AI agents work together in a startup.
  • A practical environment where reliable execution, sensible automation and cost awareness matter.

Remote Working Arrangement

You will organize your work independently, communicate progress clearly and meet agreed accounting and reporting deadlines. Financial systems and confidential information must be handled securely.

This is a full-time role with flexible working hours. You will organize your schedule around agreed accounting and reporting deadlines.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and briefly describe:

  • The European countries in which you have personally handled accounting and tax reporting, and your specific responsibilities.
  • A Business Central implementation or accounting-system migration you personally executed, including the setup, data migration and validation you performed yourself, and any experience with QuickBooks or historical accounting reviews.
  • How you have used AI agents or automation to perform accounting work and verify its accuracy.

Use anonymized examples and clearly distinguish your own work from work delivered by others.

About the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (the College)

The College is the authority mandated by the Government of Canada to regulate the practice of Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultants (RCICs) and Regulated International Student Immigration Advisors (RISIAs). Its role, authority and powers are established in the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants Act (Canada). The College sets and enforces the licensing, education and ethical standards of the profession in the public interest.

Industry

Self-Regulatory Organization (SRO)

Position

JOB TITLE: Law Clerk, Tribunals (Bilingual)

Department: Professional Conduct

Reports to: Manager, Tribunals

Language Requirement: Bilingual Imperative

Location: Canada

Classification: Full-Time

Why join us?

Do you want to be part of a team that strives to enhance and uphold Canada’s immigration and citizenship consulting profession? If you share our passion and purpose, please consider applying for the opportunity below to become part of a team that makes a difference.

How will this role support our team?

The incumbent provides legal and administrative assistance to support the operation of the Tribunal Committees. This includes monitoring and adherence to deadlines, reporting, managing and distributing case documents to prepare for hearings and/or Tribunal Committees proceedings.

Responsibilities Include (but are not limited to)

  • Provide legal and administrative assistance to support the operations of the Tribunal Committees.
  • Assist the Manager, Tribunals with tasks related to motions, case management and Tribunal Committees decisions:
  • Input case information and results into the case management database. Review case statistics and service standards monthly to identify opportunities for process improvement.
  • Respond to queries from external stakeholders (e.g., licensees, complainants, external lawyers and Committee members), related to the hearings process and other Committee work.
  • Prepare closing letters to complainants and licensees for Compensation Fund claim applications.
  • Prepare, compile, format, index, and organize the Tribunal Committees Record for Federal Court cases, Access to Information Act and Privacy Act requests (if applicable).
  • Acquire and maintain knowledge of the College’s policies, regulations, and strategies, and keep up to date with relevant developments, applicable legislation, trends and best practices.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure the College meets and delivers on its legislative compliance requirements without delay.

This role will support our team by providing

  • Knowledge of legal and administrative law concepts, principles and terminology as well as the ability to acquire knowledge of the College Act, regulations, By-laws, Code of Professional Conduct and discipline committee rules and procedures
  • Time management and organizational skills to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
  • Organizational skills and attention to keep track of deadlines and a high volume of case documents and materials
  • Interpersonal and stakeholder relationship management skills to interact professionally and respectfully with stakeholders (Tribunal participants, licensees, counsel, witnesses etc.)
  • Written and verbal communication skills to prepare legal documentation (e.g., draft orders, decision letters), and website content to comply with the College’s publication obligations and communicate with stakeholders about issues related to cases, as required
  • Attention to detail to ensure accuracy and completeness of documents and materials
  • Tact and discretion to work on confidential and sensitive matters

Required Education and Experience

  • College Diploma in law (Legal Assistant, Law Clerk or Paralegal)
  • 3-5 years of experience working as a law clerk in a law firm, government office or professional regulator, including experience working with administrative tribunals or courts
  • Bilingual in English and French
  • Knowledge of office/administrative software, online storage and case management systems

What We Offer

  • The College hires and onboards 100% remotely
  • The opportunity to protect the public interest within the immigration and citizenship sector
  • A culture of transparency, where team members are involved in important conversations
  • Full health benefits from day one for you and your family
  • Access to the Employee and Family Assistance program
  • RRSP match

How to Apply

Click here to upload your resume and brief cover letter indicating why you feel you are fit for this role.

Your personal information is collected and used by the College when you apply for employment with the College. Please read the College’s Privacy Notice for more information regarding its privacy practices.

The College is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from persons legally entitled to work in Canada, who represent the diversity of our nation, and whose qualifications meet the skills and experiences we seek. We are committed to providing equal opportunities to all candidates and to meeting the needs of people with disabilities. Should you be contacted regarding an employment opportunity and require an accommodation for a disability, we will be pleased to work with you to identify how we can best support you through this process.

The successful candidate will be required to undergo a criminal background check.

While we thank all applicants for their interest, only those identified for further consideration will be contacted.

À propos du Collège des consultants en immigration et en citoyenneté (le Collège)

Le Collège est l’autorité mandatée par le gouvernement du Canada pour réglementer la pratique des consultants réglementés en immigration canadienne (CRIC) et des conseillers réglementés en immigration pour étudiants étrangers (CRIEE). Son rôle et ses pouvoirs sont établis dans la Loi sur le Collège des consultants en immigration et en citoyenneté (Canada). Le Collège établit les normes de la profession en matière de délivrance de permis, de formation et d’éthique et veille à leur application dans l’intérêt public.

Secteur

Organisme d’autoréglementation (OAR)

Poste

TITRE DU POSTE : Assistant ou assistante juridique, tribunaux (bilingue)

Service : Conduite professionnelle

Supérieur immédiat : Gestionnaire, tribunaux

Exigences linguistiques : Bilinguisme essentiel

Lieu : Canada

Classification : Temps plein

Pourquoi vous joindre à nous?

Souhaitez-vous faire partie d’une équipe qui a à cœur de renforcer et de soutenir la profession de consultant en immigration et en citoyenneté? Si vous partagez notre passion et notre objectif, posez votre candidature ci-dessous pour vous joindre à une équipe qui apporte une contribution importante.

De quelle façon ce rôle soutiendra-t-il notre équipe?

Le ou la titulaire du poste fournit de l’assistance juridique et administrative afin de soutenir le fonctionnement des comités du Tribunal. Cela comprend la surveillance et le respect des échéanciers, l’établissement de rapports, la gestion et la distribution de dossiers liés aux cas aux fins de préparation aux audiences ou aux procédures des comités du Tribunal.

Les responsabilités comprennent les éléments suivants (sans toutefois s’y limiter) :

  • Fournir une aide juridique et administrative afin de soutenir le fonctionnement des comités du Tribunal.
  • Aider la gestionnaire, tribunaux, avec des tâches liées aux requêtes, à la gestion des dossiers et aux décisions des comités du Tribunal.
  • Saisir les renseignements sur les dossiers et les résultats dans la base de données de gestion des dossiers. Passer en revue les statistiques sur les dossiers et les normes de service chaque mois pour relever les possibilités d’amélioration du processus.
  • Répondre aux demandes de renseignements des parties prenantes externes (p. ex. titulaires de permis, plaignants, avocats externes et membres du comité) liés au processus d’audience et aux autres travaux du Comité.
  • Préparer des lettres de clôture à l’intention des plaignants et des titulaires de permis pour les demandes de réclamation auprès du fonds d’indemnisation.
  • Préparer, compiler, formater, indexer et organiser les dossiers des comités du Tribunal pour les dossiers de la Cour fédérale, ainsi que les demandes en vertu de la Loi sur l’accès à l’information et de la Loi sur la protection des renseignements personnels (s’il y a lieu).
  • Acquérir et maintenir des connaissances concernant les politiques, les règlements et les stratégies du Collège, et se tenir à jour des développements récents, des dispositions législatives applicables, des tendances et des pratiques exemplaires.
  • Collaborer avec les parties prenantes internes pour s’assurer que le Collège respecte ses obligations en matière de conformité législative et les remplit sans délai.

Ce rôle soutiendra notre équipe en y apportant les éléments suivants :

  • Connaissance des concepts, des principes et de la terminologie juridiques dans le contexte des lois et du droit administratif, et capacité à acquérir des connaissances sur la Loi sur le Collège, les règlements, les règlements administratifs, le Code de déontologie ainsi que les règles et les procédures du Comité de discipline.
  • Aptitudes pour la gestion du temps et sens de l’organisation permettant de gérer des priorités et des échéances concurrentes.
  • Sens de l’organisation et attention soutenue pour assurer le suivi des échéanciers et d’un volume élevé de documents et de dossiers.
  • Habiletés interpersonnelles et aptitudes pour la gestion des relations avec les parties prenantes permettant d’interagir avec ces dernières de manière professionnelle et respectueuse (titulaires de permis, conseillers juridiques, témoins, etc.)
  • Aptitudes pour la communication écrite et verbale en vue de préparer les documents juridiques (p. ex. projets d’ordonnance, lettres de décision) et le contenu du site Web afin de se conformer aux obligations du Collège en matière de publication et de s’entretenir avec les parties prenantes au sujet de questions liées aux dossiers, au besoin.
  • Souci du détail permettant de veiller à l’exactitude et à l’exhaustivité des documents.
  • Délicatesse et discrétion afin de travailler sur des affaires confidentielles et de nature sensible.

Formation et expérience requises

  • Diplôme d’études collégiales en droit (p. ex. assistant juridique, assistant judiciaire ou parajuriste).
  • Trois à cinq années d’expérience à titre d’assistant ou assistante juridique dans un cabinet d’avocats, un bureau du gouvernement ou au sein d’un organisme de réglementation, notamment auprès des cours ou tribunaux administratifs.
  • Bilinguisme en français et en anglais.
  • Connaissance des logiciels de bureau et administratifs ainsi que des systèmes de stockage en ligne et de gestion des dossiers.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Le processus d’embauche et d’accueil du Collège se fait entièrement à distance
  • L’occasion de protéger l’intérêt public relativement à l’immigration et la citoyenneté
  • Une culture de transparence où les membres de l’équipe participent aux conversations importantes
  • Prestations-maladie complètes dès le premier jour, pour vous et votre famille
  • Accès au programme d’aide aux employés et à leur famille
  • Contribution équivalente de l’employeur au REER

Pour postuler

Cliquez ici pour téléverser votre curriculum vitæ et une courte lettre de présentation indiquant les raisons pour lesquelles vous estimez être à même d’assumer ce rôle.

Job Title: Senior Administrative Assistant

Job Location: Livingston, West Lothian, United Kingdom

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Overview

Undertake high level administrative support to a department or team, involving some independent research and collation of information. Responsibilities will require interaction at senior levels and exposure to highly confidential information requiring considerable use of tact, diplomacy and discretion. Duties and responsibilities will be broad in scope and require considerable judgment and initiative in resolving unique problems and making recommendations. Professionally represents the manager and/or department assigned.


Essential Functions

  • Arrange and schedule meetings and teleconferences with internal and external parties.
  • Coordinate travel schedules making recommendations for cost saving and effective alternatives.
  • Compile meeting agendas, take and distribute minutes and follow up on action points, escalating issues where appropriate.
  • Independently research, compile data and compose both routine and non-routine correspondence, reports and presentations for review and final revision by manager. Routine items may be dealt with independently as delegated by the manager. Ensure that requested management information including Human Resources data is submitted accurately and to timescales.
  • Undertake projects, research data and make special studies, requiring independent decisions and conclusions.
  • When manager is unavailable, use initiative to review and prioritize activities, taking action or escalating critical matters as appropriate.
  • Serve as an information source for department, answering questions, making referrals as required, and conducting required research.
  • Assist in the development and design of improved administrative procedures to promote the timely processing and submission of all administrative deliverables.
  • Develop and implement an efficient work flow and information tracking/retrieval system across all assigned projects, and maintain/archives files and records.
  • May provide support and guidance to new or more junior members of staff.
  • Filter telephone calls, mail and email; dispersing and handling as appropriate.
  • Receive, photocopy, distribute, and file a variety of incoming and outgoing correspondence and reports.

• Perform other duties as required.


Qualifications

• High School Diploma or equivalent Req

  • 4 years' related experience; or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

• Ability to deal with routine matters.

  • Ability to exercise judgment within procedures and practices to determine appropriate action.
  • Ability to work within well defined guidelines and procedures.
  • Ability to prioritize own workloads to meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently and manage time efficiently.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with co-workers, managers and clients.

raw.description:
Tartutko rohkeasti toimeen uusien haasteiden edessä? Onko erinomainen asiakaspalvelu sinulle luontaista? Jos vastasit kyllä, hae meille palkanlaskijaksi Hoivatiimiimme!

Palkkahallinnon asiantuntijana Talenomilla

Tehtävässä huolehdit itsenäisesti sinulle nimettyjen asiakkaiden palkanlaskentaprosessista ja sen kehittämisestä toimien asiakkaiden luottohenkilönä palkka-asioissa. Toivomme, että sinulla on vähintään 2-3 vuoden kokemus palkanlaskennasta ja olet ehtinyt kartuttaa varmuutta itsenäiseen asiakasvastuuseen. Eduksesi katsotaan myös aiempi kokemus hoiva-alalta.

Arvostamme sitä, että hallitset palkanlaskennan prosessit kokonaisuutena, työskentelet järjestelmällisesti myös kiireen keskellä ja pystyt tuottamaan asiakkaalle lisäarvoa konsultoivalla otteella.

Nautit vuorovaikutuksesta, uskallat tarttua haasteisiin ja viet asiat loppuun saakka laadukkaasti sekä täsmällisesti. Lähestyt uusia asioita avoimesti ja innolla ja kehitätkin osaamistasi aktiivisesti. Osaat johtaa omaa työtäsi, priorisoida ja pitää useat kokonaisuudet hallinnassa samanaikaisesti. 

Työskentely tapahtuu pääasiassa suomeksi, mutta englannin kielen osaamisesta on etua tehtävässä. Katsomme eduksesi myös kokemuksen Mepco-järjestelmistä. Hoivatiimi ja sen esihenkilö työskentelevät pääasiallisesti Oulussa, mutta sinä voit työskennellä myös etänä toiselta paikkakunnalta.

Miksi valitsisit meidät?

Vaikka etsimme itsenäistä, oma-aloitteista ja vastuullista ihmistä, saat seuraksesi parhaat työkaverit ja heidän tukensa. Tiimisi auttaa sinua matkan varrella ja luo yhteenkuuluvuuden tunnetta. Yhteishenki onkin yksi tärkeimmistä voimavaroistamme ja arjessamme on tilaa naurulle sekä rennolle, positiiviselle hengelle. Talenomille jokainen on myös tervetullut omana itsenään. 

Meille henkilökohtainen kehitys on strateginen valinta. Tarjoamme monenlaisia koulutuksia, joiden avulla voit viedä osaamisesi seuraavalle tasolle. Jotta kehitys on mahdollista myös käytännössä, huolehdimme myös työntekijöidemme hyvinvoinnista ja jaksamisesta. Voit tutustua palkanlaskentaamme tarkemminurasivuillamme.


Liity joukkoomme ja nouse kanssamme palkkahallinnon huipulle!

Tehtävän palkkahaitari on 2300–3450 euroa määräytyen tehtävään valittujen aiemman kokemuksen sekä osaamisen perusteella. Hakuaika päättyy 29.11.2026, mutta haastattelut voidaan osittain aloittaa jo hakuaikana. Työn aloitusajankohta sovitaan valitun henkilön kanssa, mutta toivomme että pystyt aloittamaan tammikuun aikana.

Jäikö jokin vielä askarruttamaan? Voit olla yhteydessä Hanna-Leena Lauroseen, p. 0207 52 5164, tai Tiia-Maria Kreiviin, p. 0293 722131

Tehtävään valittavalta henkilöltä tarkastetaan luottotiedot.

Tietoa meistä

Talenom on ketterä taloushallinnon palvelutalo sekä yksi Suomen suurimmista tilitoimistoista. Mikä on salaisuutemme? Talenomilaiset ovat oman alansa ammattilaisia, tekijöistä parhaimpia. Meidät tunnetaan aktiivisesta otteestamme sekä ainutlaatuisesta palveluvalikoimastamme. Meillä on myös maan parhaimmat asiakkaat, joille voimme tarjota markkinoiden edistyksellisimpiä taloushallinnon ratkaisuja.

Työntekijät ovat meidän tärkein voimavaramme ja yksi tärkeimmistä tavoitteistamme on työntekijöiden hyvinvointi. Haluamme jatkuvasti kehittää toimintatapojamme saavuttaaksemme luottamuksen, ylpeyden ja yhteishengen työntekijöiden keskuudessa. Meille on myös myönnetty Great Place to Work –sertifikaatti osoituksena hyvästä työpaikasta ja suomalaisen työelämän suunnannäyttämisestä.

About Net at Work

Founded in 1996, Net at Work is one of North America’s largest technology advisors and solution providers for small and mid-size businesses. Our award-winning consultancy offers a rich portfolio of next-generation technology, industry expertise, implementation and managed services to help organizations derive value from the transformative benefits of technology.

Through the integration of ERP, HCM and/or CRM solutions, Net at Work offers unique, industry-specific solutions and operation platforms that enable companies to compete more effectively in today’s digital economy. For more information, visit www.netatwork.com.

About this Position

The Employee Experience Project Manager (PM) is responsible for the successful planning, coordination, and delivery of Human Capital Management (HCM) solutions for Net at Work clients. This role centers around client excellence—building trusted partnerships, maintaining high satisfaction levels, and driving long-term value. The PM works directly with clients to clarify business requirements, propose scalable solutions, and ensure smooth implementation. They serve as the key liaison between clients and internal teams, leveraging strong communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills. The PM also supports the sales team by contributing to project scoping and helping to expand client relationships through ongoing service opportunities.

Job Responsibilities

🔹 Client Relationship Management & Client Excellence

  • Serve as the trusted advisor and primary contact for clients throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Build strong, lasting relationships with client stakeholders, ensuring satisfaction and long-term engagement.
  • Maintain a proactive approach to client communications, providing strategic updates and anticipating needs.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to align project execution with client goals and desired outcomes.
  • Ensure a seamless handoff to post-implementation support teams, maintaining continuity and trust.
  • Identify opportunities for additional services or support, contributing to account growth and retention.

🔹 Project Planning & Initiation

  • Define detailed project plans, including timelines, milestones, budgets, and resource requirements.
  • Coordinate team onboarding and ensure readiness for project execution.
  • Share pre-kickoff materials (e.g., questionnaires, onboarding materials) with clients.
  • Lead internal and external project kickoff meetings.

🔹 Project Execution & Coordination

  • Direct project execution in alignment with defined schedules, budgets, and scope.
  • Coordinate and assign tasks across the project team to ensure timely delivery.
  • Monitor progress and make necessary adjustments to meet client expectations.
  • Track milestones and timelines, adjusting workflows and resources as needed.
  • Ensure smaller projects are progressing appropriately, even if formal meetings are not required.
  • Monitor third-party project status and follow up on closure timelines.

🔹 Client & Stakeholder Communication

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all project stakeholders internally and externally.
  • Conduct regular project status calls based on project size and complexity.
  • Send project status summary emails and post meeting recaps/status reports to the project folder.
  • Maintain an up-to-date project plan and communicate changes proactively internally and with the client.
  • Provide timely updates to clients and executive leadership.

🔹 Issue Management & Risk Mitigation

  • Monitor the “pulse” of open issues and tickets to ensure timely resolution.
  • Identify, analyze, and resolve issues that may impact project performance or deliverables.
  • Facilitate issue resolution to keep the project on track and within defined parameters.
  • Escalate risks appropriately and implement mitigation strategies.

🔹 Project Closure & Transition

  • Ensure completion of all deliverables and adherence to quality standards.
  • Conduct project closure and support transition meetings.
  • Capture lessons learned and contribute to continuous improvement efforts.

🔹 Process Improvement & Strategic Input

  • Provide strategic input for improving administrative and business processes.
  • Contribute to process analysis, redesign, and organizational effectiveness initiatives.

Job Requirements

  • BA or BS in Computer Science or related field, PMP Certification preferred
  • Strong project management background, proven success in delivering projects on time, on budget and in scope.
  • 4+ years’ experience in information systems development or implementation with progressively more complex responsibilities and accountabilities, with a focus on HRIS implementation and management.
  • Ability to effectively document business and technical designs
  • Strong understanding of HR and payroll processes, regulations, and best practices.
  • Successful track record of delivering on agreed-upon business objectives and performance on key metrics.

Customer Requirements

This job may require access to customer information, systems, and/or premises. As a result, this job may require customer approval for such access as an essential job function.

Core Values

  • Client Champion – Relentlessly exceed client expectations. Consistently anticipate needs to deliver valuable solutions and extraordinary outcomes.
  • Problem Solver – Smart, analytical, inquisitive, knowledge-seeker that thrives on a challenge.
  • Promise Keeper – Place high value on keeping our word and doing the right thing. Demonstrate honesty, integrity, and commitment.
  • Collaborative Integrator –Team player, unifier, relationship-oriented, win-win seeker, exemplify the concept of relationships through trust and unity.
  • Driven Intrapreneur – Exceed goals using independent creative thinking, optimism, self-confidence, and a can-do attitude.
  • Inspiring Coach – Help employees, clients and partners using knowledge, expertise, experience, and situational fluency.

Compensation and Benefits

Base salary range: $85,000-$115,000.

This position is also eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the Company's plan.

Please note that the quoted pay range for this job is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) experience, including industry or product-specific experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, and/or other applicable laws. 

We provide competitive, affordable, and diverse benefit programs that support your total health – from healthy body to healthy mind. These benefits support you and your family in all aspects of life:

  • Health and Welfare (Medical, Dental, Vision)
  • Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Life and AD&D Insurance
  • Short- and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Transportation and Parking Accounts
  • Health Savings Accounts (with company contribution)
  • Retirement Planning (401k with matching contribution)
  • Legal Benefits
  • Identity Theft Protection
  • Pet Insurance
  • Wellness Program Offerings
  • Paid Time Off, accrued per pay period based on years of service starting at 15 days annually.
  • 8 Paid Holidays per year, including 1 floating holiday.

The compensation and benefits information is accurate of the date of this posting and subject to plan eligibility. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.

The Company expects to accept applications for this position until December 10, 2026 but encourages interested applicants to apply as soon as possible. We will review this information and one of our Talent Acquisition professionals will reach out if your background aligns to the positions.
