raw.excerpt: About the Company Cytovale is a leading innovator in early sepsis detection, revolutionizing emergency care with its advanced IntelliSep technology.
raw.description:
About the Company
Cytovale is a leading innovator in early sepsis detection, revolutionizing emergency care with its advanced IntelliSep technology. This system provides rapid, actionable insights into a patient's likelihood of having or developing sepsis through a quick 8-minute blood test. IntelliSep's unique capability to assess immune dysregulation enhances the triage and treatment of sepsis, promoting patient-centered care, operational efficiencies, and provider satisfaction. Cytovale is committed to successful implementation, clinical adoption, and continual improvement of healthcare outcomes.

Position Overview:
The Customer Success Executive (CSE) plays a critical leadership role in leading enterprise implementations of IntelliSep across health systems. As the overall implementation leader and program owner, the CSE orchestrates cross-functional implementation activities, drives implementation governance, aligns customer and internal stakeholders, manages implementation risks, and maintains accountability for successful implementation outcomes.

The CSE provides implementation leadership by orchestrating cross-functional execution across Medical Affairs, Field Application Scientists, Data Science, Sales, Customer Service, and other internal functions. While accountable for overall implementation success, the CSE leverages the expertise of functional teams responsible for technical, clinical, operational, and commercial execution within their respective areas of ownership.

Key Responsibilities:
Customer Leadership & Governance
  • Develop executive working relationships with executive sponsors, laboratory leadership, clinical stakeholders, information technology teams, and operational leaders
  • Establish governance structures and communication plans that maintain alignment across customer and Cytovale stakeholders
  • Lead executive communications, governance meetings, implementation updates, risk discussions, and customer business reviews.
  • Develop an understanding of each customer's organizational priorities, success metrics, workflows, and strategic initiatives
  • Balance customer priorities with Cytovale implementation best practices

Program & Implementation Leadership
  • Develop, own and maintain the integrated implementation project plan across customer and Cytovale workstreams, ensuring alignment of milestones, critical path activities, dependencies, implementation governance, resource planning and overall program execution
  • Lead execution of the integrated implementation plan by orchestrating cross-functional workstreams across Laboratory (FAS), Clinical (Medical Affairs), Technical Service & Support, Customer Service, Information Technology, Data Science, Sales, and other internal functions
  • Lead implementation governance meetings that align customer stakeholders and Cytovale functional teams on implementation priorities, project status, resource planning, risks, dependencies, and executive decisions
  • Identify implementation risks early, develop and maintain mitigation plans, coordinate cross-functional resources, proactively remove implementation barriers, and drive timely resolution of issues
  • Guide customer stakeholders through implementation by ensuring clear understanding of upcoming project milestones, responsibilities, dependencies, key decision points and implementation expectations
  • Lead organizational readiness planning with site leadership to align implementation activities, workflow integration, operational planning, change management, and go-live readiness
  • Maintain accountability for overall implementation execution by ensuring commitments are completed, milestones are achieved, dependencies are resolved, and implementation activities remain on schedule while enabling functional teams to execute within their areas of expertise
  • Track implementation milestones through governance meetings, action items, implementation documentation, decision tracking, and milestone reviews to ensure successful execution and launch readiness

Customer Success & Outcome Achievement
  • Align customer stakeholders and internal teams around implementation objectives, adoption goals, success metrics, and long-term operational outcomes
  • Monitor implementation progress, program health, adoption metrics, implementation KPIs, and overall implementation readiness throughout the customer lifecycle, ensuring successful transition from implementation to ongoing customer sucess
  • Lead recurring customer governance meetings, KPI reviews, executive business reviews, and success planning sessions
  • Coordinate with Medical Affairs, Data Science, and other functional teams to review implementation progress, adoption trends, customer feedback, and opportunities for continuous improvement
  • Lead executive-level customer escalations by coordinating cross-functional response plans, maintaining proactive executive communication, and ensuring timely resolution of implementation issues
  • Capture customer feedback, identify implementation trends, and drive continuous improvements to implementation processes and the overall customer experience

Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in healthcare, life sciences, nursing, business, engineering or a related field.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience leading enterprise healthcare technology implementations, implementation program management, customer success, clinical operations, laboratory operations, or other customer-facing leadership roles
  • Demonstrated success implementing complex medical technologies within acute care hospitals or integrated delivery networks

raw.title: Finance & Accounting Lead - Business Central Setup, AI Agents & Latvian Tax
raw.excerpt: Location: Fully remote Company: Latvia-based startup Compensation: We operate on a startup budget.
raw.description:
Location: Fully remote
Company: Latvia-based startup
Compensation: We operate on a startup budget. Compensation will be discussed transparently during the hiring process and paid monthly in USD.
Engagement type: Full-time
Working hours: Flexible

About Us

We are a Latvia-based startup building a finance function that combines accurate accounting, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and practical AI automation.

We are looking for a finance professional who can personally manage our accounting, configure the systems supporting it and use AI agents to carry out the work more efficiently.

Job Description

You will personally perform and take ownership of our accounting and financial operations, using AI agents to support your work. Your responsibilities will cover daily bookkeeping, reconciliations, closing, financial reporting, cash planning and applicable Latvian tax reporting.

You will personally carry out the complete migration from QuickBooks to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, using AI agents to support your work. You will be responsible for all implementation tasks, from planning and data preparation through configuration, import, validation and go-live. No external implementation partners will be involved. As part of preparing and importing the data, you will review the complete accounting records for the past five years, identify gaps and errors, and reconcile the migrated data to the source records. You must be comfortable both doing the accounting and setting up the accounting system.

AI agents will assist with document processing, transaction preparation, matching, reconciliation and reporting. You will define their tasks, supervise their execution, investigate exceptions and verify their outputs. You remain responsible for the accuracy and completeness of the work.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform day-to-day bookkeeping, accounts payable and receivable, invoicing, expense accounting and bank reconciliations.
  • Complete month-end and year-end closing, balance sheet reconciliations, accruals and supporting documentation.
  • Set up, configure and maintain Business Central, including the chart of accounts, posting groups, dimensions, VAT setup, bank accounts, accounting periods and relevant financial workflows.
  • Personally execute the complete migration from QuickBooks to Business Central, including data extraction, account and tax mapping, cleansing, system configuration, trial imports, reconciliation and go-live. Review all accounting records for the past five years during migration preparation and import, investigate missing or incorrect entries, document corrections and preserve supporting documents and a traceable audit trail.
  • Prepare and manage applicable Latvian tax and statutory reporting, including VAT, corporate income tax, payroll-related obligations and VID/EDS processes.
  • Handle international customers, suppliers, contractors, foreign currencies and cross-border transactions.
  • Manage cash-flow forecasts, budgets, runway monitoring and management reporting.
  • Prepare payments and administer payroll and contractor payments within agreed approval controls.
  • Configure, instruct and supervise AI agents supporting accounting workflows; improve their performance through clear instructions, reliable source data and systematic verification.
  • Maintain traceability from original documents to accounting entries, resolve exceptions and protect confidential financial information.
  • Identify practical opportunities to reduce costs, improve financial controls and apply lawful tax efficiencies.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience personally performing the full accounting cycle for companies in one or more European countries.
  • Practical experience with accounting, taxation and statutory reporting in one or more European countries, and the ability to apply and verify Latvian requirements. Direct Latvian accounting and VID/EDS experience is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience independently setting up and configuring Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central for real accounting operations, with the ability to personally execute a complete accounting-system migration.
  • The ability to translate business requirements into appropriate accounting configuration and verify that postings, reconciliations and reports work correctly.
  • Practical experience using AI agents or AI-supported automation in finance or accounting, including supervising outputs and handling errors.
  • Strong spreadsheet and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate incomplete records and reconcile inconsistent data.
  • Independent working habits, ownership of deadlines and clear communication with the founder.
  • Professional working proficiency in English and the ability to work effectively with Latvian-language financial documents and reporting requirements.
  • A relevant accounting or finance qualification, or equivalent substantial practical experience.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building or improving the accounting function of a startup or small international business.
  • QuickBooks to Business Central migrations, Business Central implementations and comprehensive reviews and correction of historical accounting records.
  • Configuring integrations with banks, payment platforms, document systems and Microsoft 365.
  • Power Automate, Power BI, APIs or comparable tools used in practical finance workflows.
  • Accounting for digital services, subscriptions and international contractor relationships.
  • Preparing financial information for funding discussions or due diligence.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote role with direct collaboration with the founder.
  • Responsibility for both the accounting work and the systems supporting it.
  • The opportunity to shape how Business Central and AI agents work together in a startup.
  • A practical environment where reliable execution, sensible automation and cost awareness matter.

Remote Working Arrangement

You will organize your work independently, communicate progress clearly and meet agreed accounting and reporting deadlines. Financial systems and confidential information must be handled securely.

This is a full-time role with flexible working hours. You will organize your schedule around agreed accounting and reporting deadlines.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and briefly describe:

  • The European countries in which you have personally handled accounting and tax reporting, and your specific responsibilities.
  • A Business Central implementation or accounting-system migration you personally executed, including the setup, data migration and validation you performed yourself, and any experience with QuickBooks or historical accounting reviews.
  • How you have used AI agents or automation to perform accounting work and verify its accuracy.

Use anonymized examples and clearly distinguish your own work from work delivered by others.

About the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (the College)

The College is the authority mandated by the Government of Canada to regulate the practice of Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultants (RCICs) and Regulated International Student Immigration Advisors (RISIAs). Its role, authority and powers are established in the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants Act (Canada). The College sets and enforces the licensing, education and ethical standards of the profession in the public interest.

Industry

Self-Regulatory Organization (SRO)

Position

JOB TITLE: Law Clerk, Tribunals (Bilingual)

Department: Professional Conduct

Reports to: Manager, Tribunals

Language Requirement: Bilingual Imperative

Location: Canada

Classification: Full-Time

Why join us?

Do you want to be part of a team that strives to enhance and uphold Canada’s immigration and citizenship consulting profession? If you share our passion and purpose, please consider applying for the opportunity below to become part of a team that makes a difference.

How will this role support our team?

The incumbent provides legal and administrative assistance to support the operation of the Tribunal Committees. This includes monitoring and adherence to deadlines, reporting, managing and distributing case documents to prepare for hearings and/or Tribunal Committees proceedings.

Responsibilities Include (but are not limited to)

  • Provide legal and administrative assistance to support the operations of the Tribunal Committees.
  • Assist the Manager, Tribunals with tasks related to motions, case management and Tribunal Committees decisions:
  • Input case information and results into the case management database. Review case statistics and service standards monthly to identify opportunities for process improvement.
  • Respond to queries from external stakeholders (e.g., licensees, complainants, external lawyers and Committee members), related to the hearings process and other Committee work.
  • Prepare closing letters to complainants and licensees for Compensation Fund claim applications.
  • Prepare, compile, format, index, and organize the Tribunal Committees Record for Federal Court cases, Access to Information Act and Privacy Act requests (if applicable).
  • Acquire and maintain knowledge of the College’s policies, regulations, and strategies, and keep up to date with relevant developments, applicable legislation, trends and best practices.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure the College meets and delivers on its legislative compliance requirements without delay.

This role will support our team by providing

  • Knowledge of legal and administrative law concepts, principles and terminology as well as the ability to acquire knowledge of the College Act, regulations, By-laws, Code of Professional Conduct and discipline committee rules and procedures
  • Time management and organizational skills to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
  • Organizational skills and attention to keep track of deadlines and a high volume of case documents and materials
  • Interpersonal and stakeholder relationship management skills to interact professionally and respectfully with stakeholders (Tribunal participants, licensees, counsel, witnesses etc.)
  • Written and verbal communication skills to prepare legal documentation (e.g., draft orders, decision letters), and website content to comply with the College’s publication obligations and communicate with stakeholders about issues related to cases, as required
  • Attention to detail to ensure accuracy and completeness of documents and materials
  • Tact and discretion to work on confidential and sensitive matters

Required Education and Experience

  • College Diploma in law (Legal Assistant, Law Clerk or Paralegal)
  • 3-5 years of experience working as a law clerk in a law firm, government office or professional regulator, including experience working with administrative tribunals or courts
  • Bilingual in English and French
  • Knowledge of office/administrative software, online storage and case management systems

What We Offer

  • The College hires and onboards 100% remotely
  • The opportunity to protect the public interest within the immigration and citizenship sector
  • A culture of transparency, where team members are involved in important conversations
  • Full health benefits from day one for you and your family
  • Access to the Employee and Family Assistance program
  • RRSP match

How to Apply

Click here to upload your resume and brief cover letter indicating why you feel you are fit for this role.

Your personal information is collected and used by the College when you apply for employment with the College. Please read the College’s Privacy Notice for more information regarding its privacy practices.

The College is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from persons legally entitled to work in Canada, who represent the diversity of our nation, and whose qualifications meet the skills and experiences we seek. We are committed to providing equal opportunities to all candidates and to meeting the needs of people with disabilities. Should you be contacted regarding an employment opportunity and require an accommodation for a disability, we will be pleased to work with you to identify how we can best support you through this process.

The successful candidate will be required to undergo a criminal background check.

While we thank all applicants for their interest, only those identified for further consideration will be contacted.

Ce poste est affiché en français sur notre site Web à .

À propos du Collège des consultants en immigration et en citoyenneté (le Collège)

Le Collège est l’autorité mandatée par le gouvernement du Canada pour réglementer la pratique des consultants réglementés en immigration canadienne (CRIC) et des conseillers réglementés en immigration pour étudiants étrangers (CRIEE). Son rôle et ses pouvoirs sont établis dans la Loi sur le Collège des consultants en immigration et en citoyenneté (Canada). Le Collège établit les normes de la profession en matière de délivrance de permis, de formation et d’éthique et veille à leur application dans l’intérêt public.

Secteur

Organisme d’autoréglementation (OAR)

Poste

TITRE DU POSTE : Assistant ou assistante juridique, tribunaux (bilingue)

Service : Conduite professionnelle

Supérieur immédiat : Gestionnaire, tribunaux

Exigences linguistiques : Bilinguisme essentiel

Lieu : Canada

Classification : Temps plein

Pourquoi vous joindre à nous?

Souhaitez-vous faire partie d’une équipe qui a à cœur de renforcer et de soutenir la profession de consultant en immigration et en citoyenneté? Si vous partagez notre passion et notre objectif, posez votre candidature ci-dessous pour vous joindre à une équipe qui apporte une contribution importante.

De quelle façon ce rôle soutiendra-t-il notre équipe?

Le ou la titulaire du poste fournit de l’assistance juridique et administrative afin de soutenir le fonctionnement des comités du Tribunal. Cela comprend la surveillance et le respect des échéanciers, l’établissement de rapports, la gestion et la distribution de dossiers liés aux cas aux fins de préparation aux audiences ou aux procédures des comités du Tribunal.

Les responsabilités comprennent les éléments suivants (sans toutefois s’y limiter) :

  • Fournir une aide juridique et administrative afin de soutenir le fonctionnement des comités du Tribunal.
  • Aider la gestionnaire, tribunaux, avec des tâches liées aux requêtes, à la gestion des dossiers et aux décisions des comités du Tribunal.
  • Saisir les renseignements sur les dossiers et les résultats dans la base de données de gestion des dossiers. Passer en revue les statistiques sur les dossiers et les normes de service chaque mois pour relever les possibilités d’amélioration du processus.
  • Répondre aux demandes de renseignements des parties prenantes externes (p. ex. titulaires de permis, plaignants, avocats externes et membres du comité) liés au processus d’audience et aux autres travaux du Comité.
  • Préparer des lettres de clôture à l’intention des plaignants et des titulaires de permis pour les demandes de réclamation auprès du fonds d’indemnisation.
  • Préparer, compiler, formater, indexer et organiser les dossiers des comités du Tribunal pour les dossiers de la Cour fédérale, ainsi que les demandes en vertu de la Loi sur l’accès à l’information et de la Loi sur la protection des renseignements personnels (s’il y a lieu).
  • Acquérir et maintenir des connaissances concernant les politiques, les règlements et les stratégies du Collège, et se tenir à jour des développements récents, des dispositions législatives applicables, des tendances et des pratiques exemplaires.
  • Collaborer avec les parties prenantes internes pour s’assurer que le Collège respecte ses obligations en matière de conformité législative et les remplit sans délai.

Ce rôle soutiendra notre équipe en y apportant les éléments suivants :

  • Connaissance des concepts, des principes et de la terminologie juridiques dans le contexte des lois et du droit administratif, et capacité à acquérir des connaissances sur la Loi sur le Collège, les règlements, les règlements administratifs, le Code de déontologie ainsi que les règles et les procédures du Comité de discipline.
  • Aptitudes pour la gestion du temps et sens de l’organisation permettant de gérer des priorités et des échéances concurrentes.
  • Sens de l’organisation et attention soutenue pour assurer le suivi des échéanciers et d’un volume élevé de documents et de dossiers.
  • Habiletés interpersonnelles et aptitudes pour la gestion des relations avec les parties prenantes permettant d’interagir avec ces dernières de manière professionnelle et respectueuse (titulaires de permis, conseillers juridiques, témoins, etc.)
  • Aptitudes pour la communication écrite et verbale en vue de préparer les documents juridiques (p. ex. projets d’ordonnance, lettres de décision) et le contenu du site Web afin de se conformer aux obligations du Collège en matière de publication et de s’entretenir avec les parties prenantes au sujet de questions liées aux dossiers, au besoin.
  • Souci du détail permettant de veiller à l’exactitude et à l’exhaustivité des documents.
  • Délicatesse et discrétion afin de travailler sur des affaires confidentielles et de nature sensible.

Formation et expérience requises

  • Diplôme d’études collégiales en droit (p. ex. assistant juridique, assistant judiciaire ou parajuriste).
  • Trois à cinq années d’expérience à titre d’assistant ou assistante juridique dans un cabinet d’avocats, un bureau du gouvernement ou au sein d’un organisme de réglementation, notamment auprès des cours ou tribunaux administratifs.
  • Bilinguisme en français et en anglais.
  • Connaissance des logiciels de bureau et administratifs ainsi que des systèmes de stockage en ligne et de gestion des dossiers.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Le processus d’embauche et d’accueil du Collège se fait entièrement à distance
  • L’occasion de protéger l’intérêt public relativement à l’immigration et la citoyenneté
  • Une culture de transparence où les membres de l’équipe participent aux conversations importantes
  • Prestations-maladie complètes dès le premier jour, pour vous et votre famille
  • Accès au programme d’aide aux employés et à leur famille
  • Contribution équivalente de l’employeur au REER

Pour postuler

Cliquez ici pour téléverser votre curriculum vitæ et une courte lettre de présentation indiquant les raisons pour lesquelles vous estimez être à même d’assumer ce rôle.

Vos renseignements personnels sont recueillis et utilisés par le Collège lorsque vous postulez pour un emploi auprès du Collège. Veuillez lire l’avis de confidentialité du Collège pour plus de renseignements à propos de ses pratiques relatives à la protection de la vie privée.

Le Collège est un employeur qui souscrit au principe de l’égalité d’accès à l’emploi. Nous acceptons les candidatures des personnes légalement autorisées à travailler au Canada, qui représentent la diversité de notre pays, et dont les qualifications satisfont aux compétences et expériences que nous recherchons. Nous sommes résolus à offrir des chances égales à tous les candidats et à respecter les besoins des personnes ayant un handicap. Si nous communiquons avec vous au sujet d’une occasion d’emploi et que vous avez besoin d’une mesure d’adaptation en raison d’un handicap, nous nous ferons un plaisir de collaborer avec vous pour déterminer comment vous soutenir le mieux possible dans le cadre de ce processus.

La personne choisie devra se soumettre à la vérification de son casier judiciaire.

Nous remercions tous les candidats de leur intérêt. Toutefois, nous ne communiquerons qu’avec les candidats présélectionnés.

Location: Orlando, Florida (Remote)
Title: Chemist/Data Validator II
Schedule (FT/PT): Regular Full Time
Travel Required: Yes (0-25%)

North Wind Site Services is comprised of scientists and technical experts focused on providing program management and environmental remediation services including investigation and characterization, environmental restoration, remedial action, regulatory public involvement services, environmental compliance, logistics, and records and facility management.


POSITION PURPOSE:
The purpose of this position is to support projects in all aspects of analytical data collection and reporting as well as the review of information generated by subcontract analytical laboratories to ensure that environmental analytical data were generated in accordance with EPA, DOE and DOD guidelines, project plans, and industry standard methods to satisfy contract requirements.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Validate analytical chemistry data following national standards and company procedures, including project-specific criteria.
  • Prepare comprehensive written data validation reports and checklists with findings, including application of relevant data qualifications to affected data sets.
  • Quickly and accurately operate databases and spreadsheets.
  • Monitor individual workloads for incoming client validation requests and manage backlog to achieve due dates.
  • Manage time spent and other performance metrics as requested by supervisor.
  • Communicate in timely and effective manner with peers and supervisors.
  • Write and review Quality Assurance Project Plans (QAPPs) with a primary focus on analytical and laboratory-related worksheets.
  • Evaluate project data quality objectives and ensure selected laboratories meet those objectives, such as certification and reporting limits.
  • Evaluate analytical data to ensure overall project data quality objectives have been met as required by the client and as stated in the Quality Assurance Project Plan.
  • Consult with project team, including clients, on data quality and usability.
  • Prepare technical report sections describing precision, accuracy, representativeness, comparability, sensitivity and overall data usability.
  • Assist project managers with procuring appropriate analytical laboratory services.
  • Serve as the point of contact for laboratory coordination, including ordering bottle kits, communicating field schedules, and conveying issues or questions to and from the field team.
  • Track sample shipments during field events to ensure samples are received and logged in correctly.
  • Review reported data deliverables for accuracy and request corrections from lab.
  • Organize large amounts of data for multiple projects.
  • Update multiple project teams on status of sample data.
  • Write and review reports for federal clients based on sampling activities and results.
  • Be the client interface for large external contracts.
  • Provide quotes and proposal text for data validation, data management, sampling, and laboratory analysis.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

Education and Experience:

  • A minimum of a four-year college degree in Chemistry or equivalent area of expertise (Biology, Environmental Science, etc.)
  • A minimum of 3 to 5 years’ experience working in an environmental analytical laboratory or working as a part of a Contractor project management team of which must be directly related to environmental investigations and/or remedial actions (i.e., not primarily employed at a laboratory).
  • Must have thorough knowledge of environmental analytical chemistry methodologies as described in EPA SW-846 and QC procedures as applicable to environmental analytical chemistry
  • Knowledge of the principles and standards of scientific study, field investigation, sampling, experimentation, quality assurance of chemical measurements, and documentation.

Skills and Abilities:

  • Ability to describe technical information with clear and concise language to produce error-free written reports.
  • Ability to follow technical guidance and perform basic mathematical calculations.
  • Ability to handle multiple projects and deadlines concurrently, including prompt communication of potential delays.
  • Ability to understand analytical procedures, laboratory operations and raw data reporting.
  • Ability to work independently under general supervision, as well as part of a team.
  • Ability to work remotely.
  • Willingness to ask questions to the team.
  • Basic proficiency with business writing, office automation and communication software, technology, and tools.
  • Ability to work schedules conducive to project-specific requirements that may extend beyond the typical workweek.
  • Demonstrates excellent cross-functional team collaboration skills.
  • Consistently displays a positive/respectful attitude toward supervisors and peers.
  • Shares knowledge readily and participate in team communication and activities.
  • Works in a highly organized manner and with strong attention to detail.
  • Demonstrates integrity and a commitment to quality.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Laboratory experience including knowledge of analytical methods and SOPs and experience operating analytical instruments.
  • Previous Experience reviewing analytical reports to evaluate quality and usability per EPA, DoD, or DoE guidance.
  • Familiarity with the DoD/DoE QSM a plus.
  • Experience with federal databases, such as FUDSChem, NIRIS, or ERPIMS is beneficial.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Position is primarily sedentary in nature, but may involve walking or standing for brief periods of time. The work may involve exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally or a negligible amount of force frequently to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects, including the human body. This role requires the ability to work extensively utilizing a computer screen and keyboard.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT:

Works mainly in typical office environment. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet.

  • Modellierung und Dokumentation der Zielprozesse in Systemen und Tools zur Sicherstellung skalierbarer Abläufe
Operative Nähe als Hebel für Verbesserung
  • Gezielte Mitarbeit in ausgewählten Projekten zur Analyse realer Durchlaufzeiten, Engpässe und Qualitätsabweichungen
  • Identifikation von Standardisierungs- und Automatisierungspotenzialen
  • Ableitung und Umsetzung konkreter Verbesserungsmaßnahmen auf Basis operativer Erfahrung
Schnittstellen- & Governance-Management
  • Strukturierung der Zusammenarbeit zwischen Sales, Project Management, Project Support und Customer Success
  • Definition klarer Übergaben und interner SLAs
  • Reduktion von Reibungsverlusten und Doppelarbeit
  • Aufbau transparenter Entscheidungs- und Dokumentationsstrukturen
KPI-System & Transparenz
  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung eines KPI-Frameworks zur datenbasierten Steuerung (u. a. Durchlaufzeiten, Quality-Gate-Performance, SLA-Compliance, Forecast-Qualität)
  • Etablierung strukturierter Weekly- und Monthly-Reviews
  • Verbesserung von Planbarkeit und Transparenz für nachhaltiges Wachstum
Tooling, Automatisierung & Skalierung
  • Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung der operativen Systemlandschaft (CRM, Projektmanagement, Billing etc.)
  • Reduktion manueller Prozesse und Einführung neuer Standards
  • Aufbau einer skalierbaren Infrastruktur zur Unterstützung weiteren Unternehmenswachstums und erhöhter Stakeholder-Transparenz

dein profil

Das passt besonders gut zu dir, wenn du …

  • Organisationen nicht nur managst, sondern strukturell weiterentwickelst
  • komplexe Abläufe schnell durchdringst und systemisch verbesserst
  • Verantwortung für Integration und Umsetzung übernimmst – nicht nur für Konzepte
  • auch ohne disziplinarische Führung Wirkung entfaltest und Veränderungen vorantreibst
  • sowohl mit Management als auch mit operativen Teams auf Augenhöhe arbeitest
Fachlich bringst du idealerweise mit …
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Aufbau oder in der Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen in wachsenden Organisationen
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit KPI-Systemen, Performance-Steuerung oder operativer Governance
  • Praxis im Schnittstellenmanagement zwischen mehreren Teams oder Fachbereichen
  • Erfahrung im Projekt- oder Prozessmanagement – idealerweise im Energiesektor, bei Infrastrukturprojekten oder in einem stark regulierten Umfeld
  • Verständnis für betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und Skalierungslogiken
  • Erfahrung im Arbeiten mit operativen Tools (z. B. CRM-, Projektmanagement- oder BI-Systeme; idealerweise HubSpot, G-Suite oder Notion)
Persönlich überzeugst du durch...
  • Strukturstärke gepaart mit Umsetzungsdrang
  • Klarheit in Kommunikation und Entscheidungsfähigkeit
  • analytische Tiefe und gleichzeitig pragmatische Lösungsorientierung
  • hohe Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungswillen
  • die Fähigkeit, Teams mitzunehmen und Vertrauen aufzubauen
Warum diese Rolle zentral ist...
  • Sie schafft Skalierbarkeit
  • Sie reduziert operative Komplexität
  • Sie erhöht Geschwindigkeit und Qualität
  • Sie sorgt für saubere Übergänge entlang der Wertschöpfung
  • Sie trägt so nachhaltig zum Unternehmenserfolg bei

warum wir?

  • Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung: Ob in Stuttgart, Hamburg, Berlin oder fully remote – arbeite dort, wo Du am produktivsten bist. Teilzeit, Vollzeit – Du entscheidest!
  • Gemeinschaft & Mobilität: Wir fördern nachhaltige Mobilität mit einem Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket – und stärken das Miteinander durch regelmäßige departmentübergreifende Events an unseren Standorten, bei denen das ganze Team zusammenkommt.
  • Gestaltungsfreiraum: Wir sind ein motiviertes Start-up-Team ohne Hierarchieebenen. Bei uns kannst Du Deine Ideen umsetzen und den Kurs aktiv mitbestimmen.
  • Wachstumschancen: Deine persönliche und berufliche Weiterentwicklung ist uns wichtig – wir bieten Dir vielfältige Möglichkeiten, Dich in neue Richtungen zu entwickeln und unterstützen Dich zusätzlich mit einer bezuschussten betrieblichen Altersvorsorge für Deine langfristige finanzielle Sicherheit.
  • Sinnstiftende Aufgabe: Du arbeitest nicht nur für einen Job, sondern für eine Mission: die Energiewende. In fünf Jahren kannst Du stolz sagen, dass Du Teil davon warst!
  • Schnelle Lernkurve und Eigenverantwortung: Von Tag 1 an bist Du mitten im Geschehen. Wir setzen auf Dich und Deine Fähigkeiten und unterstützen Dich in Deiner Entwicklung.
  • Innovatives Umfeld: Wenn Du die Energie eines agilen Teams liebst und gerne eigenverantwortlich arbeitest, bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

raw.title: Director of eCommerce & Growth
raw.excerpt: Build the DTC growth engine for Protein Candy and Pulp & Press We're looking for the person who turns our brands into a growth engine online: our Shopify sites, Amazon, TikTok Shop, and whatever channel comes next.
raw.description:
Build the DTC growth engine for Protein Candy and Pulp & Press

We're looking for the person who turns our brands into a growth engine online: our Shopify sites, Amazon, TikTok Shop, and whatever channel comes next. You'll set the DTC strategy, own the P&L, and decide where the next dollar of growth comes from.

Protein Candy is redefining the $40B candy category with functional, better-for-you products. Since launching in mid-2024, we've grown into 4,000+ retail doors, including Kroger, Walmart Canada, and Circle K, with thousands more coming online by the end of the year.

Pulp & Press is a legacy cold-pressed juice brand being reinvented. You'll build its direct and marketplace business alongside Protein Candy.

The Role

This is a commercial leadership role with an operator's hands. You'll own DTC revenue and the P&L for both brands, run our Shopify sites and marketplace business, steer our agency partners, and build the team as we scale.

As part of our Marketing team, you'll work closely with our leadership team and with partners across retail, operations, lifecycle, and social. If you can read a P&L and a conversion funnel with equal ease, love finding growth others miss, and know when to say no to a shiny new channel, this is your role.

What You'll Own

1. Set and lead the DTC channel strategy

  • Own the DTC strategy and roadmap across eCommerce, marketplaces, social shopping, and new channels for both brands
  • Decide the channel mix and where to invest for each brand, based on performance and growth expectations. Decide how channels work together and where the next dollar of growth comes from
  • Judge whether new marketplaces are worth it. Build the business case as they come up, and know when to say no
  • Grow and lead the DTC team as we scale

2. Drive growth marketing and experimentation

  • Own acquisition and retention strategy across paid media, SEO, and CRO, working alongside our Lifecycle marketer who owns Klaviyo and customer lifetime value
  • Test new ad channels, formats, and audiences (TikTok, YouTube, CTV, affiliate, retail media, and whatever is next) and scale what works
  • Use DTC as the launchpad for new products, flavours, and bundles, and feed what you learn back into innovation

3. Own the Shopify sites

  • Own both brand sites end to end: eCommerce, UX, performance, MarTech, and analytics
  • Run CRO and A/B testing across the funnel, from landing page to checkout, on an always-on testing calendar
  • Keep the tech stack and sites lean and working

4. Build our marketplace business

  • Own Amazon (US and Canada) for both brands: listings, A+ content, storefronts, ads, reviews, account health, and FBA inbound
  • Own TikTok Shop as a sales channel: setup, listings, affiliate commission structure, Shop ads, and GMV. Our Social team owns content and creators
  • Own expansion into new marketplaces
  • Protect our brand presence online, including pricing strategy and unauthorized resellers

5. Own DTC revenue, P&L, and reporting

  • Own DTC revenue targets by brand and channel, driven by traffic, conversion, and AOV
  • Manage the DTC P&L through contribution margin: media, agency fees, promotions, marketplace fees, and fulfillment
  • Own pricing, promotions, and the offer calendar (launches, BFCM, bundles), aligned with Retail to avoid channel conflict
  • Own performance data strategy: set marketing KPIs and goals, make sure data capture and attribution are right, and run weekly and monthly reports and dashboards

6. Manage agency partnerships

  • Set clear strategy, scopes, KPIs, and fees for paid media, marketplace, and site agency partners
  • Run weekly performance check-ins and quarterly business reviews, and hold partners accountable
  • Recommend what to bring in-house and which partners we need as we scale

7. Partner across the business

  • Work with Logistics, Supply Chain, Customer Care, and Operations on channel readiness, inventory availability, service levels, and key initiatives
  • Forecast DTC and FBA demand with Ops to prevent stockouts and storage fees
  • Brief Social and Design on creative that converts, and align with Retail on pricing and launch timing

You're the Right Fit If You:

  • Have 7+ years in eCommerce or DTC growth for a consumer brand, with proven revenue growth and P&L ownership down to contribution margin
  • Have managed agencies and held them to clear scopes, KPIs, and fees
  • Know Shopify inside out, including UX, CRO, A/B testing, and site performance
  • Have hands-on Amazon experience, ideally in both the US and Canada: listings, A+ content, ads, account health, and FBA
  • Know TikTok Shop and social shopping, or are excited to build them
  • Have run paid media, SEO, or affiliate programs and tested new channels like TikTok, YouTube, CTV, and retail media
  • Are comfortable with attribution, dashboards, and making decisions from the data
  • Can build a business case for a new channel and say no when the numbers do not work
  • Forecast demand with Ops and understand inventory, stockouts, and FBA storage fees
  • Work well across retail, ops, supply chain, creative, and customer care, and can lead a growing team
  • Are hands-on, fast, and resourceful. You find a way to get it done, even on short notice

Nice to Haves

  • Background in CPG, food, beverage, snacks, or wellness brands
  • Experience managing pricing and unauthorized resellers
  • Experience launching new products through DTC alongside a retail business
  • Familiarity with Klaviyo and common Shopify MarTech tools
  • Based in the GTA or Southwestern Ontario

Our Values

  • Discipline – Show up ready to perform, even when it's hard. Accountable, punctual, prepared, dependable—no excuses.
  • Results Oriented – Impact over activity and ego. Every hour and dollar should create measurable value.
  • Innovation – Everyone innovates with curiosity—in every role. We look for smarter, faster, better ways to win.
  • Value Others – We genuinely respect our team, our customers, and our community. We participate, contribute, and support each other. We have fun.
  • Excellence – We hold ourselves to a higher standard—in quality, adaptability, effort, and attitude. Being "all-in" is the minimum.

Diversity & Inclusion

We welcome applications from all qualified individuals and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team. If you require accommodations during recruitment, let us know when you apply.

About Oasis Solutions

Oasis Solutions is your local NetSuite, Sage 100 and Sage Intacct partner providing business management software solutions to small and mid-sized businesses throughout America. We have offices located in Louisville and Lexington, KY, TN, and NC, and serve clients throughout the United States.

Oasis offers the leading software solutions (on-premise and cloud) for accounting and business management (ERP), human resources, payroll, and time & attendance, CRM (Customer Relationship Management), Job Management, Document Management, Warehouse management, and more.

Oasis Solutions is seeking a driven, consultative Account Executive to help organizations improve operational performance, financial visibility, and scalability through Sage Intacct solutions. This is not a transactional software sales role. We are looking for a business-minded hunter who can prospect aggressively, communicate confidently with executives, and drive complex opportunities through a disciplined sales process.

Required Experience & Capabilities

  • 5+ years of complex B2B sales experience preferred
  • 3+ Experience selling technology, SaaS, ERP, financial, or advisory solutions
  • Demonstrated success acquiring new logos
  • Executive communication and presentation capability
  • Strong financial and operational business acumen
  • Mental toughness and emotional endurance
  • Ability to prospect consistently without external pressure
  • Strong strategic thinking and organizational discipline
  • Ability to communicate business value—not just product features

This Role Is For Someone Who

  • Prefers building new business over maintaining existing accounts
  • Enjoys executive-level business conversations
  • Can diagnose operational inefficiencies and business challenges
  • Thrives in long-cycle consultative sales environments
  • Operates with high accountability and competitive intensity
  • Understands that consistent prospecting drives long-term success
  • Can balance urgency with professionalism

Core Responsibilities

  • Generate new business opportunities through strategic prospecting
  • Lead executive discovery and assessment conversations
  • Navigate complex buying committees and decision structures
  • Develop and manage a high-value opportunity pipeline
  • Position ROI and business impact effectively
  • Collaborate internally to build solutions and proposals
  • Maintain disciplined forecasting and CRM management

Compensation & Environment

· Expected Year 1 earnings: $120K–$180K

· Expected Year 2+ earnings: $200K+

  • Opportunity to sell best-in-class ERP solutions
  • Culture of mutual respect, collaboration, and high standards
  • Executive-level expectations with strong support infrastructure

raw.title: Brand Marketing Manager
raw.excerpt: Managing modern technology has become increasingly complex.
raw.description:
Managing modern technology has become increasingly complex. As organizations scale across clouds, endpoints, and hybrid environments, IT operations and cybersecurity often remain fragmented, creating gaps in visibility, slowing response times, and increasing risk.

Logically closes that gap.

We unify IT operations and cybersecurity into a single, accountable operating model that reduces risk, accelerates response, and strengthens resilience across the systems businesses depend on. With shared visibility, integrated workflows, and clear ownership, organizations gain greater control, fewer blind spots, and more confidence in their technology.

Our approach is cyber-first by design, embedding protection into every layer, from end user to edge to cloud. By combining AI-assisted monitoring with human-led expertise, we deliver faster insight, smarter decisions, and more effective outcomes without the complexity of siloed tools.

For more than 20 years, Logically has partnered with mid-market and enterprise organizations to simplify complexity, reduce risk, and improve resilience, acting as a true extension of their teams with clear accountability and measurable outcomes.

Logically. Cyber-First. Future-Ready.

Why Work for Us

  • A culture built on doing the right thing
  • Work at the forefront of cybersecurity and emerging technologies
  • Collaborative, growth-oriented environment
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Opportunities for professional development and advancement
  • Make a real impact by helping organizations reduce risk and build resilience

Job Summary:

As a resourceful, creative, and strategic Brand Marketing Manager you will drive brand growth and engagement across our target markets. Reporting to the CMO, this role is ideal for someone with 3–5 years of hands-on brand and social marketing experience who thrives in a fast-paced environment, can juggle multiple priorities with ease, and knows how to balance data-driven decision-making with creative storytelling.

You’ll own the voice, visual identity, and digital presence of Logically’s brand. From shaping our positioning to developing high-impact content and campaigns, you’ll play a central role in strengthening Logically’s reputation, driving audience engagement, and cultivating a loyal, informed community.

Job Duties & Responsibilities:

Brand Development & Identity

  • Maintain and optimize Logically’s brand presence across websites, social media, and collateral.
  • Refine brand positioning and visual identity systems (logos, colors, typography, imagery).
  • Serve as the brand champion across the organization, ensuring consistency and quality in all communications.
  • Strategically create a digital presence that embodies Logically’s core values, expertise, and long-term vision.

Social Media Marketing

  • Lead paid social campaigns (LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, etc.) and develop an organic social strategy to grow audience reach and engagement.
  • Build and execute content calendars aligned to strategic initiatives, campaigns, and industry trends.
  • Oversee reputation management across digital channels — responding to comments, direct messages, and reviews to maintain brand integrity, trust, and credibility.
  • Track and report on performance metrics such as engagement rates, reach, impressions, and CTRs, using insights to optimize content and strategy.

Creative Campaigns & Content Production

  • Collaborate with internal teams, agencies, and designers to produce multimedia content — videos, photography, graphics, blogs, and social posts — that bring Logically’s story to life.
  • Strategically capture and produce real-time content during company events, webinars, and in-office activities to highlight company culture, leadership, and innovation.
  • Repurpose and optimize existing content to align with emerging trends, ensuring consistent posting and alignment with audience interests.
  • Oversee the development and production of creative assets, ensuring timely delivery within existing project workflows.

Reputation & Brand Authority

  • Proactively monitor and manage brand reputation, addressing feedback, inquiries, and client reviews with professionalism and transparency.
  • Analyze and adapt social and industry trends to align with Logically’s brand voice and audience interests, leveraging data insights to drive engagement and relevance.
  • Cultivate relationships with industry influencers, partners, and thought leaders to amplify brand visibility and trust.
  • Engage with professional communities such as ISC², GTIA, and other IT and cybersecurity industry groups to expand Logically’s presence and strengthen brand authority.

Analytics & Optimization

  • Use analytics tools to evaluate campaign effectiveness and guide ongoing strategy refinement.
  • Collaborate with the Growth Marketing and RevOps teams to align brand and performance metrics with broader marketing objectives.
  • Regularly share insights and recommendations with leadership to inform future brand and content strategies.

Agency & Vendor Management

  • Manage relationships with creative agencies, media partners, and freelancers, ensuring deliverables are on brand, on time, and on budget.
  • Oversee creative quality from concept through execution, maintaining consistent alignment with Logically’s standards for excellence.

Qualifications:

  • 3–5 years of experience in brand marketing or social media marketing, ideally within B2B technology, SaaS, or IT/cybersecurity.
  • Proven expertise in social media strategy and execution across paid and organic channels.
  • Strong understanding of brand positioning, visual identity, and creative storytelling.
  • Experience managing agencies, vendors, and creative partners to deliver impactful campaigns.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Analytical mindset with a passion for data-driven optimization and performance tracking.
  • Creative, collaborative, and proactive — you take initiative and bring ideas to life.
  • Familiarity or passion for leveraging AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Jasper, or Canva AI) to enhance ideation, content creation, and workflow efficiency.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to adapt tone and voice for different audiences and platforms.
  • Proficiency with tools such as HubSpot, Google Analytics, and Canva.

What Success Looks Like

  • A cohesive and differentiated Logically brand identity consistently reflected across all channels.
  • Strong growth in brand engagement, social reach, and community interaction.
  • Increased brand recognition and thought leadership within the IT and cybersecurity industries.
  • A vibrant, authentic digital presence that connects with customers and prospects on a human level.

raw.description:
Quiénes somos

En Tessera acompañamos a compañías en su crecimiento desde una visión integral de personas, negocio y estructura. Trabajamos como partners en la construcción de equipos y en la toma de decisiones importantes, combinando talento y estrategia para profesionalizar procesos críticos allí donde más impacto se genera.

Creemos en construir better decisions, together. Por eso trabajamos de forma cercana tanto con compañías como con profesionales, conectando personas, equipos y proyectos en momentos críticos de crecimiento.

Somos una consultora boutique con base en Madrid. Trabajamos cerca, con criterio y con honestidad. Nada de procesos en cadena ni promesas inflables.

El reto

Como Sales Development Representative freelance, te encargarás de:

Prospección y captación de empresas que necesiten servicios de selección. Contacto con decision makers: CEO, COO, Head of People, founders. Detección de necesidades reales de talento y posicionamiento de Tessera como partner. Demo y presentación de nuestra propuesta de valor. Cierre del primer proceso de selección con el cliente. Handover limpio al equipo de delivery de Tessera.

Modelo de comisiones

  • Trabajo 100% a éxito. Cobras un porcentaje sobre la facturación que generes para Tessera, en escala progresiva sobre el total del mes. Sin tope.
  • Hasta 5.000€ facturados al mes: 30% de comisión. A partir de 5.000€: 35% de comisión sobre el tramo que supera esos 5.000€.
  • Ejemplo con 8.000€ facturados en el mes: 5.000€ × 30% = 1.500€ 3.000€ × 35% = 1.050€ Comisión total: 2.550€
  • Ejemplo con 15.000€ facturados en el mes: 5.000€ × 30% = 1.500€ 10.000€ × 35% = 3.500€ Comisión total: 5.000€

Mientras gestiones activamente al cliente (presentas el proceso, haces de puente, mantienes la relación), cobras la escala completa. Si el cliente vuelve directamente a Tessera en futuros procesos sin que tú intervengas, recibes un 10% sobre esa facturación recurrente mientras sigas activo como colaborador.

Requisitos

Experiencia en ventas B2B, idealmente servicios profesionales, RRHH, SaaS o consultoría. Mentalidad hunter: te mueve abrir mercado, no gestionar lo que ya está. Autonomía real y orientación a resultados. Capacidad de hablar de tú a tú con founders y C-levels. Cero alergia a un CRM y a la disciplina de pipeline.

Será un plus si

Ya tienes red en founders, decision makers de RRHH o C-levels de PYMEs y scale-ups. Has vendido antes servicios de selección, headhunting o consultoría de personas. Conoces el mercado madrileño y nacional de talento.

Qué ofrecemos

Marca diferencial en un mercado saturado de consultoras genéricas Acceso a nuestra metodología, materiales de venta y casos de éxito Soporte directo del equipo fundador y del Head of Recruitment Trabajo 100% remoto y autónomo, tú gestionas tu agenda Posibilidad real de evolucionar a un rol interno si hay encaje Comisiones sin tope, escalado progresivo y revenue share sobre facturación recurrente

Importante

Esto no es para todo el mundo. Si buscas estabilidad y un fijo a fin de mes, este rol no es el tuyo. Si quieres construir tu propia cartera de clientes, generar ingresos en función de tu rendimiento y trabajar con una boutique con criterio, hablamos.

Igualdad de oportunidades

En Tessera defendemos la igualdad de oportunidades y la diversidad como parte fundamental de nuestra cultura. Valoramos a las personas por su talento, experiencia y potencial, independientemente de su género, edad, origen, orientación sexual, identidad de género, religión, discapacidad o cualquier otra condición personal. Nos comprometemos a ofrecer un proceso de selección justo, transparente y accesible, y a crear un entorno de trabajo respetuoso e inclusivo.

Job title: Area Business Manager, Pulmonology, Nashville, TN

  • Location: Remote, US

About the Job:

Sanofi focuses on developing specialty treatments for debilitating diseases that are often difficult to diagnose and treat, providing hope to patients and their families. Sanofi has pioneered the development and delivery of transformative therapies for patients affected by rare and debilitating diseases for over 30 years. We accomplish our goals through world-class research, collaboration with the global patient community, and with the compassion and commitment of our employees.  With a focus on rare diseases, oncology, immunology, and multiple sclerosis, we are dedicated to making a positive impact on the lives of the patients and families we serve. 


Sanofi’s portfolio of transformative therapies, which are marketed in countries around the world, represent groundbreaking and life-saving advances in medicine. At Sanofi, we are committed to the growth of our people, connected in purpose by career, life, and health.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi:

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.


Job Description:

The Area Business Manager (ABM) is responsible for engaging Pulmonologists and other key customers within an assigned geography and presenting clinically focused selling messages to create and grow revenue and consistently deliver product goals related to the asthma indication. The ABM will demonstrate initiative, drive, and independence and take ownership of meeting and exceeding individual business goals. This will be accomplished by driving performance and delivering results in a compliant manner with a high degree of integrity, strictly following all Sanofi US policies and in compliance with all policies and procedures governing the promotion of pharmaceutical/biological products in the US.


Main Responsibilities:

  • Engage Pulmonary customers within assigned geographical territory and deliver clinically focused messages to introduce, launch, grow brand-share and revenue and to consistently deliver on product goals for the asthma indication
  • Collaborate and coordinate with other key field-based stakeholders such as Regeneron Sales Professional counterparts, Medical Science Liaisons, Field Reimbursement and Market Access teammates, Thought Leader Liaisons, and others in their territory to proactively address customer needs, identify market dynamics and trends, develop strategies which support brand and corporate objectives, and ensure optimal account success within their assigned geography
  • Develop strong working relationships with pulmonary experts in assigned geography as well as biologic coordinators, office staff, and other important health care personnel and key patient advocacy support groups as directed
  • Drive results by identifying key opportunities and developing strategic business plans to generate product utilization and grow territory business
  • Plan, organize, and execute local promotional speaker programs and activities
  • Maximize the budget allocated to the geographic territory to support the execution of strategies and tactics and generate/grow the business
  • Participate and help lead initiatives to support sales success as assigned (e.g., participate in industry-related congresses, local and regional meetings, and medical conferences)
  • Own business opportunities within the respective geographic area, which includes coordination and calling upon large group practices and other key targets to drive overall product results
  • Establish relationships with thought leaders in assigned territory
  • Primary objective is to drive industry-leading customer value

About You:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four-year college or university
  • 3+ years of pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device sales experience
  • Demonstrated ability to learn and apply technical and scientific product-related information
  • Ability to travel to meetings/training/programs as necessary - additional travel may be required within the assigned territory
  • Proven success and positive track record of consistent sales performance in complex markets with diverse customer segments operating with a high degree of integrity within compliance guidelines
  • Ability to operate as a “team player” in cooperation with collaboration partners and internal colleagues to reach common goals
  • Valid Driver’s License

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2 years selling sub-cutaneous self-injectable (or office administered IV) biologics.
  • 2 years of selling experience in pulmonary disease or other immunology disorders such as Atopic Dermatitis, Psoriasis, Multiple Sclerosis, Crohn’s disease, or Ulcerative Colitis strongly preferred
  • 2 years of selling experience calling on Pulmonologists
  • Co-promotion experience preferred
  • Demonstrate advanced clinically based selling skills
  • Results oriented with a proven track record of success with product launches
  • Experience with in-servicing and training office staff, nurses, and office managers
  • Demonstrate a passion and learning aptitude for science and is proactive in strengthening knowledge related to disease state, treatment options, and healthcare trends
  • Highly organized with strong account management skills

Why Choose Us?

  • Make your work count by supporting a company that brings life-changing treatments to millions — and is committed to doing right by patients, communities, and the planet.
  • Drive progress from within by helping simplify, scale, and modernize how a global biopharma business delivers smarter, faster, and more sustainably.
  • Support teams across science, medicine, and operations by building better systems, shaping bold strategies, and enabling innovation at speed.
  • Make an impact across borders and functions, collaborating with leaders to turn complex challenges into real-world solutions.
  • Advance your career through stretch roles, cross-functional moves, and development opportunities designed to match your ambition.
  • Thrive in inclusive, high-performing teams where every role matters and every voice helps shape what’s next.

The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Meet the team:

Provides technical expertise for software quality assurance activities, including risk management activities following ISO 14971. Supports the development and implementation of scalable quality systems, risk management practices, and software compliance strategies that ensure product safety, effectiveness, and regulatory compliance. Partners with senior R&D engineering, quality, regulatory, clinical, cybersecurity, and business leaders to drive continuous improvements to SDLC, and quality excellence throughout the product lifecycle. Influences organizational quality strategy and serves as a recognized subject matter expert in software quality.

Where you come in:

  • You will serve as a technical leader and subject matter expert for software quality, risk management, software lifecycle compliance activities.
  • You will lead the effective application, compliance, and continuous improvement of software development and V&V processes, including: Risk Management, Software Design Controls for Class I/II Exempt Applications & Components
  • You will lead complex software quality initiatives spanning multiple products, programs, and functional organizations.
  • You will lead risk assessments for software anomalies, cybersecurity vulnerabilities, emerging technologies, and post-market issues.
  • You will support digital transformation initiatives (ALM, SCM, PLM) to evolve use of electronic systems supporting SDLC as defined per IEC62304.
  • You will provide technical oversight and direction for software risk management activities, including DFMEA, PFMEA, SHA, and hazard analysis.
  • You will review and approve critical quality deliverables, including software development lifecycle documentation, risk artifacts, V&V protocols, and design history file content.
  • You will drive organizational improvements related to software quality systems, development practices, automation, verification, validation, and compliance processes.
  • You will evaluate emerging regulations, standards, and industry trends and assess impact to existing and future products.
  • You will collaborate with senior leadership to define quality strategies supporting business objectives and product roadmaps, implementing a right-sized QMS applications based on Software Classification per IEC62304.
  • You will mentor and provide technical leadership to software quality engineers and cross-functional development teams.
  • You will influence project, product, and organizational decisions through expert risk-based quality assessments and recommendations.
  • You will assume and perform other duties as assigned.

What makes you successful:

  • You have extensive medical device experience demonstrated expertise in FDA 21 CFR Part 820, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 82304, EU MDR, and applicable global regulatory requirements.
  • You have advanced knowledge of software development lifecycle processes and software development methodologies including Agile, Waterfall, DevOps, Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery (CI/CD), and Test Automation.
  • You have deep experience with software quality engineering across requirements, architecture, design, development, testing, release, and post-market activities.
  • You have advanced understanding of software risk management principles, methodologies, and regulatory expectations.
  • You have demonstrated ability to influence organizational direction and lead cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.
  • You have strong understanding of software architectures, cloud technologies, distributed systems, cybersecurity principles, and data platforms.
  • You have experience supporting regulatory inspections and direct interactions with FDA, notified bodies, and external auditors.
  • You have exceptional written, verbal, and executive-level communication skills.
  • You have the ability to manage ambiguity, influence senior stakeholders, and drive complex programs to successful completion.
  • You have demonstrated success mentoring engineers and developing organizational quality capabilities.

What you’ll get:

  • A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.
  • A full and comprehensive benefits program.
  • Growth opportunities on a global scale.
  • Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.
  • An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

Travel Required:

  • 15-25%

Experience and Education Requirements:

  • Typically requires a Bachelor’s Degree in a technical discipline and a minimum of 8-12 years related experience or Master’s degree and 5-7 years equivalent industry experience or a PhD and 2-4 years of experience.

Remote Workplace:Your location will be a home office; you are not required to live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km). If you reside within commuting distance of a Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km) a hybrid working environment may be available. Ask about our Flex workplace option.

Category: Human Resources

Location:


SUMMARY
We are seeking an experienced Human Resources Generalist based in South Africa to manage and support day-to-day HR operations across the employee lifecycle.
This role is heavily focused on HR operations, employee records, onboarding, offboarding, HR administration, employee relations, employment contract administration, and HR compliance in South Africa.
The successful candidate must have practical, hands-on experience applying South African labor laws, employment regulations, and statutory compliance requirements in an HR environment.
Experience with compensation and benefits administration is preferred but not required. Recruitment experience is not required for this role.
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
HR Operations & Administration
  • Manage day-to-day HR operations across the employee lifecycle.
  • Maintain accurate and confidential employee records, personnel files, HR documentation, and employee information.
  • Prepare, process, and maintain employment-related documentation, including contracts, amendments, employee changes, and HR correspondence.
  • Maintain employee information within HR systems and ensure records are accurate and current.
  • Process employee changes such as promotions, transfers, compensation updates, role changes, and other employment-related movements.
  • Respond to HR-related questions from employees and managers and provide appropriate guidance.
  • Prepare HR reports, employee data, and administrative documentation as required.
  • Maintain and improve HR policies, procedures, documentation, and operational processes.
Onboarding & Offboarding
  • Manage employee onboarding and offboarding processes in South Africa.
  • Prepare and coordinate employment documentation for new employees.
  • Ensure required employee information and documentation are accurately completed and maintained.
  • Coordinate onboarding activities with relevant internal teams.
  • Ensure employees receive appropriate information regarding HR policies, procedures, benefits, and employment requirements.
  • Manage offboarding activities, documentation, clearances, system notifications, and employee records.
  • Ensure onboarding and offboarding activities comply with applicable South African employment requirements.
South African Labor Law & Compliance
  • Apply South African labor laws and employment regulations to day-to-day HR operations and employee matters.
  • Ensure HR processes, employment documentation, policies, and employee practices comply with applicable statutory requirements.
  • Support managers with guidance on employment policies, contracts, procedures, and HR compliance matters.
  • Administer and maintain employment contracts and related documentation.
  • Monitor changes to relevant South African employment legislation and support updates to HR practices when required.
  • Maintain appropriate records and documentation to support regulatory and statutory compliance.
  • Identify potential HR compliance issues and ensure appropriate action or escalation.
Employee Relations
  • Serve as a point of contact for employee HR questions, concerns, and workplace matters.
  • Support managers in addressing employee relations matters in accordance with company policies and applicable South African employment requirements.
  • Support grievance, disciplinary, performance management, and other employee relations processes.
  • Maintain complete and confidential documentation for employee relations matters.
  • Provide consistent and professional guidance to employees and managers.
  • Help promote a positive, professional, and compliant workplace environment.
Compensation & Benefits Administration
  • Support compensation and benefits administration where required.
  • Maintain accurate employee compensation and benefits records.
  • Process employee changes affecting compensation or benefits.
  • Coordinate with appropriate internal teams and benefits providers.
  • Assist employees with benefits-related questions.
  • Support periodic compensation and benefits activities where applicable.
Compensation and benefits experience is preferred but not required.

Requirements

QUALIFICATIONS
Required Qualifications
  • Relevant professional experience as an HR Generalist, HR Operations Specialist, People Operations Specialist, or similar HR role in South Africa.
  • Strong hands-on experience with HR operations and HR administration.
  • Practical experience managing employee records, onboarding, offboarding, and employment documentation.
  • Demonstrated experience applying South African labor laws, employment regulations, and statutory compliance requirements.
  • Experience with employment contract administration in South Africa.
  • Hands-on experience supporting employee relations matters.
  • Strong knowledge of employee lifecycle processes and HR best practices.
  • Strong documentation, organization, and attention-to-detail skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple HR activities independently.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to handle confidential and sensitive employee information appropriately.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with compensation and benefits administration.
  • Experience working with HRIS or employee-record management systems.
  • Experience supporting remote or geographically distributed employees.
  • Experience developing or improving HR policies, SOPs, and administrative processes.
  • Relevant qualification in Human Resources, Human Resource Management, Industrial Relations, Business Administration, or a related field.
JOB REQUIREMENTS
  • Must be based in South Africa.
  • Willing to accept a long-term work-from-home arrangement.
  • Amenable to working a U.S. shift schedule.

This position is responsible for all aspects of full-service and a la carte meeting and incentive programs of various size and scope. The primary responsibility is to manage all facets of the planning process and be the primary point of contact for Events customers. This individual must be able to travel on-site and to client meetings as requested by the account.

Schedule / Shift

Standard


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Program management from concept to completion; to include meeting and striving to exceed program goals, and objectives, contracting with suppliers, creating cost estimates for budget purposes, program execution and reconciliation.
  • Lead discovery calls to engage customer and learn about the meeting needs focusing on the goals and objectives of the program. Include all internal stakeholders.
  • Make destination recommendations; submit RFP’s through Cvent for a diverse group of customers with consideration of the program goals, objectives, budget and space requirements.
  • Produce accurate documents/reports for clients and vendors in conjunction with account needs.
  • Conduct effective vendor negotiations and contract execution to include terms, due dates, cost savings and concessions for hotel/venue, ground transportation, DMC, audio-visual production, food & beverage, optional activities and other suppliers contributing to the success of the program. Facilitate contract execution between the parties in a timely manner.
  • Provide meeting owner/requester a summary of all terms, due dates, total costs and deposits to meet and exceed program timelines and deadlines.
  • Record accurate budget, cost, savings and contract execution in Cvent or applicable technology.
  • Ability to travel on-site with programs as needed. While on-site, employee should maintain a professional demeanor and project a positive reflection of Event Travel Management.
  • Manage program reconciliation, invoicing, accounts payable, and accounts receivables for each program; when applicable. Follow-up to ensure timely payment processing and revenue reconciliation.
  • Provide exceptional service and manage the relationship with the meeting owner. Proactively offer professional recommendations to the client based on industry knowledge and expertise. Secure repeat business.
  • Utilize time tracking for accurate billing by project.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Leadership Responsibilities

  • This position does not have supervisory responsibilities.

Required of all CTM Positions

  • Embrace CTM’s core values of Connect, Evolve and Deliver.
  • Professional, collaborative and supportive interaction with employees, clients, suppliers and vendors.
  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
  • Appropriate and professional written and verbal communication.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines, handle and prioritize simultaneous requests.
  • Creative and analytical thinking with strong problem-solving and consultative skills.
  • Demonstrates calm under pressure – is a proactive contributor and eager to learn.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to do basic math.
  • Ability to read and interpret information.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Regular and reliable attendance.

Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent is required.
  • Minimum of five (5) year's event/meeting planning experience required.
