Job Description

A bit about this role:


Devoted Health is seeking a strategic, influential leader with a strong operational track record to serve as Director, Health Systems Management. This role is designed for an operator who can effectively de-escalate issues with our most critical provider partners, build processes that make our escalation response more scalable and effective, and drive cross-functional initiatives that prevent escalations in the first place.


Reporting directly to the Head of Provider Escalations & Education, you will work closely with cross-functional partners to build tooling that helps us diagnose escalation issues quickly and at scale, prepare executive briefings that equip leadership to decide on next steps, and charter initiatives that address the root causes of escalations through improvements to our operational processes and policies.


The best candidate will combine operational excellence, systems thinking, obsession with detail, pace-setting execution, and the ability to create confidence through change. This role is ideal for someone who organizes around metrics and outcomes, runs to hard problems, has a strong track record of achieving results, and thrives in ambiguity while building durable systems that outlast any one leader.


Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Ownership of Devoted’s Health System Escalation function, including escalation response time, quality, and time to resolution
  • Influential Leadership: Drive alignment and change across a broad set of cross-functional stakeholders, including Devoted’s executive team, Network, Claims, Payment Integrity, Clinical, Product, and Engineering teams, to achieve goals
  • Managing the function through rigorous metrics, KPIs, scorecards, and performance dashboards, with clear accountability for outcomes
  • Leading through significant evolution while creating confidence, momentum, stability, and strong culture through change
  • Running the current operation while designing, implementing, and owning the future-state process
  • Raising the talent bar across the organization by setting the pace and modeling high standards
  • Building and operationalizing AI-enabled and human-in-the-loop workflows that improve quality, and speed of our response resolution
  • Establishing clear visibility into units of work, productivity, quality, cost, workforce planning, and performance metrics
  • Defining and executing the roadmap for scaling our Health System Escalations function through workflow automation, and self-service

Required skills and experience:

  • At least 10 years of leadership experience with a track record of delivering measurable outcomes in complex operational environments
  • Outstanding operational rigor with the ability to deploy technology to solve complex business challenges
  • Proven experience driving end-to-end initiatives from strategy through execution that materially improve quality, service levels, cost, compliance, or operational efficiency
  • Strong systems thinking and product mindset, with experience owning roadmaps, KPIs, and cross-functional execution
  • Demonstrated ability to manage through metrics, establish ambitious targets, and drive teams to results with clear accountability
  • Exceptional attention to detail and precision, with a reputation for sweating the details and getting the hardest operational last mile right
  • Strong people leadership skills, with the ability to lead through managers, distributed teams, and external vendors
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners
  • Clear evidence of urgency, resilience, and the ability to move quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Demonstrated ability to raise the talent bar and serve as a pace setter for teams and peers

Desired skills and experience:

  • Experience transforming operations through AI-enabled workflows

Salary range: $182,000 - $217,000 / year

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.


Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. We value diversity and collaboration. Individuals are respected for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in Devoted’s Code of Conduct, our company values and the way we do business.

The HR Business Partner Lead leads the people management agenda in a business unit/area and acts as a strategic advisor to senior leadership. Applies broad experience across Human Resources disciplines, including workforce strategy, organizational effectiveness, talent management, succession planning, change leadership, and executive coaching. The HR Business Partner Lead works on problems of diverse scope and complexity ranging from moderate to substantial.

The HR Business Partner Lead is a strategic advisor and trusted partner to senior leaders within Stars and Risk Adjustment. This role helps shape and execute people strategies that support business priorities, strengthen organizational effectiveness, and enable a high-performing culture.


The HR Business Partner Lead partners closely with business and HR leaders to align workforce, talent, leadership, and organizational strategies with business objectives. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy and influence, providing data-driven insights, organizational consulting, and change leadership to support business success in a complex and highly matrixed environment.


This position serves as a connector across HR functions, bringing together talent, compensation, learning, workforce planning, and other people solutions to drive coordinated outcomes that improve business performance and organizational capability.


Responsibilities:

  • Translate business priorities into workforce plans, organizational capabilities, leadership strategies, and talent initiatives.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, providing guidance on organizational effectiveness, talent management, succession planning, and workforce-related decisions.
  • Lead organizational design efforts, including role clarity, decision rights, operating models, and team effectiveness initiatives.
  • Drive leadership and succession strategies that strengthen organizational capability and support future business needs.
  • Lead change management efforts by developing stakeholder engagement, communication, readiness, adoption, and sustainment strategies.
  • Leverage workforce, talent, and business data to identify trends, assess organizational health, inform decisions, and measure outcomes.
  • Partner with HR Centers of Excellence and other key stakeholders to develop and deliver integrated people solutions that support business objectives.
  • Influence and support organizational decisions by identifying risks, evaluating options, and providing evidence-based recommendations.
  • Facilitate collaboration across business areas and HR teams to improve effectiveness, alignment, and execution.
  • Drive adoption of HR programs, processes, and best practices that support a consistent and positive associate experience.
  • Advise leaders through organizational changes, leadership transitions, and evolving business priorities.
  • Contribute to the advancement of HR capabilities through knowledge sharing, best practices, and scalable solutions that can be leveraged across the organization.
  • Present workforce insights, organizational trends, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Lead confidential and special projects that improve organizational effectiveness and support business transformation.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Expectations:

  • Demonstrated success advising senior leaders within complex, highly matrixed organizations.
  • Deep understanding of workforce planning, talent management, succession planning, organizational effectiveness, and change leadership principles.
  • Ability to leverage workforce and business data to identify trends, challenge assumptions, and support strategic decision-making.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect workforce, operational, customer, and business considerations.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes and build consensus without direct authority.
  • Exercises sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive and complex situations.
  • Builds strong partnerships across HR and business teams to deliver effective solutions.
  • Demonstrates resilience, adaptability, and the ability to navigate ambiguity while maintaining focus on priorities.
  • Proven ability to proactively identify issues, develop solutions, and drive execution in a fast-paced environment.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field.
  • Experience coaching and advising senior leaders, including serving as an accountability partner for company values and leadership behaviors.
  • Demonstrated ability to advise on workforce planning and succession strategies that build a strong pipeline of future leadership talent.
  • Ability to lead and/or facilitate effective change initiatives and activate change through influence rather than direct oversight.
  • Seven or more years of progressive HR experience, with emphasis on strategic business partnership, talent management, and data analysis.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships at all levels of the organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret performance analytics and identify meaningful insights that inform action.
  • Proven track record contributing to improvements in talent retention and organizational effectiveness.
  • Strong proficiency with HRIS platforms, business intelligence tools, and other technology required to perform the essential functions of the role.
  • Ability to travel approximately 25% based on business needs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PHR or SPHR certification.
  • Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field.
  • Experience in the healthcare industry and/or with a multi-site, multi-state employer.

raw.description:
HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT

As the Regional Director, U.S. Market Development, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by advancing USGBC and GBCI's mission through increased adoption of green building products, services, and solutions across the United States.

You'll serve as a proven sales leader responsible for developing and executing the market development and sales strategy for your assigned region, driving revenue growth, strengthening strategic customer and partner relationships, and leading a high-performing team of market leads.

You will provide direct leadership and oversight to the market leads assigned to the U.S. market, establishing clear performance expectations, coaching and developing team members, and ensuring consistent execution of sales and market development priorities across assigned countries and territories.

You'll be accountable for revenue attainment and growth within your assigned region, setting clear commercial priorities, strengthening sales execution, and opening doors with strategic customers, sponsors, partners, and industry leaders.

While your direct commercial and people-management responsibilities will focus on your assigned region, you will collaborate with global market development leadership and cross-functional teams across all regions to support consistent commercial practices, knowledge sharing, and organizational priorities.

You'll report to the Global Head of Market Development and work closely with Sales Operations, Account Management, Client Solutions, Marketing and Communications, Product, and other organizational teams to support sustained revenue growth and product adoption.

You'll also lead the development of a multi-year strategic and revenue plan for the U.S. market in collaboration with the Global Head of Market Development and other relevant organizational leaders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Regional Market Development Strategy and Revenue Growth:Lead the planning, development, and execution of the market development and sales strategy for the U.S. market to increase revenue, expand adoption of USGBC/GBCI products and services, and strengthen market engagement. Develop a multi-year strategic and revenue plan aligned with organizational objectives. Oversee the development and execution of territory-specific sales plans across assigned countries and markets, ensuring consistent commercial priorities while addressing regional market conditions and opportunities.
  • Market Lead Team Leadership and Performance Management:Provide direct leadership, supervision, coaching, and performance management to all market leads assigned to the U.S. market. Establish clear priorities, performance expectations, sales targets, and individual development objectives. Attract, develop, motivate, empower, and retain a high-performing team while strengthening sales, communication, and leadership capabilities. Foster a collaborative, accountable, and results-oriented team environment across assigned geographic locations.
  • Sales Targets, Pipeline Management, and Forecasting:Own revenue and sales targets for the U.S. market and team KPIs, allocate approved targets across assigned territories, and remain accountable for meeting or exceeding established goals. Establish a disciplined sales operating rhythm, including pipeline reviews, forecasting, performance reporting, and regular coaching discussions. Partner with Sales Operations to monitor pipeline health, conversion rates, forecast accuracy, and revenue outcomes. Provide consolidated regional sales performance updates and actionable recommendations to the global head of market development and relevant organizational leadership.
  • Strategic Customer Relationships and Commercial Opportunities:Build and leverage senior-level relationships with strategic customers, major sponsors, partners, and industry leaders to advance commercial opportunities. Support Market Leads in developing executive relationships, negotiating significant opportunities, and progressing complex sales within approved commercial authority. Provide executive-level support for high-value, multi-territory, or strategic commercial opportunities while maintaining clear account ownership and coordination with customer account management and client solutions.
  • Market Intelligence and Customer Engagement:Maintain a strong understanding of customer needs, market conditions, industry priorities, and emerging opportunities through engagement with existing and prospective customers, partners, and other stakeholders. Translate market intelligence into commercial priorities, customer engagement strategies, and recommendations for product development and optimization. Share relevant regional market insights with global leadership and cross-functional teams to support organizational planning and informed decision-making.
  • Membership, Sponsorship, and Strategic Partnerships:Strengthen USGBC's presence, influence, and commercial engagement across the U.S. market by developing relationships with industry leaders, policymakers, peer organizations, sponsors, members, and strategic partners. Identify mutually beneficial opportunities that support organizational objectives, product adoption, and revenue growth. Coordinate with channel partner account management and other relevant teams to ensure consistent partner engagement and clear commercial responsibilities.
  • Marketing, Advocacy, and Industry Representation:Represent USGBC and GBCI at relevant industry meetings, conferences, and events, including Greenbuild and other relevant global, regional, or local events. Contribute market insights and relevant content to Marketing and Communications initiatives that support pipeline generation and revenue growth. Collaborate with Advocacy and Policy teams on engagement with relevant government agencies, regulatory bodies, and policymakers within the U.S. regarding supportive policies, access to capital, high-performance buildings, and sustainability technologies. Serve as a senior representative of market development in approved external engagements and strategic industry relationships.
  • Sales Enablement, Operational Effectiveness, and Continuous Improvement:Support sales success by identifying barriers, improving commercial processes, strengthening team capabilities, and promoting effective use of sales tools and resources. Partner with Sales Operations and Sales Enablement to implement approved training, coaching, sales methodologies, and process improvements. Review team capacity and organizational structure with the Global Head of Market Development and recommend adjustments to improve efficiency and effectiveness. Promote consistent CRM adoption, data quality, sales forecasting, and performance management practices across assigned market leads and territories.
  • Leadership Accountability, Decision-Making, and Escalation:Establish clear team priorities, manage performance, support commercial decisions within delegated authority, and recommend resource allocation, organizational adjustments, and strategic initiatives. Escalate significant commercial risks, resource limitations, pricing or contractual exceptions, and decisions requiring executive approval. Maintain accountability for U.S. market performance while ensuring alignment with global commercial governance, applicable local requirements, and the strategic direction established by the global head of market development.

Assessment Notice

  • Candidates who advance in the interview process will be required to complete an assessment, more details will be provided as the time approaches.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

  • A minimum of 15 years of progressively responsible experience in B2B sales, business development, or market development, preferably within real estate, green building, sustainability, or related industries.
  • Executive-level experience leading, motivating, supervising, and developing sales teams in a geographically distributed or multi-market work environment.
  • Demonstrated success leading sales teams that consistently achieve or exceed revenue, pipeline, and commercial growth objectives.
  • Proven track record of developing and implementing market development and sales strategies that improve sales effectiveness, build pipeline, and deliver sustainable revenue growth.
  • Extensive experience managing strategic customer relationships, renewals, cross-selling, upselling, and complex commercial opportunities.
  • Strong negotiation and consultative selling experience, including the ability to engage senior executives and decision-makers and coach sales professionals in these capabilities.
  • Demonstrated experience leading sales or market development teams across multiple territories, countries, or geographic markets.
  • Experience establishing sales targets, managing commercial forecasts, and holding distributed sales teams accountable for measurable performance outcomes.
  • Experience collaborating with global or multinational commercial teams to support cross-functional alignment and shared business objectives.
  • Knowledge and experience in the green building industry.
  • Experience in real estate, sustainability, high-performance buildings, or related professional services (preferred).
  • Demonstrated commitment to advancing green building market transformation and increasing the adoption of sustainable building practices (preferred).
  • Experience developing strategic partnerships, sponsorships, and relationships with industry associations or policymakers.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, marketing, international business, finance, sustainability, real estate, or a related field required.
  • Master's degree in business administration (mba), business leadership, sustainability management, or a related discipline preferred.

Technology/System(s)

  • Proficiency with salesforce or a comparable CRM platform, including using data to manage pipeline, forecast revenue, and drive team performance.
  • Advanced proficiency with CRM reporting, sales pipeline dashboards, forecasting tools, and commercial performance analytics.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint, or comparable business productivity and collaboration platforms.
  • Experience using sales reporting and business intelligence tools, such as Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, or comparable analytics platforms, to monitor performance and support commercial decision-making.
  • Experience using digital collaboration, virtual meeting, and performance management tools to lead and develop geographically distributed teams.

Skills

  • Strong leadership and people-management skills, including the ability to motivate, develop, and hold high-performing sales teams accountable for results.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, including empathy, active listening, respect for others, and the ability to build effective working relationships.
  • Strong strategic planning, negotiation, consultative selling, and executive relationship management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to represent the organization effectively with senior stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple initiatives, competing priorities, and deadlines while delivering expected outcomes.
  • Self-directed, detail-oriented, organized, and capable of working effectively in a distributed or multi-location leadership environment.
  • Ability to lead and develop sales teams across assigned geographic markets while maintaining consistent performance expectations and team engagement.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, including the ability to evaluate revenue performance, pipeline health, forecast accuracy, and resource priorities.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with global stakeholders across different cultures, organizational functions, and time zones.
  • Commitment to the missions of USGBC and GBCI and an interest in advancing sustainability in the built environment.

Certifications

  • LEED Green Associate or LEED AP credential preferred.
  • Relevant professional certifications in sales leadership, strategic account management, business development, or salesforce are preferred

ABOUT OUR TOTAL REWARDS PACKAGE

Salary

Final compensation and benefits will be confirmed at the time of offer and may vary based on factors such as internal equity, relevant experience, qualifications, and employment status. Please note that salary negotiations will not extend beyond the top of the internal salary range.

Benefits

We offer you:

  • Competitive compensation
  • 401(k) with employer matching
  • Professional development reimbursement
  • We offer a healthcare plan through Cigna that includes medical, dental, vision, and prescription drugs. USGBC covers 100% of the premiums and an HRA that will assist you and your dependents in reaching the in-network medical deductible. You will only be responsible for the $300 individual / $600 family up front deductible for medical services before the employer funded HRA will process payments for your in-network claims
  • Generous paid time off (12 paid holidays, 9 paid personal sick days and based on career level either 2 to 3 weeks PTO), including operations closed for a full week between Christmas and New Year’s
  • 6 weeks paid renewal leave after 7 years of continuous service

LOGISTICS

Location:This position is remote in the U.S.

Work Schedule:Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM in candidate time zone. Flexibility to collaborate with global leadership and cross-functional teams across international time zones may be required.

Travel:Domestic or international travel, including customer and partner meetings, regional market development activities, and relevant organizational events, as business needs require.

EEO STATEMENT

The U.S. Green Building Council is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

ABOUT US

U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC)is a mission-driven nonprofit dedicated to accelerating and scaling the transformation of the built environment. Through LEED—the world’s most widely used green building rating system— and initiatives likes Greenbuild, the Center for Green Schools and advocacy, USGBC empowers professionals to drive market transformation that advances human and environmental health, climate resilience, and equity.

Green Business Certification Inc. (GBCI)is the world’s leading sustainability and health certification and credentialing body, independently recognizing excellence in performance. GBCI administers project certifications and professional credentials and certificates includingLEED,PERFORM,SITES, andTRUE Zero Waste.

We are proud to be globally recognized for our leadership in green building, environmental performance, and sustainable development.

Our Global Impact

  • Over 120,000 LEED-certified commercial projects worldwide
  • Millions of square feetof certified healthy, efficient, low-carbon space
  • Recognition in 180+ countries for innovation in green building and business practices

Why Join Us?

At USGBC and GBCI, you’ll work alongside passionate, mission-aligned professionals who care deeply about people, the planet, and progress. We offer:

  • A purpose-driven, inclusive culture
  • Opportunities to grow your career and take ownership of meaningful work
  • A chance to make a measurable impact on global sustainability efforts
  • We’re seeking team members who thrive in collaborative environments, are committed to excellence, and want to build lasting partnerships that drive change in the built environment.

Meet Our Leaders and Learn More about our Mission:

Working together, each of us advances our mission by respecting all voices, trusting and supporting one another, excelling through collaboration and accountability, and continuously improving ourselves and our organization.

Job Description Summary

‎

The AVP, Consultant Relations is responsible for building, activating, and expanding Castlight / Vera’s broker and consultant ecosystem across assigned geographies. This role is the frontline ambassador to the brokerage community -- developing relationships, telling our value story, creating new market interest, and generating high-quality opportunities for the employer sales teams.

This leader operates with a high degree of autonomy and ownership. While tightly partnered with Regional Directors (Sales) and ADRs, the AVP, Channel Partnerships is expected to independently build broker mindshare, open doors to key target accounts, secure RFP inclusion, and advance Castlight/Vera into preferred/best-fit “buckets” within consulting firms.

This is a high-visibility, externally facing commercial role that requires strong relationship building, strong existing network, follow-through, and an ability to translate our differentiated value into clear, compelling conversations with the market.

‎

How will you make an impact & Requirements

‎

Broker & Consultant Relationship Development

  • Build and grow strategic relationships with brokers, consultants, and advisor firms across assigned territories.
  • Introduce our value story, outcomes, client performance, expanded services, and improved go-to-market model.
  • Rebuild trust where necessary; tailor messaging for consultants with prior Castlight experiences (good or bad).
  • Secure inclusion in the right “buckets” across national and regional consulting houses.
  • Maintain regular, proactive communication with key brokerage contacts to stay top-of-mind for new opportunities.

Territory Development & Market Penetration

  • Own a territory-aligned channel strategy that complements the Sales team’s account plans.
  • Use our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) to identify target employers, then map the associated consultants/brokers covering those accounts.
  • Coordinate multi-threaded outreach with Regional Directors and ADRs to ensure maximum coverage.
  • Drive early-year momentum — the first 120 days are critical for relationship building and shaping the book of business for the year.

Opportunity Creation & Pipeline Acceleration

  • Serve as the primary engine for generating new employer opportunities through the broker ecosystem.
  • Ensure we are included in RFPs that meet our strategic thresholds and ICP criteria.
  • Work closely with Sales to shape early-stage opportunities, share intelligence, and guide deal strategy.
  • Deliver high-quality introductions, warm handoffs, and contextual background that improves deal momentum.
  • Support Sales in shaping demand through thought leadership, shared client wins, ROI, and success stories.

Value Storytelling & Market Messaging

  • Deliver a consistent, compelling narrative about our transformation, expanded services, and clinical + navigation integration.
  • Communicate our ROI, outcomes, quality metrics, and client tenure as part of our credibility story.
  • Tailor messaging for each consulting firm based on history, market positioning, and client portfolios.

Cross-Functional Partnership (Sales, Marketing, Product, Finance)

  • Partner with Regional Directors on strategic pursuits and pipeline prioritization.
  • Collaborate with ADRs to align outbound efforts with broker-driven opportunities.
  • Work closely with Marketing on broker campaigns, regional strategies, and relationship-building events.
  • Gather consistent insights on buyer trends, competitive positioning, consultant preferences, and emerging market opportunities. Provide broker feedback and voice-of-market insights to Product Marketing and Commercial Strategy.
  • Coordinate early-stage pricing conversations with Finance to ensure alignment with broker expectations.

What This Role Does Not Own

  • Closing sales or managing late-stage deal cycles
  • Pricing strategy, packaging, or economic modeling
  • Detailed RFP response development
  • Product roadmap strategy
  • Sales forecasts, pipeline reporting, or Salesforce governance
  • Requirements:
  • Bachelors degree with 10+ years experience in healthcare

Kein Konzeptpapier, keine Vorlesungsaufgabe. Du sitzt beim Kunden oder im Team-Call, nimmst das Problem auseinander und kommst mit einer ersten Lösung zurück. Remote oder hybrid von München aus, mit 12 bis 20 Stunden pro Woche neben dem Studium.

Was du tatsächlich tust

Du löst Probleme im Termin, nicht im Backlog. Industrieunternehmen zeigen dir Abläufe im Service, im Vertrieb oder in Operations, die seit Jahren so laufen. Du analysierst sie direkt im Gespräch mit den Leuten, die damit arbeiten.

Du baust die erste Version selbst. Mock-up, Demo oder kleines MVP, gebaut mit Coding-Agenten und schnell genug, damit der Kunde entscheiden kann.

Du hältst die Linie bis zum Ergebnis. Die produktionsreife Umsetzung übernehmen unsere Agenten und die Tech-Teams, die du mitsteuerst. Du entscheidest mit, was gebaut wird, und auch, was sich wirtschaftlich nicht lohnt.

Ein Ergebnis aus einem Kundenprojekt: Eine Service-Anfrage braucht jetzt 45 Sekunden, vorher waren es 25 Minuten. Bei Ausnahmen entscheidet ein Mensch.

Das bist du

Du hast schon etwas gebaut, das andere nutzen. Ein Tool im Studium, ein Startup-Versuch, eine Vereinswebsite oder ein Open-Source-Repo. Wie groß, ist egal.

Du machst Ideen sichtbar. Ist etwas unklar, baust du eine Version davon und redest darüber.

Du fragst zuerst nach dem Business. Wie oft passiert das? Was kostet es heute? Danach wird es technisch.

Was du wirklich brauchst: Du studierst, zum Beispiel Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Maschinenbau oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen. Dazu Deutsch auf verhandlungssicherem Niveau, weil du mit Kunden im Termin sitzt.

Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Informatikstudium, Berufsjahre oder Erfahrung in der Industrie setzen wir nicht voraus. Das Industriewissen lernst du bei uns.

Ehrlich: Was dich hier erwartet

Wir arbeiten KI-first, in allen Rollen. KI nimmt dir Routine ab, der Anspruch an deine Arbeit steigt dadurch. Damit alle mitkommen, steht Lernzeit fest im Kalender.

Remote ja, unsichtbar nein. Du arbeitest, wo du willst, bist aber ansprechbar und im Team sichtbar. Du bekommst viel Kontext, wenig Mikromanagement und zeigst Kunden deine eigenen Ergebnisse.

Ehrlich gesagt passen wir eher nicht zusammen, wenn du feste Vorgaben von außen brauchst oder KI für ein Thema für später hältst.

Was du bekommst

  • KI-Werkzeuge ohne Formular, dazu unsere eigenen Agenten. Neue Modelle probierst du direkt im Projekt aus.

  • Echte Kundenprojekte schon im Studium: Mit eluna setzt du unsere eigenen KI-Agenten bei echten Kunden ein.

  • Dein Rhythmus: Stunden und Arbeitszeiten flexibel neben dem Studium.

  • Dazu: EGYM Wellpass, Jobrad, Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, Teamevents und Workations.

So bewirbst du dich

Kein Anschreiben, Lebenslauf oder LinkedIn-Profil reicht. Am meisten freut uns ein Link auf etwas, das du gebaut hast. KI darfst du dabei nutzen.

  1. Video-Interview. Ein paar kurze Fragen, wann es dir passt.

  2. Kennenlern-Call. Über dich, die Rolle und deine Fragen.

  3. Gespräch mit einem Gründer. Wohin elunic will, aus erster Hand.

  4. Use Case. Eine echte Aufgabe, mit den Werkzeugen aus dem Job.

Unsicher, ob es passt? Mach den AI Harness-Check oder lass deinen eigenen Agenten prüfen, ob wir zu dir passen.

Über elunic. Wir bringen KI in den industriellen Mittelstand, mit rund 60 Leuten im Kernteam und einem festen Netz aus Partnern. Mit eluna bauen wir KI-Agenten, die im Büro unserer Kunden Vorgänge erledigen, von der Service-Anfrage bis zum Angebot.

Mehr über uns auf elunic.com/karriere

IMPORTANT NOTE: ONLY CANDIDATES WHO APPLY USING THIS LINK WILL BE CONSIDERED FOR THE ROLE:

If you are unable to access the link, please find the job here at

Salary: 43,000 PHP / month

What we offer:

  • 100% Remote Work - Work from home/work from anywhere
  • Schedule Flexibility - No time tracker / no micromanagement
  • Above market pay in line with your experience and the roles responsibilities and impact
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Health & Wellness Reimbursement
  • Open Book Management -

Key Responsibilities:

1. Customer Satisfaction and Resolution (40%)

  • You must be the type of person who can think outside of the box, think ahead for the customer, and provide solutions that are well-thought-out and simple
  • Purposeful Design to eliminate waste: Your responses/answers should be very intentional. Eliminate wasted time by thinking ahead and answering the core of the customers problem to avoid a lot of back and forth.
  • Provide exceptional customer support by responding to customer queries in a timely and accurate way, via phone, email, or chat
  • Monitor and study our customer reviews/feedback on our Amazon product listing (so you can help make suggestions on how to improve our product/process)
  • You are expected to provide complete resolution to exactly what the customer is trying to do (not necessarily what the customer is asking about... we are to provide EXCEPTIONAL customer support. Our customer service is about quality, NOT quantity. Please understand this; if this is not you, it's ok and do not apply.

2. Product Advocacy & Mastery(30%)

  • Be a product and process expert. Understand our products, our competitors products, the issues, our value proposition, as well as our process/resolution.
  • Constant Growth & Improvement: Be curious and cognizant about our product(both existing and newly launched), processes, as well as of whats going on within the industry so you can help make suggestions on how we can improve
  • Familiarize oneself with the products offered in the organization
  • Expected to be updated with new product launches, inventory, and availability of products
  • Learn product specification, purpose & use most especially for fence and rail products.

3. Process Adherence & Cadence : (30%)

  • Use our CRM (Front App) and adhere to the following
    • SLA - 24 hours
    • Hours of Operations - Flexibility with working hours depending on the surge of Tickets & Requests
    • Analytics - Monitor daily productivity (Products, Prices, # Tickets)
    • Rules - Attendance, SLA Adherence, Meeting target expectations & KPIs Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly & Yearly
    • Process - Coordinating with the Sales & Product team for accuracy & smoother process.
  • Update on CRM (Pipedrive)
    • Deal Stages - Data Entry - Providing updates on the status of Opportunities & Leads to help sales to close all pending deals.
    • Doing proper cadence and follow-through on delivery, OOS, and pending payments.
  • Update our internal databases, sheets & CRM with information about technical issues, questions, and other useful discussions with customers so we can improve our system/product
  • Reply to customers always within 5 minutes. Attend and do callbacks to CX requesting urgent assistance. You can be flexible with how else you want to spend your time at work as long as you are meeting this SLA. We prefer for you to be attentive around the computer and be on the lookout for new messages/tickets
  • Data entry (make labels/ship things on FBA or other shipping platforms, either for inbound or for customer spare parts)
  • Resolve all issues by the end of the day (you can snooze if we are waiting for a customer or another person's reply/info)
  • Fill out an End of Day report to confirm you have done all the required checklist/tasks for the day (it's the same daily)
  • Fill out an End of Week report to think about how the week went and anything can be improved (same weekly)
  • DILO:
    • Check all turnovers from the previous CS shift:
    • Emails
    • Refunds
    • Requests for Quotations
    • Help on parts to use
    • Draw or illustrate what it would look like to determine parts to be used; seek assistance or endorse to the Sales Specialist
    • Missing parts
    • Other miscellaneous concerns
    • Follow up / follow through on turnover items and pending payments
    • Escalate non-CS escalations to respective owners (e.g. Thine, Steve)
    • Address customer concerns as they come
    • Submit EOD & EOW

Requirements:

Role Requirements:

  • Must be amenable to work during weekends and graveyard shifts.
  • 3-5 Years of Customer Support and Providing exemplary service to customers.
  • 3-5 years experience in taking Inbound and Outbound Calls
  • 3 years experience in using good email etiquette
  • Experience in using Basic CRMs and Data Entry
  • Knowledge in Shopify

Role Preferential:

  • Use of Apollo, Pipedrive, Slack, 3CX & Monday are not a requirement but are good to have
  • A proven track record in customer service and support with expertise in prioritization and pipeline management.
  • Has experience in the manufacturing industry

Role Exclusion:

  • Lead Generation or Lead Mining - Leads and tickets are being generated from our CRMs
  • Do Training and Creation of dashboards - rather than utilizing CRMs and reports we already have in monitoring Sales & Performance
  • Creation of sales scripts and workflows

Education:

  • Associate's or equivalent

Experience:

  • 2-5 years relevant experience

Management:

  • No Management experience

Scope of Control:

  • Control is only limited to their own work.

Impact:

  • Jobs at this level have a direct impact on the performance of a single individual or team. (Entry-Associate level roles)

Degree of Technical Skills:

  • Has good working and background knowledge of the area of practice.
  • Can complete tasks independently with little guidance.
  • Can identify and troubleshoot complex problems.
  • Can mentor or train others.

Degree of Problem Solving:

  • Individuals at this level are able to identify and solve problems that have already occurred. They can use basic problem-solving skills to identify the root cause of a problem and develop a solution.
  • May require some guidance and support to solve problems.

Task Complexity:

  • Tasks are very complex and require a high level of problem-solving skills.
  • There is a lot of ambiguity or uncertainty involved in completing the tasks.
  • The tasks require a wide range of specialized skills and knowledge.
  • The tasks can take a long time to complete.

Hardware Required:

  • This level of hardware is sufficient for more demanding tasks such as browsing multiple browser tabs, video editing, and graphic design.
  • The hardware requirements for this level are higher than the basic level, and a mid-range computer or laptop will be required.

Why join CR Fence & Rail?

CR Fence & Rail is a fast-growing, disruptive company. The job required here is often messy, challenging & fast pace. One will most likely have to do hard/difficult things, have to learn new skills (relevant to your job/career goal), have to have uncomfortable conversions and be graded 100% on your outcome/output (not time spent). The bottom line is that working at CR Rail & Fence is NOT for everyone. However, for the right person, this job will be a kick-ass, messy, fun, challenging, and rewarding place to work.

CR Fence & Rail aims to empower people to easily install handrails and keep their loved ones safe, globally.

Are You the Right Fit? Let Us Explain...

Besides having the right job experience, which is someone who has demonstrated in the past of having done (or solve our exact issues & a proven track record of success), we are looking for people who can succeed "in spite of"...

  • Learn and do a good job in spite of poor onboarding and training.
  • Communicate quickly & efficiently in spite of being remote and rarely doing meetings.
  • Do the job and do the job well in spite of ambiguous and incomplete processes.
  • Make improvements to our process in spite of being so busy executing the process.
  • Get the job done with flying colors, on schedule, and on budget in spite of all the difficulties we face as a startup.

You can learn much more about CR Rail & Fence's About Us, Core Value, Work Principles, Detailed Benefits, Bonus Structure, and more at:

Recruitment Process

  1. The recruitment process is all initially at your pace. We only do in-person interviews in the final step. We will initially ask yes/no & numeric questions to verify your relevant experience.
  2. We will ask you to list out your key responsibilities from your previous companies.
  3. We will then ask you to demonstrate past responsibilities to support your list of key responsibilities and success metrics.
  4. Then we will select a few applicants to do a paid trial task (we will provide actual problems/issues we face that you will try to resolve).
  5. Lastly, we will do a final in-person interview (at this point, you would most likely have passed most of the job competency and experience assessment and this is a job/culture fit + opportunity for you to ask/understand us better).

About Ellucian

Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students. Ellucian's AI-powered platform, trained on the richest dataset available in higher education, drives efficiency, personalized experiences, and strengthened engagement for all students, faculty and staff. Fueled by decades of experience with a singular focus on the unique needs of learning institutions, the Ellucian platform features best-in-class SaaS capabilities and delivers insights needed now and into the future. These solutions and services span the entire student lifecycle, including data-rich tools for student recruitment, enrollment, and retention to workforce analytics, fundraising, and alumni engagement. Ellucian's innovative solutions, vast ecosystem of partners and user community of more than 45,000 provides best practices leading to greater institutional success and achieving better student outcomes.


About the Opportunity

Ellucian is seeking an experienced Senior Solutions Consultant to help higher education institutions explore the capabilities of Student Flex and envision their technology modernization journey.

As part of our Solution Sales organization, you will combine deep functional expertise in Anthology Student Information System (SIS) with consultative selling and compelling solution demonstrations to connect institutional challenges with meaningful business outcomes.

This is a unique opportunity to help bring Student Flex to market. Alongside leading customer demonstrations, you will take a key role in building, maintaining, and evolving the Student Flex demonstration environment, working closely with Account Executives, Strategic Business Advisors, Platform Architects, and Product teams to deliver engaging customer experiences.

Where You Will Make an Impact

  • Lead engaging, customer-focused demonstrations of Student Flex, using your Anthology SIS expertise to showcase capabilities, address institutional challenges, and communicate business value.

  • Serve as the lead functional expert for Student Flex demonstrations, providing guidance on Anthology SIS functionality, workflows, and higher education student lifecycle processes.

  • Take a leading role in configuring, maintaining, and enhancing the Student Flex demonstration environment, ensuring it remains reliable, relevant, and ready for customer engagements.

  • Develop realistic demonstration scenarios, workflows, scripts, and sample data that bring Student Flex capabilities to life and reflect customer needs.

  • Partner with Account Executives, Strategic Business Advisors, and Platform Architects to shape pursuit strategies, tailor demonstrations, and deliver compelling solution narratives.

  • Collaborate with Product Management and technical teams to incorporate new functionality, resolve demonstration challenges, and continuously improve the customer experience.

  • Help establish reusable demonstration assets, Experience Cards, and best practices in partnership with the Solutions Acceleration Office (SAO), supporting consistency and scalability.

  • Contribute to competitive positioning, knowledge sharing, and enablement activities that strengthen Student Flex go-to-market readiness and support the wider Solutions Consulting team.

What You Will Bring

  • 7+ years of experience in higher education technology, SaaS presales, solutions consulting, or higher education administration, with substantial student information system experience.

  • Direct, hands-on experience demonstrating Anthology SIS (Anthology Student) in customer-facing presales, solutions consulting, or comparable roles.

  • Strong functional knowledge of Anthology SIS, including student administration, academic records, registration, curriculum, and core student lifecycle processes.

  • Practical experience configuring, preparing, maintaining, or supporting Anthology SIS demonstration environments, including developing workflows, scripts, scenarios, and demonstration data.

  • Proven ability to independently lead complex software demonstrations, translating technical and functional capabilities into clear institutional benefits and business outcomes.

  • Strong understanding of higher education operations, institutional priorities, and the challenges associated with SIS modernization.

  • Excellent presentation, storytelling, discovery, and communication skills, with the confidence to engage functional, technical, and executive stakeholders.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience partnering with Sales, Product Management, and technical teams to support complex customer engagements.

  • Ability to work independently as a senior functional expert, contribute to reusable demonstration practices, and adapt to evolving product capabilities and customer needs.

  • Curiosity and openness to using AI and emerging technologies to improve demonstration effectiveness and customer engagement.

About us

mazeed is a financial management platform that helps businesses automate accounting, simplify tax compliance, and stay ready for e-invoicing through a combination of localized software (SaaS) and Finance-as-a-Service (FaaS). We work with SMEs and growing companies across the GCC, enabling them to operate with clarity, control, and confidence.

We are building the infrastructure for the next phase of financial compliance and digital transformation in the region, with a strong focus on e-invoicing and scalable financial operations

Job Purpose

The ERP Success Lead is responsible for leading, coaching, and supporting the ERP Success function while also managing key enterprise accounts. In addition to overseeing complex onboarding, data migration, and technical support activities, this role provides subject matter expertise across ERP processes and implementations.

You remain hands-on, ensuring high-quality onboarding delivery, providing advanced technical support for complex cases, and acting as the escalation point for critical customer issues by diagnosing challenges and driving effective solutions. This role also plays an active part in the presales process by attending strategic sales demos, supporting the commercial team with ERP expertise, validating customer requirements, and advising on technical feasibility and solution design.

The ERP Success Lead plays a critical role in maximizing client value from the mazeed platform by combining strong financial acumen, deep technical knowledge, and leadership capabilities. The role works closely with Product, Sales, and Support teams to improve processes, support product feedback loops, and ensure the highest standards of delivery and team performance.

Primary Responsibilities

ERP Team Support

  • Support the ERP Success team in successful implementation SLA achievements, including daily operations, task allocation, and performance monitoring and client engagement

Client Onboarding & Data Migration

  • Lead and manage client onboarding, ensuring smooth setup, accurate configuration, and successful data migration of client accounts.

  • Prepare solution design documentation, a process map and implementation plans.

  • Attend Presales activities and manage any customization request

Financial Analysis & Advisory

  • Utilize financial expertise to understand each client’s business and financial model, goals, and challenges, providing tailored insights and recommendations.

Client Success & Partnership

  • Serve as a financial advisor and success partner, guiding clients on best practices to ensure long-term satisfaction and retention.

Implementation & Process Optimization

  • Translate financial data and client workflows into actionable implementation plans that align with business objectives.

  • Support knowledge sharing within the team and contribute to internal documentation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with product, operations, and support teams to ensure seamless execution and alignment on client needs.

  • Join the commercial team to identify client needs and deliver tailored product demos based on the industry and business model.

Performance Monitoring & Retention

  • Monitor account performance, adoption, and financial outcomes to drive retention, engagement, and satisfaction.

Risk Identification & Problem Solving

  • Identify risks or areas for improvement and proactively offer effective, data-driven solutions.

Support & Issue Resolution

  • Manage and follow up on client support tickets, ensuring first call/chat resolution and clear communication between clients and internal departments.

  • Act as the voice of the customer—bring real-world insights to help shape roadmap and feature delivery.

Presales Support

  • Attend sales demos as the ERP subject matter expert to support the commercial team.

  • Analyze client business needs in real time during demos and translate them into ERP use cases.

  • Handle customer functional and technical questions to live during sales meetings and demos.

  • Assess and validate customer customization requests and advise on feasibility, effort, and product fit.

  • Support solution positioning by mapping customer requirements to Mazeed ERP modules and features.

  • Document presales findings and requirements to ensure smooth handover to onboarding and implementation teams.

Core Values

Being a mazeeder, our promise to customers, internal teams, HR and Leadership is to demonstrate our core values in our daily interactions and quality of work:

  1. Integrity

  2. Customer Obsession

  3. Simplicity

  4. Growth Mindset

  5. Innovation

  6. Empowerment

Essential Skills and Qualifications

  • Bacherlors Degree in a relevant field, preferrably Accounting and Commerce

  • 5 to 7 years' of experience in ERP implementation in customer-facing role

  • Hands-on onboarding expertise

  • Familiarity with ERP platforms (e.g., Odoo, SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics).

  • Understanding of financial reporting, data analysis, and ERP workflows.

  • Proficient in Excel or knowledge of data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau)is a plus.

  • Basic understanding of data migration processes and ERP configuration steps.

  • English Command: C1

Desireable Skills and Qualifications

  • HubSpot knowledge is a plus

raw.description:
Make your next move an expert one.

At Colliers it’s not our success that sets us apart, it’s how we achieve it. Our people are passionate, take ownership and always do what’s right for our clients, people and communities.

Why Colliers?

Our enterprising environment needs your expertise to facilitate Colliers’ continued growth as an industry leader. Our nimble, decentralized culture can provide you with a wealth of opportunities to learn about our business and quickly gain experience to accelerate your career.

***This role is a Remote arrangement from one of the States listed.***


About you

This role leads the design and development of integrated Occupier Solutions for broker-led single and multi-market clients.

This individual partners directly with brokers, internal service line leaders and client stakeholders to architect differentiated, multi-service solutions spanning Transaction Management (TM), Project Management, Lease Administration and Consulting, and Advisory services.

The role is responsible for shaping client strategy, defining integrated solution approaches, and leading commercial and financial structuring for sophisticated occupier engagements. It plays a critical role in positioning the firm’s capabilities in a compelling, value-driven way to support win strategy, enterprise growth, expansion of wallet-share within existing accounts, and long-term client relationships.


This role serves as…

  • Occupier solutions leader for broker-led occupier client relationships.
  • Architect of integrated, multi-service client solutions.
  • Senior advisor on commercial strategy, pricing, and deal structuring.
  • Lead solution designer for broker-led pursuits and strategic opportunities.
  • Contributor to enterprise relationship development, opportunity origination, and account expansion

In this role, you will…

Lead the development of integrated occupier solutions for broker led clients by:

  • Designing end-to-end, multi-service solutions aligned to client portfolio strategy and business objectives.
  • Architecting solutions across Transaction Management (TM), Project Management, Lease Administration, and Consulting, and Advisory services.
  • Partnering with internal service line leaders to define optimal solution structures and operating constructs.
  • Developing differentiated value propositions that align client needs with firm capabilities.
  • Ensuring solutions are commercially sound, scalable, and strategically aligned.

Lead commercial architecture and financial design for occupier broker-led client solutions:

  • Develop pricing models and integrated financial frameworks across multiple service lines.
  • Define fee structures, margin considerations, and value-based pricing strategies.
  • Support complex, multi-market deal structuring and scenario modeling.
  • Provide senior-level insight into commercial trade-offs, risk, and value optimization.

Support broker client growth through strategic relationship development, wallet share expansion, and opportunity shaping:

  • Identify and shape broker-led occupier opportunities across priority accounts and sectors.
  • Drive expansion of wallet - share within existing client accounts through cross-serviceengagement and solution alignment.
  • Build and maintain senior-level client relationships to support long-term pipelinedevelopment, retention, and growth.
  • Engage in strategic networking and market-facing activities to strengthen enterprisepresence and opportunity flow.
  • Serve as a senior representative of the firm at key industry events, conferences, and client forums to enhance market visibility, deepen executive relationships, and support enterprise growth strategy.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to translate market intelligence into actionable pursuit and expansion opportunities.
  • Support account growth strategies that increase multi-service penetration and deepen client engagement.

Lead solution strategy for high-value broker-led occupier pursuits and strategic client opportunities:

  • Shape pursuit strategy, win themes, and solution narrative for broker led opportunities.
  • Lead or support executive-level solution workshops and client presentations.
  • Partner with client-facing teams on proposals, RFP responses, and client communications.
  • Support opportunity qualification, including go/no-go decisions and strategic positioning input.

raw.title: Head of Growth, Brand & Product Marketing - Mobile Dating App
raw.excerpt: About Us We are an early-stage startup preparing to launch a mobile dating app competing in the same market as Tinder, Bumble and Hinge.
raw.description:
About Us

We are an early-stage startup preparing to launch a mobile dating app competing in the same market as Tinder, Bumble and Hinge.

Our working culture is fast-moving, hands-on and shaped by short decision cycles, evolving priorities and limited resources. We need someone who enjoys this environment, takes initiative and remains composed and effective when deadlines are tight or plans change.

You will help shape the product, build the brand and bring the app to market. Initially, you will personally deliver much of the work across marketing, content, partnerships and automation. As the business develops, the role may expand to include building and leading a team.

Job Description

You will play a central role in deciding how the app is positioned, how the brand looks and communicates, which audiences we serve and how the product develops to meet their needs.

Working closely with the founding and development teams, you will turn market research, user insights and performance data into recommendations for product priorities, features, onboarding and the overall user experience. Your involvement starts before launch and continues through ongoing product development and growth.

You will also own the marketing strategy and its practical execution. This includes creating the content and systems needed across websites, social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, advertising, influencer campaigns and partnerships.

Exceptional practical expertise in AI is essential. You must be able to use AI to produce high-quality work independently and build reliable content pipelines and automations. n8n and similar tools should be part of your everyday workflow.

Key Responsibilities

  • Shape the product: Research user needs, competitors and market opportunities. Help define the product's value proposition, contribute to roadmap priorities and turn insights into clear feature proposals and briefs.
  • Improve the user experience: Work with the product and development teams on onboarding, activation, engagement, retention and monetization. Help define experiments and assess whether changes improve the experience.
  • Build the brand: Develop brand positioning, messaging, tone of voice, visual direction and storytelling. Translate these into a consistent identity across the app and all marketing channels.
  • Own go-to-market: Develop and execute the pre-launch, launch and growth strategy, including target audiences, market selection, channel priorities and campaign planning.
  • Create marketing content: Personally plan, produce, edit and publish the content the business needs, including websites, landing pages, social posts, advertising assets, graphics, email campaigns, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts and other short-form video.
  • Build content pipelines: Use AI and automation to support research, scripting, visual production, video editing, repurposing, publishing and performance analysis while maintaining creative quality.
  • Develop influencer marketing: Identify suitable creators, establish relationships, negotiate collaborations, develop campaign briefs and measure results.
  • Establish partnerships: Find and develop relevant brand, community, event and distribution partnerships that support awareness, trust and user acquisition.
  • Drive measurable growth: Run acquisition and lifecycle experiments across paid, organic, referral and community channels. Connect marketing activity to activation, retention and commercial outcomes.
  • Automate operations: Build and maintain n8n workflows and integrations that reduce repetitive work across marketing, content production, partnerships and reporting.
  • Support future team growth: As needs and resources develop, help identify hiring priorities, document effective workflows and onboard colleagues or external specialists.

Required Qualifications

  • Substantial hands-on experience launching and growing consumer mobile apps, with a demonstrable personal contribution to apps reaching six-, seven- or eight-figure download totals.
  • Evidence of your own impact: the decisions you owned, the work you delivered and the measurable results achieved.
  • Experience contributing directly to product development through user research, feature definition, prioritization, experimentation and collaboration with designers and developers.
  • Strong brand-building ability, including positioning, messaging, visual judgment and consistent execution across product and marketing.
  • Exceptional practical AI skills across research, writing, design, image generation, video production, editing and content workflows.
  • The ability to independently produce marketing content across multiple formats, including social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, websites and advertising creatives.
  • Hands-on experience with influencer marketing, creator collaborations and partnership development.
  • Strong practical knowledge of n8n or comparable automation platforms, including APIs, webhooks, integrations and reliable workflow operation.
  • A solid understanding of mobile acquisition, attribution, activation, retention, customer acquisition cost and lifetime value.
  • The judgment to prioritize the channels and activities that matter most, balancing quality, speed and limited startup resources.
  • A willingness to take ownership across disciplines and personally execute the work required at an early-stage business.
  • Resilience under pressure, strong prioritization skills and the ability to maintain quality and sound judgment during demanding launch phases.
  • Comfort working with uncertainty, changing priorities and limited startup resources, with the confidence to communicate trade-offs, flag constraints early and propose practical solutions.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Experience with dating apps, social discovery products or consumer platforms that depend on network effects.
  • Growing mobile apps to millions or tens of millions of downloads.
  • Taking a product from pre-launch through launch and subsequent growth.
  • Building local user density, communities and market-by-market launch strategies.
  • Developing a brand from the beginning and carrying it consistently into the product experience.
  • Building a YouTube presence, repeatable video formats or creator-led acquisition channels.
  • Establishing partnerships that delivered measurable distribution, engagement or revenue.
  • Growing from an individual contributor into a team leadership role within a startup.

What We Offer

  • A central role in shaping the product, brand and market launch of a new mobile dating app.
  • Broad responsibility across creative work, product decisions, marketing and growth.
  • The opportunity to build practical systems and workflows from the beginning.
  • The potential to help build and lead a team as the business grows.

How to Apply

Please share your CV and selected examples demonstrating:

  • Mobile apps you helped launch or scale, their download totals and your personal contribution.
  • Product decisions or improvements you helped shape, including the user insight behind them and the outcome.
  • Branding and marketing content you personally created, ideally covering multiple formats.
  • AI-powered content workflows or automations you built.
  • Influencer campaigns or partnerships you developed and the results they produced.

Public links and anonymized examples are welcome. Please respect the confidentiality of previous employers and clients.

raw.description:
Is it surprising to hear that a financial institution of 1.5 million members and over $30 billion in managed assets say that success comes from focusing on people, not profits?

Our “people helping people” philosophy has guided us since 1935, driving our deep commitment to serving our members, communities, and each other. When you join our team, you become part of a purpose-driven organization where your work makes a real difference.

While we’re proud of our history, we’re even more excited about our future. With business and technology transformation on the horizon, there’s never been a better time to be part of BECU.


You bring more than your expertise to your role, and that matters here. Your story, perspectives, and lived experiences help shape belonging at BECU and deepen how we connect with and support our employees, our members, and our communities.


PAY RANGE

The Target Pay Range for this position is $173,500.00-$211,900.00 annually. The full Pay Range is $135,100.00 - $250,600.00 annually. At BECU, compensation decisions are determined using factors such as relevant job-related skills, experience, and education or training. Should an offer for employment be made, we will consider individual qualifications. In addition to your salary, compensation incentives are available for the hired applicant. Incentives are performance based and targets vary by role.

BENEFITS – because people helping people starts with supporting you

  • 401(k) Company Match (up to 3%)

  • 4% annual contribution to your 401(k) by BECU

  • Medical, Dental and Vision (family contributions as well)

  • PTO Program + Exchange Program

  • Tuition Reimbursement Program

  • BECU Cares volunteer time off + donation match

IMPACT YOU’LL MAKE:


As the Director of Mortgage Servicing, you’ll shape the future of mortgage servicing at BECU by providing strategic leadership across all servicing functions. You’ll drive operational excellence, scalability, automation, and continuous improvement while ensuring an exceptional member experience. Through strong partnerships with our sub-servicer, retail banking, credit risk, and other key teams, you’ll bring people, processes, and technology together to build efficient, sustainable operations. You’ll oversee the mortgage servicing lifecycle, including performing and default servicing, member escalations, agency relationships, credit bureau reporting, dispute management, and default resolution.

Your leadership will strengthen vendor partnerships, champion regulatory compliance, optimize financial performance, and transform operations to support BECU’s continued growth. This is your opportunity to make a meaningful difference in our members’ financial lives while helping shape the future of mortgage servicing.

To join our dynamic team in this role, we require candidates to be residents of WA, OR, ID, CA, AZ, TX, NC, SC, GA, or VA. If you’re located in Washington state and within a reasonable driving distance to our Tukwila Headquarters (TFC), we encourage you come into the office on Tuesdays & Wednesdays each week. For those candidates that live outside the commutable distance to TFC and in any of our approved remote work locations, this role will be primarily remote. Remote or onsite, we are committed to ensuring you are fully engaged and included in our collaborative environment.


WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Build and Develop High-Performing Teams: You’ll build, lead, and develop a highly experienced mortgage servicing support team, establishing member-focused policies, practices, and operational standards that support sustainable growth and scalability.
  • Coach, Mentor, and Inspire: You’ll provide ongoing coaching, mentoring, and training to support employee development, strengthen performance, and encourage professional growth. You’ll meet with team members regularly to conduct performance evaluations using BECU competencies and SuccessFactors as performance measures.
  • Set Direction and Drive Accountability: You’ll establish departmental and individual goals aligned with BECU’s operating plan, providing clear direction, ongoing performance monitoring, and the support your team needs to deliver timely and accurate services.
  • Oversee End-to-End Servicing Operations: You’ll provide strategic oversight of mortgage servicing workflows across BECU and its sub-servicer, ensuring strong performance management, contractual compliance, and adherence to established service-level expectations.
  • Drive Process Improvement and Scalability: You’ll identify opportunities to streamline workflows, strengthen operational quality, and improve the member experience through automation, optimization, and scalable servicing solutions.
  • Champion the Member Experience: You’ll evaluate and respond to member and employee feedback regarding remote services and delivery channels, translating insights into effective solutions that improve service delivery and meet evolving member needs.
  • Strengthen Servicing Practices: You’ll maintain a comprehensive understanding of mortgage servicing operations, policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements to ensure consistent, effective, and compliant execution across the organization.
  • Own Financial Performance: You’ll oversee P&L and budget performance, identifying opportunities to optimize revenue, manage expenses, and deliver sustainable long-term business value.
  • Turn Insights into Action: You’ll lead business unit analytics and reporting, evaluate performance data, identify trends, and develop business cases that inform strategic decisions and operational improvements.
  • Monitor Business Performance: You’ll oversee operational performance, key performance indicators (KPIs), vendor and business partner relationships, and service levels to ensure alignment with organizational goals.
  • Champion Regulatory and Investor Compliance: You’ll maintain a strong oversight and internal control environment, proactively managing regulatory changes and ensuring adherence to applicable investor, agency, and regulatory guidelines.
  • Lead Vendor and Sub-Servicer Relationships: You’ll serve as the Credit Union’s primary point of contact for mortgage servicing matters, ensuring consistent, compliant practices across BECU and applicable vendors, including the sub-servicer.
  • Manage Complex Servicing Matters: You’ll oversee member escalations, agency relationship manager engagement, credit bureau management matters, consumer credit bureau reporting, default resolution, and dispute management.
  • Strengthen Operational Controls: You’ll ensure mortgage servicing activities are consistently managed in accordance with contractual obligations, regulatory expectations, and applicable Credit Union standards.
  • Translate Business Needs into Technology Solutions: You’ll lead system administration efforts by translating business requirements into technical specifications and ensuring technology solutions support business objectives.
  • Oversee System Testing and Issue Resolution: You’ll establish business unit protocols for User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and lead the resolution of technology issues impacting mortgage servicing operations.
  • Develop and Maintain Operational Documentation: You’ll lead the creation and ongoing maintenance of business workflows, procedure manuals, and supporting documentation, ensuring effective management of the forms library and compliance with state and federal regulations.
  • Support Broader Business Priorities: You’ll perform additional duties as assigned, bringing your expertise, leadership, and collaborative approach to evolving business needs.

This isn’t just about ticking off tasks on a list. It's about making a significant, positive change in BECU’s journey, where your contributions are valued, and your growth is continually fostered.

WHAT YOU’LL GAIN:

  • Strategic Influence: Shape the direction and future of BECU’s mortgage servicing operations, influencing business strategy and enterprise-wide initiatives.
  • Meaningful Leadership Impact: Lead and develop experienced professionals while building a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Enterprise-Level Visibility: Partner with senior leaders and cross-functional teams across retail banking, credit risk, technology, and operations.
  • Transformation Opportunities: Drive large-scale process improvements, automation, system enhancements, and operational modernization.
  • Purpose-Driven Work: Make a meaningful difference in the financial well-being of members while contributing to the success of a member-owned credit union.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, business operations or related field, or equivalent work or educational experience.
  • 8 years of experience in mortgage servicing operations, mortgage banking, or closely related field.
  • 5 years of people leader experience.
  • Comply with SAFE Act Legislation, which requires annual registration as a Mortgage Loan Originator (MLO).

Desired Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree.
  • Experience in preforming and default management practices.
  • Experience with business reengineering, regulatory compliance, financial reporting/analytics, project management, process improvement and systems administration.
  • Experience leading large-scale project teams.
  • Experience managing GSE, GNMA, and MI claims.
  • Advanced understanding of mortgage agency guidelines and relationships to include FNMA, FHLMC, HUD, VA. FHA, and Private Credit Portfolios.
  • Effective leadership and negotiation skills and the ability to present information and/or training to individuals and groups.

JOIN THE JOURNEY:

Ready to make an indelible impact? Eager to be a part of a collaborative and innovative team where your ideas and contributions don’t just fill a role, but fuel the growth and success of BECU? This is more than a job – it’s a chance to elevate your career, skills, and future, all while contributing to the robust technological landscape of BECU.

Embrace the opportunity to grow with us. Apply now, bring your expertise to the table, and let’s achieve excellence together at BECU. Your journey of influence, innovation, and impactful contribution starts now. #BECU #YourGrowth #BECUJourney

BECU is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status.

You will work closely with our Solutions Consultants, Business Development Representatives, Professional Services and Client Success colleagues, and you will be the voice of the Italian customer inside ServiceChannel, feeding market insight back to Product and Marketing.

This is a role for someone who wants to be the CEO of their own territory. You will join a small, entrepreneurial team where you can roll up your sleeves, get creative in how you open doors and win deals, and see the direct impact of your work on our growth in Italy. You will enjoy close collaboration with colleagues across Europe who share ideas, celebrate wins together and are building this market side by side.   • Drive renewals, upsell and cross-sell across the Italian customer base, identifying expansion into new sites, brands and product modules.

  • Run regular business reviews with key customers, partnering with Client Success and Professional Services to deliver measurable outcomes and resolve escalations.
