What’s Unique About You Is What Makes Us Better! Diversity is our strength and competitive advantage. Bring your flavor to the Papa John's team today!

Job Summary

The Franchise Business Manager works cross functionally with marketing, training and R&D/SCM to assist the international franchisees in designated regions (UK).  Develops a good working relationship with each franchisee and works shoulder-to-shoulder with their organization to build sales, customer satisfaction, market share, and profitability.  Strengthens and protects the company’s brand and communicates the company’s culture and core values.  Provides assistancein: sales growth, new store development, inventory and quality control, store and market productivity and profitability, site selection, construction, equipment installation, store team member training, and marketing.​

Duties and Responsibilities (other duties as assigned)

  • Support the Business Director in increasing the market share and sales of assigned units/markets in accordance with good operations, business practices policies and procedures. This includes helping each franchisee establish individual, specific business plans and building and maintaining trusting and respectful relationships.

  • Assist each franchisee to continuously improve customer satisfaction in each of the franchisee units to ensure the highest levels of product, service and image as defined by the company’s operations manual.

  • Assist the franchisee in gaining access to the resources of the region and the corporation, and ensure follow up as needed.

  • Tracks and analyze monthly P&Ls of all new franchisees for the first 12 months of operation with the finance team. Provide insights into how optimum profits are attained.

  • Work with Finance to complete a financial review no later than 120 days after the franchisee begins business. Review the P&L and cash flow performance of all new franchisees to identify potential problems and recommend solutions. Discuss cash flow and break-even sales as they relate to the overall financial health of the franchisee.

  • Evaluate the need for investment to maintain and improve customer satisfaction, market share and profitability. Evaluate cost-effectiveness of investments with the development team.

  • Support the introduction of new products, procedures, equipment and any other corporate and regional programs.

  • Attendfranchise business meetings as needed. Support the Business Director in presenting the corporation’s perspective and evaluation the franchisees strategies to improve sales and market share, profitability and financial stability, customer satisfaction, strategy planning by the operating partner, investment (three year plan), management depth and strength, people practices and any other business practices related to improving the business and/or expandability.

  • Support the necessary pre-opening preparations to ensure a smooth and efficient unit opening consistent with Papa John’s customer satisfaction standards. This includes coordinating corporate and regional resources to ensure a successful opening and assisting the franchisee in initiating the necessary training and preparation to assure the highest level of Q.S.C. and customer satisfaction during the opening of the new unit.

  • Assist and support the training of new franchisees. Advise regional team of any concern or additional training that would be required.

  • Work with Quality Control Centers to provide quality products, assist with cost control, and compliance visits as required.

  • Ensure the stores are inspected and in compliance to the company’s standards.

  • Support the Business Director in reviewing and approving sites of new stores, as directed, and in coordination with the development department.

Everybody loves pizza, which means they also love the people who are behind the scenes working to deliver it. This is complex and challenging work – but let’s face it – it’s also pizza! If you want a fulfilling career with a company that’s always moving forward, we’re the right place.

raw.description:
Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first.We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. In this fast-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

The Sr. Data Quality Analyst, PDM is responsible for leading strategic and operational initiatives that improve the quality, accuracy, integrity, and governance of provider data across the organization. This role partners closely with Provider Operations, Credentialing, Network Management, Provider Enrollment, Claims, Digital, Compliance, Product, and Technology teams to ensure provider data is accurate, compliant, and consistently represented across all internal and external systems.

This role serves as a subject matter expert in provider data management and provider directory operations, driving data quality programs, root cause analysis, governance practices, monitoring frameworks, and corrective action plans that improve provider directory accuracy and member/provider experience while reducing operational and regulatory risk.

This position combines business process expertise, data analysis, governance leadership, and operational consulting to establish sustainable data quality processes and support provider data transformation initiatives.

Job Duties/Responsibilities:

Provider Data Quality & Integrity

  • Lead provider data quality initiatives across provider lifecycle management processes, including contracting, credentialing, enrollment, maintenance, and termination activities.
  • Develop and maintain data quality frameworks, standards, controls, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Identify data quality issues through analytics, audits, monitoring, and stakeholder feedback.
  • Perform root cause analysis of provider data defects and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
  • Establish ongoing quality assurance and validation processes to improve provider record accuracy.
  • Drive remediation efforts for identifying provider data discrepancies and systemic issues.

Provider Directory Accuracy & Regulatory Compliance

  • Support enterprise provider directory accuracy programs designed to meet regulatory and accreditation requirements.
  • Monitor directory performance metrics and identify trends impacting member and provider experience.
  • Partner with compliance teams to support CMS, state, NCQA, and accreditation-related directory requirements.
  • Design and implement controls that improve provider directory accuracy and reduce regulatory risk.
  • Support readiness activities, audits, corrective action plans, and regulatory reporting.

Data Governance

  • Serve as a business lead for provider data governance initiatives.
  • Define and maintain provider data definitions, business rules, standards, and stewardship responsibilities.
  • Partner with business and technology teams to establish governance processes for provider master data.
  • Facilitate governance forums and stakeholder discussions focused on data ownership, accountability, and quality improvement.
  • Support the development of policies, procedures, and operating models related to provider data management.

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Analyze provider data across multiple source systems to identify quality issues, trends, gaps, and opportunities.
  • Develop dashboards and reporting solutions that provide visibility into data quality performance and operational effectiveness.
  • Measure the impact of data quality initiatives through established metrics and business outcomes.
  • Present findings, recommendations, and progress updates to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Assess end-to-end provider operational processes and identify opportunities to improve data accuracy and operational efficiency.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives using structured problem-solving methodologies.
  • Document current-state and future-state workflows related to provider data management and directory operations.
  • Partner with operational teams to implement sustainable process improvements.
  • Support automation and technology solutions that improve data quality, governance, and operational effectiveness.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Network Management, Credentialing, Provider Enrollment, Claims, Digital, Product, Compliance, and Technology teams.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on provider data-related initiatives and enterprise transformation efforts.
  • Support strategic projects involving provider data modernization, provider lifecycle management, and directory optimization.
  • Facilitate stakeholder alignment and drive resolution of cross-functional data quality issues.
  • Other duties as assigned by your manager.

Job Requirements:

EXPERIENCE

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in healthcare provider operations, provider data management, provider enrollment, credentialing, network operations, or related functions.
  • 3+ years of experience leading data quality, data governance, or data integrity initiatives.
  • Experience supporting provider directory operations and provider data management processes.
  • Experience conducting root cause analysis and developing corrective action plans.
  • Strong knowledge of healthcare provider lifecycle processes and provider master data.
  • Proficiency in Excel, Power BI, and SQL, with experience analyzing provider data, identifying data quality issues, and developing reports and dashboards.
  • Experience with Tableau or similar data visualization tool
  • Must be able to work Pacific Time (PST/PDT) business hours

Preferred:

  • Experience with Quest Analytics, particularly Network Adequacy analysis, monitoring, and reporting
  • Experience within a health plan or managed care environment.
  • Experience supporting CMS, NCQA, accreditation, or regulatory compliance activities.
  • Experience working with provider lifecycle management platforms and provider data repositories.
  • Experience supporting data governance or master data management programs.
  • Experience with quality improvement methodologies and operational transformation initiatives.

EDUCATION

  • Required: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Information Management, Data Analytics, Health Informatics, or related field.
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

SPECIALIZED SKILLS

  • Deep understanding of provider operations, provider data management, and provider directory processes.
  • Knowledge of provider credentialing, enrollment, contracting, and network management workflows.
  • Advanced Excel skills and proficiency with Power BI and SQL for provider data analysis, reporting, and visualization.
  • Ability to analyze large provider datasets, identify data integrity issues, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Ability to translate complex data issues into business recommendations and operational actions.
  • Experience developing KPIs, scorecards, dashboards, and quality monitoring frameworks.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and drive results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Advanced proficiency with data analysis and reporting tools.

Essential Physical Functions:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

1. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee regularly is required to stand, walk, sit, use hand to finger, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; and reach with hands and arms.

2. The employee frequently lifts and/or moves up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.


Employment sponsorship is not available for this position

Pay Range: $98,550.00 - $147,825.00

Pay range may be based on a number of factors including market location, education, responsibilities, experience, etc.

raw.description:
At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!

As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets. At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.

At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.

Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!

Your Role:

Global Regulatory Project Lead

As the Global Regulatory Project Lead, you will be a key individual contributor at the forefront of our innovation pipeline, guiding the regulatory strategy for novel farm and companion animal products. You will serve as the dedicated regulatory expert on global project teams, shaping development from the ground up and leading direct negotiations with agencies like the U.S. Food and Drug Administration's Center for Veterinary Medicine (CVM). This role requires a strategic professional who can navigate complex agency interactions, influence cross-functional partners (including Global Research and Development (R&D), Sales and Marketing, Supply Chain, Manufacturing & Quality, Finance, and Technical Services), and ensure our submissions in the United States (US), European Union (EU), and other first-wave countries are successful.


Your Responsibilities:

  • Guide the design and development of the global regulatory strategy for development projects, with a primary focus on CVM/FDA submissions.
  • Serve as the dedicated regulatory subject matter expert on development teams, representing the regulatory viewpoint and providing risk/benefit evaluations to guide project strategy.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for and lead direct engagements with regulatory agencies (e.g., CVM, European Medicines Agency (EMA)), including pre-submission meetings and negotiations.
  • Partner with R&D to develop and implement clinical trial submission plans, ensuring alignment with the overall regulatory strategy.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to provide technical leadership on Quality, Safety, and Efficacy sections for regulatory submissions.
  • Proactively identify and communicate project-specific regulatory risks and opportunities to the development team and leadership.
  • Comply with all company local and global policies including quality frameworks, Code of Conduct, anti-discrimination, harassment, and health, safety, and environment (HSE) policies.

What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):

  • Education: A Master’s degree or higher in veterinary medicine, biology, infectious diseases, immunology, animal science, or a related field.
  • Experience: At least 10 years of relevant experience in the animal health industry, with direct regulatory affairs experience in veterinary pharmaceuticals.
  • Regulatory Expertise: Demonstrated experience leading direct submissions and negotiations with regulatory agencies, with a strong preference for the U.S. Food and Drug Administration's Center for Veterinary Medicine (CVM).
  • Guidance & Influence: Proven ability to serve as the primary regulatory expert on cross-functional project teams in a global environment, with exceptional communication, negotiation, and influencing skills.

What will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications):

  • Direct regulatory experience with both farm animal and companion animal products.
  • Broad experience with global registration processes, particularly leading first-wave submissions in the European Union and other key markets simultaneously.
  • Experience navigating novel regulatory pathways for innovative products.
  • A strong understanding of risk assessment and risk management fundamentals.
  • Knowledge of Continuous Improvement methodologies (e.g., Six Sigma, Lean).

Additional Information:

  • Travel: 10-25%
  • Location: This is a US-based role. It can be based at our Global Headquarters in Indianapolis, IN (Hybrid), or be a remote position for the right candidate.

Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown underrecognized groups are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Elanco we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive work environment. If you think you might be a good fit for a role but don't necessarily meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this role or other roles!


Elanco Benefits and Perks:

We offer a comprehensive benefits package focusing on financial, physical, and mental well-being while encouraging our employees to pursue our purpose! Some highlights include:

  • Multiple relocation packages
  • Two weeklong shutdowns (mid-summer and year-end) in the US (in addition to PTO)
  • 8-week parental leave
  • 9 Employee Resource Groups
  • Annual bonus offering
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Up to 6% 401K matching

Elanco currently anticipates that the base salary for this position could range from $118,000 to $197,000 depending partly on the successful candidate's qualifications, including education and experience. Full-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending partly on company and individual performance). Additionally, Elanco offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees that includes a company-matching 401(k); vacation benefits; eligibility for medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug benefits; flexible benefits (e.g., healthcare and/or dependent day care flexible spending accounts); life insurance and death benefits; certain time off and leave of absence benefits; and well-being benefits (e.g., employee assistance program, fitness benefits, and employee clubs and activities). Of course, the compensation is subject to change and could be higher or lower than the range described above. Elanco reserves the right to amend, modify, or terminate its compensation and benefit programs in its sole discretion, and Elanco's compensation practices and guidelines will apply regarding the details of any promotion or transfer of Elanco employees. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the role is filled.


Elanco is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status

These tools help ensure a consistent, structured evaluation, but they do not make hiring decisions. All decisions involve a human reviewer. Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of mobile development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile App Developer with strong Kotlin Multiplatform expertise and an excellent background in native Android development with Kotlin.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our application, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development. Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build Android applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our Android application using Kotlin and Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Design shared application logic and integrate it with platform-specific functionality.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical mobile challenges such as permissions, background execution, battery consumption, connectivity, and differences between devices.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and resolve problems that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and understandable explanations.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production Android applications with Kotlin.
  • Strong practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform, including shared code, platform-specific integrations, and the boundaries between them.
  • Solid understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack Compose, coroutines, Flow, application lifecycle, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills and the ability to investigate problems across application code, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain why an implementation is appropriate.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, sensor data, and proximity detection.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and signal-strength limitations.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful mobile development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing Android applications and Kotlin Multiplatform solutions.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio or GitHub links are welcome where available.

About Us

We are a Latvia-based startup building a finance function that combines accurate accounting, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and practical AI automation.

We are looking for a finance professional who can personally manage our accounting, configure the systems supporting it and use AI agents to carry out the work more efficiently.

Job Description

You will personally perform and take ownership of our accounting and financial operations, using AI agents to support your work. Your responsibilities will cover daily bookkeeping, reconciliations, closing, financial reporting, cash planning and applicable Latvian tax reporting.

You will personally carry out the complete migration from QuickBooks to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, using AI agents to support your work. You will be responsible for all implementation tasks, from planning and data preparation through configuration, import, validation and go-live. No external implementation partners will be involved. As part of preparing and importing the data, you will review the complete accounting records for the past five years, identify gaps and errors, and reconcile the migrated data to the source records. You must be comfortable both doing the accounting and setting up the accounting system.

AI agents will assist with document processing, transaction preparation, matching, reconciliation and reporting. You will define their tasks, supervise their execution, investigate exceptions and verify their outputs. You remain responsible for the accuracy and completeness of the work.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform day-to-day bookkeeping, accounts payable and receivable, invoicing, expense accounting and bank reconciliations.
  • Complete month-end and year-end closing, balance sheet reconciliations, accruals and supporting documentation.
  • Set up, configure and maintain Business Central, including the chart of accounts, posting groups, dimensions, VAT setup, bank accounts, accounting periods and relevant financial workflows.
  • Personally execute the complete migration from QuickBooks to Business Central, including data extraction, account and tax mapping, cleansing, system configuration, trial imports, reconciliation and go-live. Review all accounting records for the past five years during migration preparation and import, investigate missing or incorrect entries, document corrections and preserve supporting documents and a traceable audit trail.
  • Prepare and manage applicable Latvian tax and statutory reporting, including VAT, corporate income tax, payroll-related obligations and VID/EDS processes.
  • Handle international customers, suppliers, contractors, foreign currencies and cross-border transactions.
  • Manage cash-flow forecasts, budgets, runway monitoring and management reporting.
  • Prepare payments and administer payroll and contractor payments within agreed approval controls.
  • Configure, instruct and supervise AI agents supporting accounting workflows; improve their performance through clear instructions, reliable source data and systematic verification.
  • Maintain traceability from original documents to accounting entries, resolve exceptions and protect confidential financial information.
  • Identify practical opportunities to reduce costs, improve financial controls and apply lawful tax efficiencies.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience personally performing the full accounting cycle for companies in one or more European countries.
  • Practical experience with accounting, taxation and statutory reporting in one or more European countries, and the ability to apply and verify Latvian requirements. Direct Latvian accounting and VID/EDS experience is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience independently setting up and configuring Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central for real accounting operations, with the ability to personally execute a complete accounting-system migration.
  • The ability to translate business requirements into appropriate accounting configuration and verify that postings, reconciliations and reports work correctly.
  • Practical experience using AI agents or AI-supported automation in finance or accounting, including supervising outputs and handling errors.
  • Strong spreadsheet and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate incomplete records and reconcile inconsistent data.
  • Independent working habits, ownership of deadlines and clear communication with the founder.
  • Professional working proficiency in English and the ability to work effectively with Latvian-language financial documents and reporting requirements.
  • A relevant accounting or finance qualification, or equivalent substantial practical experience.

Especially Valuable Experience

What We Offer

  • Responsibility for both the accounting work and the systems supporting it.
  • The opportunity to shape how Business Central and AI agents work together in a startup.
  • A practical environment where reliable execution, sensible automation and cost awareness matter.

Remote Working Arrangement

You will organize your work independently, communicate progress clearly and meet agreed accounting and reporting deadlines. Financial systems and confidential information must be handled securely.

This is a full-time role with flexible working hours. You will organize your schedule around agreed accounting and reporting deadlines.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and briefly describe:

  • The European countries in which you have personally handled accounting and tax reporting, and your specific responsibilities.
  • A Business Central implementation or accounting-system migration you personally executed, including the setup, data migration and validation you performed yourself, and any experience with QuickBooks or historical accounting reviews.
  • How you have used AI agents or automation to perform accounting work and verify its accuracy.

Use anonymized examples and clearly distinguish your own work from work delivered by others.

  • Provides initial triage, investigation and ensures fast turnaround times on issue/incident resolution.

raw.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.


Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
  • Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
  • An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution.
  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

In Abbott’s Electrophysiology (EP) business, we’re advancing the treatment of heart disease through breakthrough medical technologies in atrial fibrillation, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.


What You’ll Work On

Responsible for helping lead our EP strategy within an assigned territory to accomplish planned objectives as to sales volume, market penetration, and profitability. As team leader, coordinates the activities of Direct Sales Representatives, Clinical Specialists, and Associates to support ablation procedures using Abbott EP products. Fully accountable for all performance metrics of quality, compliance, cost and delivery within the territory. Responsible for leading, facilitating, and directing the activities of subordinates by hosting quarterly business plan meetings and annual performance reviews for each direct report. Responsible for managing profitability and continuing to improve our operating expenses as a percentage of sales and increase our revenue per head.

Territory Managers will also call on physicians, medical laboratories, hospitals and hospital management to sell a variety of Abbott USD medical devices in an assigned territory. Will work strategically with the Regional Sales Director to grow new business, maintain current business and assess opportunities across the territory. May coordinate with the Regional Sales Director to hire, promote and develop employees in the territory. Exercises judgment in planning and organizing work; monitors performance and reports status. Uses best business practices to ensure success in areas of responsibility. Ensures employee compliance with Abbott USD policies and practices.


  • Supervises direct reports and selling activity within assigned territory.
  • Coordinates ablation schedules for Direct Sales Representatives and Clinical Specialists assigned to the territory.
  • Partners with hospital management, physicians and others in the assigned territory to influence decisions on purchasing of the Company’s products and addresses any customer questions and concerns.
  • Participates in the contracting process of company products.
  • Sets a strategy to help the region hit it’s Capital Sales targets within the territory each year.
  • Provides medical professionals with information and training on the use of Company products and with staff education, in-services and technical troubleshooting.
  • Abides by all HIPPA rules in order to maintain patient privacy in all business activities.
  • Responsible for the management of any trunk stock located within assigned territory.
  • Partners with the Research Team to assist in the implementation of studies in the territory.
  • Analyzes sales statistics, prepares business plans, and performs required administrative sales duties for the territory including, but not limited to, submitting expense reports, creating a daily procedure schedule for the team, submitting contract requests in Salesforce, assisting with corporate meeting appointments, and making travel plans for conferences.
  • May attend trade shows where new products and technologies are showcased and conferences to meet other sales representatives and clients and discuss new product developments.
  • Works with the Regional Sales Director and Enterprise Accounts team as needed to achieve Region-wide and system-wide corporate goals.
  • Remains current on developments in field(s) of expertise, regulatory requirements, as well as industry trends.
  • Resolves and/or facilitates resolution of problems including identifying causes to prevent re-occurrence.
  • Support all Company initiatives as identified by management and in support of Quality Management Systems (QMS), Environmental Health Systems (EHS), and other regulatory requirements.
  • Complies with U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations, other regulatory requirements, Company policies, operating procedures, processes, and task assignments. Maintains positive and cooperative communications and collaboration with all levels of employees, customers, contractors, and vendors.
  • Performs other related duties and responsibilities, on occasion, as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5 years of EP or CRM sales experience required.
  • A comprehensive understanding of Electrophysiology.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field or equivalent and typically four plus years of progressively more responsible sales experience, including experience with medical devices.
  • Working knowledge of domestic regulations relative to the medical device industry.
  • A demonstrated ability to analyze and evaluate technologically complex devices; ability to work with and direct others effectively; ability to prepare and present strong written and verbal communications; and familiarity with medical device industry policies, operations and procedures.
  • Documented record of delivering sales/marketing information which adds value to management's decision-making process.
  • Ability to establish and maintain good working relationships with customers, physicians, hospital administrators, government agencies, medical groups, and other sales representatives.
  • Demonstrated verbal and written communication, negotiation, sales, interpersonal and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work in a highly matrixed and geographically diverse business environment.
  • Verification that you will satisfy all vendor credentialing requirements, which may include vaccination for COVID-19. If you require a medical or religious accommodation from these requirements or if you would like to understand more about these requirements, please advise HR so that we can provide additional information and if needed, we can explore any needed accommodation(s).

Preferred Qualifications

  • An engineering degree is highly preferred.
  • Prefer an advanced credential in a relevant discipline/concentration. Professional certification or designation.
  • Experience working in a broader enterprise/cross division business unit model preferred.

Job Summary

The Senior Digital Marketing Specialist supports Flowserve’s broader marketing strategy by leading the execution and optimization of digital content across the corporate website, organic social media, paid media, and digital campaigns. This role helps promote Flowserve’s products, portfolio, services, industry positioning, and growth initiatives through engaging, customer-focused digital experiences. Working closely with the Digital Marketing Manager and cross-functional partners, the specialist will translate business priorities and technical information into compelling web, social, and campaign content. The role requires a creative, data-informed marketer who understands the purpose behind each post, page, and campaign activity.


Responsibilities & Requirements

  • Develop, implement, and optimize web content plans that support Flowserve’s brand, product portfolio, services, business priorities, lead-generation programs, and digital marketing initiatives.
  • Create, edit, publish, and maintain website content and landing pages in Drupal, using approved components and basic HTML/CSS to ensure accuracy, consistency, accessibility, and a strong user experience.
  • Support website operations and enhancement initiatives, including content audits, migrations, page refreshes, product launches, acquisition integrations, and requirements gathering for more complex changes.
  • Recommend improvements to content hierarchy, navigation, calls to action, search visibility, and customer journeys using SEO, generative engine optimization (GEO), UX, accessibility, and conversion best practices.
  • Manage assigned organic social media activities, including maintaining editorial calendars, reviewing scheduled posts, coordinating approvals, publishing content, monitoring engagement, and routing questions or sensitive issues to the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Partner with internal teams to develop creative, channel-appropriate content—including copy, imagery, video, and visual assets—that brings energy and relevance to Flowserve’s industrial and manufacturing audiences.
  • Develop web, landing-page, social, and paid-media content to support advertising, demand-generation, branding, industry-positioning, and new-growth-area campaigns.
  • Review and analyze website, social, search, and lead-source performance to identify content gaps, assess traffic quality and conversion opportunities, and recommend measurable improvements.

Preferred Experience/Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
  • 5–7+ years of hands-on digital marketing experience, ideally supporting B2B industrial, manufacturing, energy, technology, or similarly technical businesses.
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing across websites, social media, paid media, campaign promotion, lead generation, and content performance measurement.
  • Excellent writing, editing, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical information into clear, customer-focused messages.
  • Proven experience developing and executing web content plans, social media strategies, and digital campaigns with a clear understanding of the business purpose behind each activity.
  • Experience managing corporate social channels, particularly LinkedIn, including editorial planning, scheduling, publishing, engagement monitoring, and performance reporting.
  • Strong CMS experience, preferably Drupal, including page building, content publishing, reusable components, and basic HTML/CSS.
  • Working knowledge of Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager; experience using Salesforce, Conductor, Acquia Asset Manager, and Pardot is preferred.
  • Deep understanding of SEO/GEO, accessibility, UX, content governance, conversion optimization, and quality assurance across devices and channels.
  • Curiosity and comfort with emerging technologies, including GenAI and its application to content discovery, brand visibility, and digital marketing operations.
  • Creative, collaborative, and self-directed mindset, with the confidence to bring forward ideas, challenge conventional approaches constructively, and make technical content engaging for customers.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines with increasing autonomy.
  • Ability to travel up to 10%.
  • Ability to support implementation of lead generation plans and understanding how to tie marketing activities to sales.

raw.description:
Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English. Your language skills and technical background decide where you fit.

About the project

Welo Data is helping evaluate how well AI coding agents perform when the instructions they receive are written in languages other than English. Agents are given a real software engineering task in a code repository, and automated tests check whether they solved it. The code, repositories and tests stay exactly as they are. Only the human-written instructions change language, so the quality of every instruction directly affects the result.

About the roles

There are two roles on this project. We place you in one of them based on your experience & skillsets.

  • Translator: translate English software engineering task briefs into the target language. You keep every requirement, constraint and success condition, and you leave commands, file paths, API names, code and test conditions exactly as written in English. This role suits people with a stronger technical background, and translation experience is a plus.
  • Reviewer: compare each translation with the English source, check that nothing is missing, added or changed in meaning, correct errors, and log each correction by error type. This role suits people with strong translation, editing or review experience and enough technical familiarity to read code context.

Who we are looking for

  • Native or near-native writing in the target language, and strong reading ability in English.
  • Either professional experience in translation, editing, review or technical writing, or a software background combined with excellent writing in the target language
  • Comfort reading technical text. Coding experience is a strong plus for the translation role and helpful for the review role.
  • Close attention to detail. In this project, a dropped clause can make a task fail.

Project at a glance

  • Project duration: one week since the mid of November
  • Languages: Japanese
  • Project time commitment: 6 hours per person
  • Project compensation: US$75 - US$90 per hour
  • Work location: fully remote in Japan

How selection works (major steps)

  1. Screening questions: about 2 minutes. They cover your language background, translation and review experience, which programming languages you know and how well, and your availability.
  2. Language test: short exercises in the target language.
  3. Programming skills assessment: you will be invited to another opportunity, in the programming language you know best (Rust, Go, Python, or TypeScript / JavaScript). It confirms your technical level and places you in a language track.
  4. Financial Onboarding & Role placement: complete the financial onboarding with Welo Data. In the meanwhile, you will be informed about the decision whether you are placed in the initial translation role or the review role.
  5. Production: once you finish all steps above, our project team will contact you for production.

raw.description:
Overview

Atlassian is seeking a Principal Machine Learning Engineer to set the technical direction for AI agent quality in Studio. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll define how we measure whether agents built on our platform are doing good work, and lead the work to make them better.

Responsibilities

Your future team

Studio is where Atlassian customers build, run and manage AI agents under the Rovo brand. Rovo Agents is a model-agnostic cloud agent platform. Teams give an agent instructions, knowledge, tools and skills, then put it to work in Jira and Confluence, inside automation rules, or as an autonomous agent that works on its own.

Because customers build these agents themselves, quality can't be checked once before release. Every agent has its own instructions, data and tools, and any of them can be misconfigured or connected to a tool that fails. We ask three questions of every agent: did it understand and follow the task, did it use its tools correctly and report honestly what it did, and did the result actually help?

The team is software and machine learning engineers based in Sydney and Melbourne, with remote options. We work closely with product, data science and Atlassian's central AI teams. This is applied ML on real agentic systems in production.

What you'll do

  • Own the agent quality architecture. Define what we measure, how production traffic is sampled, how it is judged, and how results roll up without hiding important failure modes behind one score.

  • Design for cost and accuracy. Decide which quality questions can be answered with deterministic checks, which need behavioral heuristics, and which need contextual model-based judgment. Build the evaluation system around those decisions.

  • Architect evaluation and experimentation. Define the benchmarks, datasets, evaluation environments and observability needed to assess agent behavior and task success. Guide teams in building reproducible experiments and calibrated evaluators that inform model, prompt and launch decisions.

  • Make quality part of how we ship. Set up regression gates and pre-release checks for agent, prompt and model changes, and drift detection on production traffic.

  • Lead the hardest quality problems hands-on. Examples include agent selection and routing, tool-use reliability, and quality for agents that run inside automations with no user present to give feedback.

  • Lead technical direction across teams. Set a multi-quarter roadmap with product and data science, partner with central AI teams and model providers, and take accountability for measurable improvements in agent quality.

  • Grow ML craft. Mentor engineers through design reviews and hands-on work in a team made up mostly of software engineers.

Qualifications

Your background

On the first day, we'll expect you to have:

  • 6+ years in ML/AI engineering, with deep expertise in LLMs, NLP, information retrieval or recommendation.

  • A proven track record of building and shipping LLM-powered or agentic systems used by real customers, and improving them over time through measurement.

  • Strong evaluation and experimental skills. You can design useful benchmarks, assess label and judge quality, recognize leakage and confounding factors, and connect offline results to product impact.

  • Strong software and data engineering skills, with the ability to validate designs in code and work deeply with data pipelines, model serving and production observability.

  • Strong product judgment: you can find the real problem, define measurable outcomes, and choose between deterministic, classical ML and LLM-based approaches.

  • A record of influencing technical direction across multiple teams and mentoring senior engineers.

  • Regular use of AI tools in your own work, and the ability to turn new research into production results.

  • Sound judgment about trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, privacy and access control.

It's great, but not required, if you have:

  • Experience building agent platforms where customers configure the agents.

  • Experience with trajectory-level evaluation of multi-step agents, or prompt and agent optimization.

  • Experience in enterprise SaaS.

  • A master's or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning or a related field.

About ZRG:

For nearly 25 years, ZRG has been helping our clients move forward in their industries and our candidates move forward in their careers. We started as a boutique retained executive search firm with a handful of talent professionals. Today, we are a global talent advisory firm, providing people solutions for our clients' most complex talent issues. Our core offerings include revolutionary, data-based, executive search focusing on senior leadership around the world. Our suite of on-demand talent offerings helps backfill open roles and address project-based work with specialized talent. Our consulting and advisory solutions focus on key issues like culture, strategic alignment, coaching, and sales optimization.

Leveraging our global platform of over 500 teammates with a tech-powered solution kit, ZRG is a leading talent advisory firm for leading-edge clients. We are natively global in our reach with practitioners and entire divisions working around the world in the UK, Europe, the Middle East/North Africa, Australia, the Asia Pacific, and North and South America. Our team collaborates across geographic boundaries and industry verticals to bring you multiple solutions.

About Aspen Leadership Group, a ZRG Company:

As part of ZRG’s Education and Social Impact practice, Aspen Leadership Group, a ZRG Company specializes in placing fundraisers and administrative C-suite leaders at every level of nonprofit organizations. Our search services and leader-to-leader consulting focus on building teams that strengthen revenue and drive increased impact. We are the top firm in the world in placing fundraising leaders and one of the most experienced firms in the entire nonprofit sector.

We work with clients ranging from large, multi-national and multi-billion-dollar organizations to small, local organizations—in education, healthcare, arts and culture, social services, and conservation, among other areas. Aspen Leadership Group team members focus exclusively on nonprofit (including higher education) executive search, team building, leadership consulting, and thought partnership.

Role Summary:

Senior Associates are an integral part of the executive search team, responsible for providing essential support to Managing Directors in all aspects of executing search engagements, executing client engagements at a high level.

The executive search process begins from the conception of the search until the placement is complete, with each stage playing a pivotal role in the process. Before the client engagement begins, Senior Associates may also be involved in developing a proposal to present to the client. Once the search is earned, you will assist the team in analyzing and mapping out the most effective search strategy based on clients’ needs and requirements.

When potential candidates are identified through multiple rounds of research, the Senior Associate conducts outreach and initial phone interviews, helping the team gather more market intel in the field and develop a strong pipeline of candidates. Once candidates are identified as the best fit for the profile of the position, the Senior Associate will develop a presentation for the client using tools and software developed by ZRG.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the key driver of client service delivery, acting as a client ambassador in all phases of the search engagement;
  • Anticipate client needs, acting proactively to provide exceptional client experience;
  • Collaborate with team to ensure execution of tailored search strategy based on client needs;
  • Play a key role in directing and calibrating research with our research team;
  • Identify leads directly utilizing channels not covered by our research team;
  • Handle outreach, engagement, and initial interviewing resulting in generating candidates for search engagements, interacting via phone, email, and in-person conversations to identify top targets;
  • Partner with engagement leaders to interview and assess candidates against position specifications and may draft candidate interview summaries;
  • May present candidates to clients alongside engagement leaders;
  • Communicate effectively between client and candidate as the process moves towards an offer, managing expectations and operating on behalf of the client;
  • May at times, participate in business development meetings to inform potential clients and provide a point of view on the firm’s capabilities;
  • Develop metrics, reporting mechanisms, and continuous improvement strategies to measure, track, and report against goals effectively.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant executive search or recruitment experience or equivalent working experience;
  • A high level of responsiveness to both internal and external requests, with a genuine customer service mindset;
  • An undergraduate degree or equivalent working experience
  • Collaborative and team oriented;
  • Experience researching and seeking to understand market trends;
  • Tech-savvy - proficient in Microsoft Office with intermediate to advanced Excel capabilities;
  • Able to quickly learn and adopt new tools and databases (ie Salesforce).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Comprehensive knowledge of the industrial industry.

Compensation is tailored to each individual based on their skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The rates mentioned in this posting represent only the base hourly, monthly, or annual pay and exclude potential bonuses, equity, or sales incentives, where applicable. Beyond base pay, we provide a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Embracing New Ideas: Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.

The Opportunity:


CAREER OPPORTUNITY OFFERING:

  • Paid Certifications
  • Tuition Reimbursement

  • Career Advancement
  • This position pays $63,100 – $94,650 based on experience

Ensemble Health Partners is seeking a Privacy Analyst to join the Privacy Department. This role is designed as a core privacy position focused on supporting privacy operations, incident review, compliance monitoring, and program administration across a complex healthcare environment.


The Privacy Analyst will help review privacy incidents, maintain documentation, support privacy risk analyses, and contribute to policy and training updates. The role offers broad exposure to HIPAA, healthcare operations, data governance, and the practical application of privacy requirements in a fast-moving, technology-enabled business setting.


This position is especially well suited for candidates who are intellectually curious, analytical, and highly comfortable with technology. We welcome applicants who enjoy learning new systems quickly, working with data, understanding how digital tools shape business operations, and exploring how AI-enabled solutions can be used responsibly to solve real problems.

Key Responsibilities:


Privacy Investigations:


  • Support investigations of suspected privacy incidents and breaches involving protected health information and other sensitive data under the direction of senior team members.
  • Gather facts, review available records, and coordinate with business partners to help determine scope, root cause, and required follow-up actions.
  • Assist with incident documentation, client support materials, and internal communications related to privacy matters, with senior review for complex issues.
  • Maintain investigation records, evidence, and the privacy incident log in accordance with retention requirements.
  • Identify patterns and recurring issues from incidents, including those involving new technologies or process gaps, and escalate trends to senior team members.

Privacy Operations & Data Risk Support:


  • Support day-to-day privacy operations, including privacy reviews, documentation, issue tracking, and follow-up activities across the organization.
  • Assist with privacy risk analyses involving sensitive data, business processes, and new or changing technologies.
  • Review data flows, system use cases, and operational activities to help identify privacy risks and escalation needs.
  • Help maintain privacy logs, intake records, issue trackers, and program documentation with a high degree of accuracy and organization.
  • Contribute to reviews involving digital tools, workflow automation, analytics platforms, and AI-enabled solutions to help ensure privacy requirements are considered early in the design and implementation process.
  • Monitor regulatory, industry, and technology developments and summarize practical implications for the privacy team.
  • Support the continuous improvement of templates, workflows, trackers, and checklists used in privacy operations and governance activities, with an eye toward efficiency, usability, and scalability.

Program Support:


  • Contribute to privacy policies, standards, training materials, and internal guidance documents.
  • Support privacy risk assessments, audits, monitoring activities, and regulatory response preparation.
  • Track metrics and help prepare reports, dashboards, and status updates that turn privacy activity into useful insights for leaders and business partners.

Required Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 2–4 years of professional experience in privacy, compliance, healthcare operations, information governance, information security, risk, or a related analytical, operations, or technology-focused role.
  • Working knowledge of privacy principles, data handling expectations, and risk awareness in regulated or data-intensive environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to produce clear, organized written documentation such as case notes, issue summaries, policy drafts, reports, or research findings.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical or regulatory topics to non-technical audiences.
  • Sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to handle sensitive information.
  • Interest in professional development and willingness to pursue privacy certification such as CIPP/US, CIPM, CHPC, or related credentials.

Experience We Love:

  • Experience with HIPAA Privacy compliance in a hospital, health system, or other regulated healthcare setting.
  • Experience supporting healthcare compliance, privacy investigations, audit, security, data governance, or other work requiring strong critical thinking and organization.
  • Strong digital fluency and comfort using modern workplace tools, case-management systems, spreadsheets, dashboards, or data analysis tools.
  • Curiosity about emerging technology and interest in how AI, automation, and data-driven tools can be used responsibly in healthcare and business operations.
  • Experience reviewing operational workflows, business processes, or data practices to identify risks and recommend practical next steps.
  • Relevant certifications, coursework, internships, or project work in privacy, cybersecurity, data governance, analytics, health informatics, or responsible AI.
  • Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences.
  • This is a remote position; however, candidates must be willing and able to travel to and work onsite at client, temporary, or corporate office locations as business needs require.

Success in This Role Looks Like


First 6 months —  Learning Ensemble's privacy workflows, tools, and business environment; supporting investigations and routine privacy work; building familiarity with healthcare data, issue tracking, and core compliance processes.

6–12 months —  Handling standard privacy analyst responsibilities with increasing independence; contributing to risk reviews, reporting, policy and training updates, and process improvements; becoming a dependable resource for privacy operations and technology-related questions.

12–24 months —  Operating confidently as a high-performing Privacy Analyst, helping improve team processes, supporting more complex issues, and building a strong foundation for growth into senior privacy, compliance, governance, data risk, or responsible AI roles.

Why This Role Matters


This role matters because strong privacy programs need people who can combine sound judgment, attention to detail, and confidence with modern technology. The Privacy Analyst will help protect sensitive information, support responsible innovation, and improve the systems and workflows that make a complex healthcare business run well. For early-career professionals, this role offers meaningful exposure to healthcare privacy, digital operations, data risk, and the practical use of AI and automation in the workplace.

It is a strong opportunity for candidates who want more than a traditional compliance role—especially those who enjoy working across policy, operations, systems, and emerging technology. This position offers hands-on experience, visible impact, and a chance to build a career at the intersection of privacy, healthcare, data, and innovation.

Five-time winner of “Best in KLAS” 2020-2022, 2024-2025

Black Book Research's Top Revenue Cycle Management Outsourcing Solution 2021-2024

22 Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) MAP Awards for High Performance in Revenue Cycle 2019-2024

raw.description:
PROJECT OVERVIEW

Our client is a leading commercial real estate advisory and services provider, supporting large institutional investors, global corporations, and other owners and occupiers. Their mission is to make leasing, buying, and selling properties across the retail, office, multifamily, industrial, student housing, and hospitality sectors easier and more efficient.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

  • Own and drive the technical architecture for complex, cross-team data initiatives spanning ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving layers.

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, high-performance data pipelines and distributed data platforms in a cloud-native environment (Azure, AWS, or GCP).

  • Architect and lead enterprise Master Data Management (MDM), including golden records, entity resolution, data domains, reference and hierarchy management, and stewardship, to create trusted, authoritative data across the business.

  • Architect and integrate agentic AI and LLM-driven workflows (autonomous agents, RAG pipelines, AI copilots) into data platforms and pipelines to drive efficiency and new capabilities.

  • Build and support the data foundations for machine learning and AI, including feature stores, vector stores, embeddings, and ML/LLMOps pipelines.

  • Design and deliver backend data services and APIs (REST/GraphQL), and contribute across the stack to expose curated datasets to applications, analytics, and BI consumers.

  • Set engineering standards and best practices for data quality, modeling, testing, observability, and deployment across the organization, including responsible use of AI-assisted development tools.

  • Establish data governance, lineage, cataloging, and quality frameworks across the data estate.

  • Lead technical design reviews and provide architectural guidance to multiple engineering and data teams.

  • Partner with product, analytics, and engineering leadership to translate business strategy into scalable data roadmaps, including AI-driven capabilities.

  • Identify and resolve systemic performance, reliability, and scalability issues across the data stack.

  • Mentor and coach senior and mid-level engineers, raising the technical bar across the organization on data engineering, MDM, and AI practices.

  • Drive adoption of modern frameworks, tools, and engineering practices, including agentic AI and LLM tooling, to improve delivery velocity and platform resilience.

  • Maintain awareness of emerging technologies and industry trends, particularly in agentic AI, master data management, and modern data platforms, and assess their applicability to the business.

IF YOU ARE

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, MIS, or related field preferred.

  • 12+ years of experience in data engineering or software engineering, with demonstrated experience architecting data platforms and pipelines at scale.

  • Expert-level SQL and strong proficiency in Python (Scala or Java a plus) for large-scale data processing and transformation.

  • Deep experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, Synapse, BigQuery, Redshift) and cloud-native architecture patterns.

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, data modeling (dimensional, data vault, lakehouse), and ETL/ELT architecture.

  • Hands-on experience designing and implementing Master Data Management (MDM) solutions, including entity resolution, match/merge, golden records, and reference/hierarchy management (e.g., Informatica, Reltio, Profisee, or similar).

  • Hands-on experience building or integrating agentic AI systems, LLM-powered applications, RAG pipelines, or AI agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, MCP).

  • Experience building backend data services and APIs (REST/GraphQL), with comfort working across the full stack.

  • Strong background with both relational (SQL) and NoSQL data stores, plus data lake/lakehouse formats (Delta, Iceberg, Parquet).

  • Deep understanding of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and DevOps/DataOps practices.

  • Proven track record of leading large-scale technical initiatives across multiple teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and influence technical direction without direct reporting authority.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with data governance, lineage, and cataloging tools (e.g., Unity Catalog, Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Alation).

  • Experience designing multi-agent systems, tool-calling architectures, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines.

  • Experience with event-driven architectures and streaming/real-time data processing (e.g., Kafka, Event Hubs, Kinesis, Flink, Spark Structured Streaming).

  • Experience building the data layer for ML/AI, including feature stores, vector databases, embeddings, and ML/LLMOps.

  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and workflow orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, dbt).

  • Prior experience in commercial real estate, fintech, or operations/transaction systems.

  • Track record of speaking, writing, or open-source contributions that demonstrate technical thought leadership, especially in applied AI or data.

AS AN OPINOV8R, YOU WILL HAVE

  • Digital-First Approach:Great talent knows no borders! You can work from wherever you are — we hire and collaborate with professionals worldwide.

  • Remote Work Model:Balance your professional and personal life with our flexible working conditions, empowering you to deliver your best from anywhere.

  • Exciting Projects:Dive into impactful projects across industries that challenge and spark creativity.

  • Boost Your Expertise:Grow your career with continuous learning, development opportunities, and hands-on experience.

  • Join the Best Team Ever:Collaborate with our diverse and cross-cultural team of passionate technologists and creative thinkers.

HOW’S THE HIRING PROCESS GOING

We strive to make our hiring process smooth and transparent to find the perfect match for both sides. Steps may differ depending on the role, but here’s what to expect:

  • Initial Interview: If your background fits the role, we’ll invite you for an interview with a Talent Acquisition Specialist.

  • Technical Interview:Depending on the position, you may complete a technical assessment or test task.

  • Client Interview:You can expect 1 or 2 Client Interviews.

  • Final Decision:After all steps, we’ll get back to you with the result and next steps.

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, high-performance data pipelines and distributed data platforms in a cloud-native environment (Azure, AWS, or GCP).

  • Architect and lead enterprise Master Data Management (MDM), including golden records, entity resolution, data domains, reference and hierarchy management, and stewardship, to create trusted, authoritative data across the business.

  • Architect and integrate agentic AI and LLM-driven workflows (autonomous agents, RAG pipelines, AI copilots) into data platforms and pipelines to drive efficiency and new capabilities.

  • Build and support the data foundations for machine learning and AI, including feature stores, vector stores, embeddings, and ML/LLMOps pipelines.

  • Design and deliver backend data services and APIs (REST/GraphQL), and contribute across the stack to expose curated datasets to applications, analytics, and BI consumers.

  • Set engineering standards and best practices for data quality, modeling, testing, observability, and deployment across the organization, including responsible use of AI-assisted development tools.

  • Establish data governance, lineage, cataloging, and quality frameworks across the data estate.

  • Lead technical design reviews and provide architectural guidance to multiple engineering and data teams.

  • Partner with product, analytics, and engineering leadership to translate business strategy into scalable data roadmaps, including AI-driven capabilities.

  • Identify and resolve systemic performance, reliability, and scalability issues across the data stack.

  • Mentor and coach senior and mid-level engineers, raising the technical bar across the organization on data engineering, MDM, and AI practices.

  • Drive adoption of modern frameworks, tools, and engineering practices, including agentic AI and LLM tooling, to improve delivery velocity and platform resilience.

  • Maintain awareness of emerging technologies and industry trends, particularly in agentic AI, master data management, and modern data platforms, and assess their applicability to the business.

IF YOU ARE

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, MIS, or related field preferred.

  • 12+ years of experience in data engineering or software engineering, with demonstrated experience architecting data platforms and pipelines at scale.

  • Expert-level SQL and strong proficiency in Python (Scala or Java a plus) for large-scale data processing and transformation.

  • Deep experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, Synapse, BigQuery, Redshift) and cloud-native architecture patterns.

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, data modeling (dimensional, data vault, lakehouse), and ETL/ELT architecture.

  • Hands-on experience designing and implementing Master Data Management (MDM) solutions, including entity resolution, match/merge, golden records, and reference/hierarchy management (e.g., Informatica, Reltio, Profisee, or similar).

  • Hands-on experience building or integrating agentic AI systems, LLM-powered applications, RAG pipelines, or AI agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, MCP).

  • Experience building backend data services and APIs (REST/GraphQL), with comfort working across the full stack.

  • Strong background with both relational (SQL) and NoSQL data stores, plus data lake/lakehouse formats (Delta, Iceberg, Parquet).

  • Deep understanding of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and DevOps/DataOps practices.

  • Proven track record of leading large-scale technical initiatives across multiple teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and influence technical direction without direct reporting authority.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with data governance, lineage, and cataloging tools (e.g., Unity Catalog, Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Alation).

  • Experience designing multi-agent systems, tool-calling architectures, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines.

  • Experience with event-driven architectures and streaming/real-time data processing (e.g., Kafka, Event Hubs, Kinesis, Flink, Spark Structured Streaming).

  • Experience building the data layer for ML/AI, including feature stores, vector databases, embeddings, and ML/LLMOps.

  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and workflow orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, dbt).

  • Prior experience in commercial real estate, fintech, or operations/transaction systems.

  • Track record of speaking, writing, or open-source contributions that demonstrate technical thought leadership, especially in applied AI or data.

AS AN OPINOV8R, YOU WILL HAVE

  • Digital-First Approach:Great talent knows no borders! You can work from wherever you are — we hire and collaborate with professionals worldwide.

  • Remote Work Model:Balance your professional and personal life with our flexible working conditions, empowering you to deliver your best from anywhere.

  • Exciting Projects:Dive into impactful projects across industries that challenge and spark creativity.

  • Boost Your Expertise:Grow your career with continuous learning, development opportunities, and hands-on experience.

  • Join the Best Team Ever:Collaborate with our diverse and cross-cultural team of passionate technologists and creative thinkers.

HOW’S THE HIRING PROCESS GOING

We strive to make our hiring process smooth and transparent to find the perfect match for both sides. Steps may differ depending on the role, but here’s what to expect:

  • Initial Interview: If your background fits the role, we’ll invite you for an interview with a Talent Acquisition Specialist.

  • Technical Interview:Depending on the position, you may complete a technical assessment or test task.

  • Client Interview:You can expect 1 or 2 Client Interviews.

  • Final Decision:After all steps, we’ll get back to you with the result and next steps.
