Get to know us better

CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

  • Act to deliver.

  • Disrupt to grow.

  • Team up to win.

The project and the team

We are looking for an Engineering Manager capable of leading software development, quality assurance, or observability projects.

We are recruiting for two different divisions, and you can join us if your background aligns with either the Networking & Hardware domain or the Observability & QA domain.

You will be working under the supervision of our senior managers alongside a team of fellow EMs/PMs. In this role, you will oversee a diverse portfolio of projects. The nature of these engagements will vary significantly—ranging from straightforward team augmentation setups to complex deliveries that require deep, hands-on project management involvement. The customer may be one of the big vendors or it can be a startup aiming to disrupt the biggest players in the observability business.

What else you should know:

  • We keep our project teams consisting of fewer than 10 people.

  • We often work using client-supplied hardware and tools.

  • Most of our clients are based in the US (often Silicon Valley), so work in the afternoon may sometimes be required.

  • We work hybrid or fully remotely

Your role

Note: While you will heavily leverage your technical background to steer teams and discussions, this is a non-coding management role.

Project Delivery & Technical Alignment

  • Collaborate with clients to clarify business objectives and technical requirements.

  • Facilitate architectural discussions and align engineering decisions with client leads.

  • Oversee delivery health, proactively managing risks, scope changes, and project dependencies.

  • Empower engineering teams by removing obstacles and ensuring efficient execution.

People Leadership & Growth

  • Foster high-performing, engaged teams by applying your leadership style within CodiLime’s culture.

  • Actively participate in talent acquisition, onboarding, and continuous engineer mentoring - full employee lifecycle

Client & Business Partnership

  • Nurture long-term client trust and spot opportunities to expand ongoing engagements.

  • Take part in pre-sales and business development activities

  • Travel occasionally for on-site client visits (typically up to twice a year).

Do we have a match?

As an Engineering Manager, you must meet the following criteria:

  • 7 years of experience in the domain and at least 3 years in a managerial position (Project Manager, Engineering Manager, Technical Delivery Manager, Tech Lead / QA Lead) with dedicated people management responsibilities (we are open to both growing and seasoned managers—the scope will match your seniority).

  • Prior hands-on engineering background (e.g., Software Engineering, QA Automation, Systems/Embedded Engineering) — while this is a non-coding role, you must be able to understand low-level concepts and speak the same language as your engineers and client architects.

  • Solid grasp of networking & systems fundamentals: strong familiarity with Linux environments and core networking protocols/concepts (L2/L3, network architecture).

  • Delivery & test mindset: practical understanding of modern CI/CD practices, test automation strategies, and efficient software delivery lifecycles.

  • Proven people leadership skills: guiding career development, conducting impactful 1-on-1s and performance reviews, building trust, and navigating conflict.

  • Fluency in English (C1+): confident verbal and written communication, capable of leading technical discussions with international clients and stakeholders.

Nice to have (or what will make you stand out):

  • Professional services experience: prior background working in a software house, outsourcing, or consulting environment managing external client expectations.

  • Domain familiarity:

Option A: Networking & Hardware Domain:

  • Solid grasp of networking & systems fundamentals: Linux environments and core networking protocols/concepts (L2/L3, network architecture).

  • Delivery & test mindset: practical understanding of modern CI/CD practices, test automation strategies, and efficient software delivery lifecycles.

  • Exposure to networking hardware and low-level software, such as network adapters, SmartNICs, or DPUs/IPUs.

  • Network Operating Systems (e.g., SONiC, IOS-XR).

  • Hardware bring-up, driver integrations, or porting software to new silicon/hardware targets.

Option B: Observability & Quality Assurance Domain:

  • Observability: Experience in at least one of the Observability domains (APM, NPM, Cloud Monitoring, or Infrastructure Monitoring) and familiarity with observability tools and platforms such as Grafana, Splunk, Prometheus, or the ELK Stack.

  • Network testing & validation: experience leading teams around network function testing, performance benchmarking, or testbed orchestration (e.g., Spirent, Keysight, PyTest frameworks).

  • Broad infrastructure awareness: practical exposure to cloud environments, virtualization, or containerization.

More reasons to join us

  • Flexible working hours and approach to work: fully remotely, in the office or hybrid

  • Professional growth supported by internal training sessions and a training budget

  • Solid onboarding with a hands-on approach to give you an easy start

  • A great atmosphere among professionals who are passionate about their work

  • The ability to change the project you work on

  • Manage 1040 intake for individual clients, reviewing W-2s, 1099s, brokerage statements and K-1s to confirm each client’s document set is complete before it goes to the preparer.

  • Assist with various other administrative assignments and special projects as they arise including mailings, faxing, filing, copying, scanning, etc.

  • Working knowledge of individual tax documents (W-2s, 1099s, brokerage statements, K-1s) and what a complete set looks like for an individual return.

  • Overtime hours may be required during busy season (January through April including some Saturdays, depending on workflow as well as September & October major deadlines).
  • Strong attention to detail, proofreading, and problem-solving skills.
  • A continuous-improvement mindset: motivated not just to get the work done, but to find ways to do it better. Able to spot problems, bring forward practical solutions, and help put better processes in place.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple assignments, manage interruptions, and shift priorities with ease.
  • Ability to maintain a professional demeanor in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment.
  • Polished written and verbal communication skills, with the professionalism to interact directly with clients.
  • Ability to exercise complete confidentiality while working with sensitive information.
  • Energetic team player with a positive attitude.
  • Proficient in the use of Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook and Adobe; GoFileRoom, CCH, GoTax a plus.

Benefits

Why us?

  • We have a unique culture that emphasizes and values flexibility and work/life balance including fully virtual or hybrid work arrangements.
  • Our collaborative work environment is strongly committed to your professional growth and success.
  • We have a track record of ranking as a Best Place to Work NJ for the past twenty-two years and have won several other awards including Best Firms for Young Accountants, Accounting Today Best Accounting Firms to Work For, Best Accounting Firms for Women, Best Accounting Firms for Millennials, and many more!
  • WG offers a competitive salary and benefits package, including generous PTO, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with employer match, Summer Fridays, flexible work schedules, and much more!
  • The estimated salary range for this position is $58,000 - $72,000. Individual salaries are determined through multiple factors permitted by law including but not limited to experience, education, licensure/certification, knowledge, skills and qualifications. WG also offers a comprehensive benefits package and performance award (bonus) eligibility where you’ll be recognized and rewarded based on your performance.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required.

We believe in equal opportunity:

Wilkin & Guttenplan P.C. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

Collectively - part of the Brandtech Group (formerly You & Mr. Jones) - is the global leader in influencer marketing; combining strategy, creative, and technology to deliver the most innovative influencer work. We partner with forward-thinking brands in technology, fashion, retail, gaming, entertainment, consumer goods, and more to build deeply integrated social activation strategies that drive relevance, awareness, and sales. Our work has been recognized by top publications including The Wall Street Journal, Fast Company, Digiday, AdAge, and Business INSIDER, among others. We’ve also earned Effie, Webby, Glossy, IMA Fast Company, and OMMA awards for our programs.

Collectively is known across the industry as the partner who delivers the most creative, strategic, and effective programs, with the most sophisticated analysis and paid social offerings. But most importantly, we’re known to be genuinely committed partners to our clients, many of whom have worked with us for multiple years. We aspire to continue to provide an excellent workplace for our teams while delivering the industry’s most ambitious and thoughtful influencer collaborations. In 2020, we were named by Built In Bay Area as one of the Best Small Companies to work for.

About The Team:

Collectively’s Analytics & Performance team brings creativity, analytics, and paid social expertise together to lead the reporting of our campaigns, implement successful boosting programs, and manage multiple cross-functional tools and processes that power the organization. The team also supports R&D and innovation, helping to guide our consistent evolution in an ever-changing industry.

About The Role:

Digital Marketing Analysts are actively involved in campaign tracking and manage the scaled distribution of influencer marketing programs through paid social campaigns on TikTok, Instagram, and other social media platforms.

Responsibilities:

Client Research, Reporting, and Analysis:

Support of the following work streams:

  • Cleaning and analysis of data to support client reporting deliverables
  • Customization and maintenance of dashboards and reporting tools to measure program-specific KPIs, with regular QA checks on the data
  • Quantitative and qualitative research to explore questions posed by clients
  • Preparation of slides, analytic reports, and other visualizations to illustrate key insights
  • Participation in client-facing conversations around campaign performance, in collaboration with the cross-functional team
  • Delivery of benchmarks, trends, and other insights from reporting tools

Paid Social Planning and Buying:

  • Work closely with account management colleagues to develop paid social strategies and targets
  • Maintain up-to-the-minute knowledge of social platforms’ paid media products and services, and serve as an authority on this fast-moving sector of digital marketing internally and with clients
  • Set-up and execute paid social campaigns across platforms, working cross-functionally to coordinate influencer participation

We're looking for a Technical Delivery Manager to own delivery across multiple engineering initiatives. This role is critical to ensuring projects move from idea to production smoothly, predictably, and on time — with clear priorities, strong coordination, and minimal surprises.

You'll work closely with Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Leadership Teams to plan work, manage execution, resolve blockers, and drive projects to completion. Your focus is delivery: keeping teams aligned, issues unblocked, and outcomes shipped.

This role is ideal for someone who is structured, decisive, and comfortable operating at the intersection of technical systems and cross-functional teams.

Delivery Ownership & Execution

Triage & Priority Management

  • Lead incident and bug triage, assessing urgency vs. backlog items
  • Partner with leadership (including Jhun) to confirm priorities and sequencing
  • Ensure fixes are validated, released, and communicated clearly

Process & Systems Improvement

  • Continuously improve how we use ClickUp, Confluence, and Slack
  • Create or refine templates, task standards, reporting, and workflows

Communication & Visibility

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and strong at follow-through

Nice to Have:

raw.description:
Hi, we're TechnologyAdvice.

Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, TechnologyAdvice helps millions of B2B technology buyers make smarter decisions by providing trusted research, practical guidance, and connections to the world's leading technology brands. Our work spans 30+ media brands and 50+ newsletters, supported by a global team across the United States, United Kingdom, Singapore, Australia, and the Philippines.

We're a remote-first company that values curiosity, collaboration, and growth. We invest in our people, embrace AI and new technologies to improve how we work, and create opportunities for team members to build meaningful careers. Many of our leaders have grown from within, including our CEO, who started here as an intern.

We believe great work happens when people feel connected. Through company all-hands, team events, Slack communities, learning sessions, and in-person gatherings, we create intentional opportunities for our global team to collaborate, build relationships, and celebrate successes together.

All positions are open to remote work unless otherwise specified in the requirements below.

The opportunity

The HR Generalist will serve as a trusted HR partner to U.S. employees and managers while managing programs that shape the day-to-day employee experience. This role combines employee relations, benefits administration, leave and accommodation management, compliance, manager support, and HR process improvement.

You will evaluate HR matters, research federal and state requirements, and provide practical guidance that balances employee needs, consistency, compliance, and business priorities. You’ll take ownership of your work while partnering with HR leadership on complex or unfamiliar situations and continuing to build your expertise.

Reporting to the Director of HR, you will work closely with payroll, finance, legal counsel, benefits vendors, managers, and the broader People Operations team. You will remain hands-on while improving documentation, strengthening processes, and sharing knowledge with other HR team members.

Location: United States

What you'll do

  • Serve as a primary HR partner to U.S. employees and managers, providing guidance on performance, attendance, conduct, policy interpretation, and employee concerns.
  • Manage employee relations matters, including investigations, corrective actions, performance improvement plans, and termination support, partnering with HR leadership as needed.
  • Administer U.S. health and welfare programs, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, HSA, and related benefits.
  • Research and resolve benefits issues involving eligibility, enrollment, deductions, coverage, qualifying life events, and required corrections.
  • Coordinate with benefits brokers, carriers, third-party administrators, COBRA administrators, and other vendors to support accurate and timely service.
  • Partner with payroll and finance to reconcile benefits deductions, invoices, contribution files, and discrepancies across systems.
  • Support benefits renewals and manage key aspects of open enrollment, including plan implementation, employee communications, system review, and post-enrollment reconciliation.
  • Manage day-to-day 401(k) administration, including eligibility, contributions, employee questions, vendor coordination, audit support, and corrections.
  • Manage employee leave and workplace accommodation processes involving FMLA, ADA, parental leave, disability, workers’ compensation, and applicable state programs, seeking guidance on complex cases.
  • Guide employees and managers through documentation, benefits, accommodation, and return-to-work requirements throughout the leave process.
  • Maintain the U.S. HR and benefits compliance calendar and coordinate required filings, notices, audits, disclosures, and employee communications.
  • Monitor developments in federal, state, and local employment requirements and work with HR leadership to update policies, systems, communications, and operating practices.
  • Draft and maintain HR policies, procedures, manager resources, employee communications, and standard operating procedures.
  • Review HR data, records, and recurring processes to identify compliance risks, resolve discrepancies, and improve accuracy and efficiency.
  • Provide guidance and review work within assigned programs to support HR coordinators and other developing HR professionals.
  • Partner with the Director of HR on workforce planning, organizational initiatives, compliance matters, and evolving People Operations priorities.

Who You Are

  • 3+ years of human resources experience, including hands-on responsibility for benefits administration, employee relations, leave management, and HR operations.
  • Direct experience administering U.S. health and welfare benefits, including eligibility, enrollment, deduction, coverage, and qualifying life event issues.
  • Hands-on involvement in 401(k) or other retirement plan administration, including contributions, audits, vendor coordination, or corrections.
  • Experience managing employee relations matters, including investigations, performance concerns, corrective actions, and termination support.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. employment and benefits requirements, including ERISA, ACA, COBRA, HIPAA, FMLA, ADA, wage and hour requirements, and applicable federal and state laws.
  • Practical experience administering employee leave and workplace accommodation processes involving FMLA, ADA, workers’ compensation, and state leave programs.
  • Ability to research unfamiliar requirements, evaluate options, and recommend practical next steps.
  • Experience partnering with payroll, finance, benefits brokers, carriers, or third-party administrators to resolve issues and maintain accurate records.
  • Proficiency with HRIS and payroll platforms, including reviewing employee data, benefits deductions, contribution files, and process accuracy.
  • Sound judgment when handling sensitive HR matters, maintaining documentation, and determining when to involve HR leadership or other partners.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain requirements and next steps to employees, managers, and external partners.
  • Strong organization and follow-through when balancing multiple sensitive or deadline-driven matters in a remote environment.
  • Experience supporting employees across multiple U.S. states or a remote-first workforce is preferred.
  • Exposure to international HR teams or global People Operations initiatives is preferred.

What we offer you

  • Career Growth: Advance with mentorship programs, leadership academies, and opportunities to shape company culture and DEI initiatives.
  • Flex Fridays: Adjust your 40-hour week to enjoy a full or half day off on Fridays.
  • Remote-First Culture: Work from the comfort of your home.
  • Flexible PTO: Take the time you need, when you need it.
  • Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your family.
  • Insurance Protection: Life, AD&D, Short-Term, and Long-Term Disability coverage.
  • 401K with Match: Secure your future with our company-matched retirement savings.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Support for new parents during life’s special moments.
  • Wellness Perks: Access Headspace and enjoy monthly fitness reimbursements.
  • Pet Insurance: Care for your furry family members.
  • Speaker Series Bonus: Present in our monthly speaker series and earn a bonus.
  • Book Reimbursement: Get up to 12 books reimbursed per year to fuel your learning.
  • Bucket List Benefit: Celebrate milestones with annual contributions toward your dream adventures after 3 years.
  • In-Office Perks: Enjoy catered lunches for our in-office team.

Work authorization

Employer work visa sponsorship and support are not provided for this role. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States at hire in an employer approved US state and must maintain authorization to work in the United States throughout their employment with our company.

Salary Range
We seek to hire top-tier individuals and intend for our compensation to be at a rate that allows us to recruit and retain individuals who align with our core values, purpose, mission, and vision. Final total compensation is based on a multitude of factors including, but not limited to, skill level, relevant experience to the position, and cost of labor.

Annual pay range
$70,000—$90,000 USD

EOE statement

We believe that our differences make us stronger, and thus foster a diverse and inclusive culture where people feel safe being themselves. TechnologyAdvice is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under federal, state or local law.

Pre-employment screening required.

TechnologyAdvice does not engage with external staffing agencies. Any candidates introduced by such firms will not be eligible for compensation. TechnologyAdvice communicates only through @technologyadvice.com emails and official recruiting platforms. We never recruit via Teams, WhatsApp, or similar apps, and we will never request money, gift cards, or personal financial details during hiring.

Any AI-generated or incomplete application answers will be auto-rejected.

raw.title: Group Financial Controller
raw.excerpt: Large organisations consistently make important decisions without the intelligence they already own — because they can't find what they have, can't see what they're missing, and can't act on it fast enough to matter.
raw.description:
Large organisations consistently make important decisions without the intelligence they already own — because they can't find what they have, can't see what they're missing, and can't act on it fast enough to matter.

We are Stravito and this is the problem we solve.

Due to the universal nature of the problem, our customers come from various industries all around the world. We help world-leading organizations, such as McDonald’s, Nestlé and Heineken, better understand their customers and make better, insights-backed decisions by organizing their knowledge and making it easy to access through our intuitive platform.

We really mean it when we say we're a diverse and international team as our team of 100 has more than 30 different nationalities! We are guided by our operating principles: simplicity first, an “own it, do it” mentality, embracing different perspectives, and enjoying the journey together.

About the job

As our Group Financial Controller, you will own the numbers across our Swedish, UK and US entities, from transaction to internal management, board and investor reports, and step by step change how the work behind them gets done. This is a hands-on role with a lot of ownership in a small finance team with a wide scope. You will report to our VP Finance and work closely with our CEO, the leadership team and our external partners.

We want our own finance function to run on the same principle we offer our customers: accurate numbers, fast, with minimal manual effort. Owning the numbers comes first. Alongside that, you will shape how finance works at Stravito: what agents can do, where people come in, and what to automate or bring in-house, while keeping controls strong. Success means a faster close, confident reporting and more time for insights.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Month-end close, consolidation and statutory reporting for our Swedish parent company and our UK and US entities

  • Management reporting, budget and forecast follow-up, and SaaS metrics together with the VP Finance

  • Cash flow forecasting and liquidity planning

  • Financial material for the board and investors

  • Managing external accounting, payroll and tax partners, audits and internal controls

  • Initiating and driving improvement projects through completion, and putting AI and automation into production where they prove their value

  • Owning the finance systems stack (Light and Claude) and its integrations, and measuring impact in close days, hours saved and errors avoided

About you

We believe that you have extensive experience from accounting, controlling and group reporting, ideally with a Big Four or audit foundation, and are skilled at owning the close and improving how it gets done. You demonstrate a strong knowledge of Swedish statutory reporting and K3 and/or IFRS, and a willingness to develop and learn. We know few finance professionals have built AI workflows in production yet, so we do not expect a finished playbook, but we do expect strong fundamentals and curiosity. With strong communication skills you effectively collaborate with a variety of stakeholders across the business.

To be successful in this role, you need:

  • 5+ years in accounting, controlling and group reporting, ideally with a Big Four or audit foundation

  • Hands-on experience with statutory and group reporting for a Swedish company

  • Experience from a fast-moving international setting, ideally within tech, SaaS or subscription businesses

  • A track record of initiating an improvement and showing the result: implementing or migrating a system, harmonising a chart of accounts, automating a reconciliation or forecast, or shortening the close

  • Hands-on use of AI tools in your own work, and drive to put scalable systems in place

Job Description:

Job Title - Head of Data

Location – Remote, commutable to London office as and when required

Type – Permanent, Full-time 37.5 hours

About Velonetic

Velonetic helps keep the London insurance market moving. With more than 100 years of market heritage, we combine specialist insurance expertise, proven processes and technology to make complex insurance operations simpler, faster and more reliable.

As we continue to evolve, data will play a critical role in improving performance, enabling innovation and supporting the responsible use of AI and automation.

Job Overview

We’re looking for an experienced Head of Data to lead our enterprise data strategy and help turn data into a trusted, accessible and valuable business asset.

Working across the business, Technology, Architecture and control functions, you’ll set the direction for data, improve quality and ownership, strengthen governance and ensure our data foundations support reporting, analytics, transformation and AI.

What you’ll do

  • Define and deliver Velonetic’s enterprise data strategy and roadmap.
  • Establish clear data ownership, governance and stewardship.
  • Improve data quality, lineage, metadata and traceability.
  • Shape our data architecture and platform roadmap alongside Technology.
  • Enable trusted reporting, analytics, automation and responsible AI.
  • Strengthen data risk, GDPR and regulatory compliance.
  • Influence senior leaders and build a strong, organisation-wide data culture.

What we’re looking for

You’ll be an established data leader with:

  • Senior experience across data strategy, governance, management, architecture or analytics.
  • A strong track record in data quality, ownership, stewardship and governance.
  • Experience influencing Executive and Board-level stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of modern data platforms, analytics and AI-readiness.
  • Strong understanding of data risk, privacy and regulatory requirements.
  • Ideally, experience within insurance, financial services or another highly regulated industry.

Investment In Training and Development

We offer a comprehensive range of training and career development opportunities, a structured induction programme, tailored job training as well as mentoring and support for relevant sponsored professional qualifications. We’re developing an environment where people can grow and harness their careers and skills to be the best that they can be to focus on the long term.

Our Culture

Here at Velonetic we support with care and compassion. We are constantly evolving our initiatives around equality, diversity, and inclusion to ensure that everyone feels equally involved and supported in the workplace no matter of who they are or what they do. We are proud of the culture we are creating to ensure that our commitment is ongoing and have a diverse mix of employees working within an inclusive environment and culture to create a high performing workforce led by talented leaders. We aspire to be recognised for our innovative and modern thinking approach.

Employee Benefits

As part of our competitive remuneration package, flexible benefits are available. There is an option to “flex up and down” on specific benefits, for example buy or sell annual leave, Private Medical Benefit, Dental and Travel Insurance.

You will also have access to ‘Perks at Work’, a discount store to purchase gift cards at reduced rates and get discounts on holidays, restaurants, activities, groceries and more.

DXC Recruitment Team will be engaging with all candidate applications on behalf of Velonetic. DXC will be managing the recruitment throughout the onboarding process.

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

Recruitment fraud is a scheme in which fictitious job opportunities are offered to job seekers typically through online services, such as false websites, or through unsolicited emails claiming to be from the company. These emails may request recipients to provide personal information or to make payments as part of their illegitimate recruiting process. DXC does not make offers of employment via social media networks and DXC never asks for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process, nor ask a job seeker to purchase IT or other equipment on our behalf. Are you an expert in orchestrating high-impact software implementations from kickoff to go-live? Do you enjoy translating complex enterprise requirements into seamless delivery plans? Are you eager to make your mark in an industry ready for disruption, helping investment managers reimagine their operations with innovative cloud technology? If so, we invite you to be a part of our innovative team.

As a Customer Experience Senior Project Manager at Ridgeline, you will be responsible for leading end-to-end implementations of the Ridgeline enterprise cloud software for investment management customers. You will directly interact with both internal and customer stakeholders to define and deliver an agreed upon scope of services in a project management capacity. Gravitas and exceptional organizational skills are paramount. A consultative approach, innovative mindset, and collaborative spirit will also be key as you continue your track record of successful go-lives and make a meaningful impact on an industry primed for change.

At Ridgeline, how we work matters as much as what we build. Ridgeliners act like owners, choose growth over comfort, and communicate with transparency. We assume positive intent, bias toward action, and bring solutions—not just problems. We celebrate wins, learn from setbacks, and thrivein a resilient, collaborative, high-performing culture. If this excites you, we’d love to meet you.

You must be work authorized in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship.

What You’ll Do?

  • Project Planning and Design: Define project goals, plan scope, allocate resources, and set timelines.
  • Team Leadership: Lead and motivate the project team, assign tasks, and ensure collaboration.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and managing expectations.
  • Budget Management: Oversee the project budget, ensuring cost-effectiveness and financial tracking.
  • Quality Control: Ensure project deliverables meet quality standards and stakeholder requirements.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential project risks, devise mitigation strategies, and manage any issues that arise.
  • Project Evaluation: Assess project outcomes against objectives, analyze performance, and report on results to stakeholders.
  • Hands-On Task Execution: Directly engage in and complete critical project tasks as necessary to support team efforts and project success.
  • Domestic travel 25-50%

Desired Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field of study
  • 5+ years of experience leading investment management software implementations in a customer-facing role
  • Investment management industry knowledge of front office and back office systems, workflows and processes (ex. portfolio accounting, performance measurement, trading, reconciliation, data, compliance, reporting, etc.)
  • Skilled Project Management practitioner with a proven track record; adept at coordinating functional and technical resources
  • Ability to work independently, with general direction and guidance; highly organized with excellent time management skills and the ability to manage competing priorities with a hands-on approach
  • Innate curiosity and proven ability to learn new software technologies quickly
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with an ability to build relationships with internal and external customer stakeholders, including senior leadership

Bonus:

  • Understanding of Agile principles and software development lifecycles
  • Familiarity with Google Apps and/or the MS Office suite
  • Comfortable leveraging tools such as Slack, JIRA/Confluence, and Mavenlink for project management and communication
  • Basic understanding of AWS, APIs, and serverless technology
  • Project Management certifications such as PMP, CAPM, PRINCE2 a plus

About Ridgeline

Ridgeline is the first front-to-back system of record for investment managers. Founded by visionary entrepreneur Dave Duffield (co-founder of both PeopleSoft and Workday), the company was created to modernize an industry held back by outdated, disconnected technology. Powered by a single, real-time data set and embedded AI, Ridgeline helps firms automate complexity, accelerate collaboration, and deliver tailored client experiences at scale, without added headcount or risk. Ridgeline is headquartered in Lake Tahoe, with offices in New York, Reno, and the Bay Area, and is recognized by Fast Company as a “Best Workplace for Innovators,” by Frost & Sullivan as a “Technology Innovation Leader,” and by The Software Report as a “Top 100 Software Company.”

Ridgeline is proud to be a community-minded, discrimination-free equal opportunity workplace.

Ridgeline processes the information you submit in connection with your application in accordance with the Ridgeline Applicant Privacy Statement. Please review the Ridgeline Applicant Privacy Statement in full to understand our privacy practices and contact us with any questions.

Compensation and Benefits

The typical starting salary range for new hires in this role is listed below. In select locations (including, the San Francisco Bay Area, CA, and the New York City Metro Area), an alternate range may apply as specified below.

The typical starting salary range for this role is: $104,000-$130,000 OTE.

The typical starting salary range for this role in the select locations listed above is: $114,400-$143,000 OTE.

Final compensation amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amount listed above.

As an employee at Ridgeline, you’ll have many opportunities for advancement in your career and can make a true impact on the product.

In addition to the base salary, Ridgeline employees can participate in our Company Stock Plan subject to the applicable Stock Option Agreement. We also offer rich benefits that reflect the kind of organization we want to be: one in which our employees feel valued and are inspired to bring their best selves to work. These include unlimited vacation, educational and wellness reimbursements, and $0 cost employee insurance plans. Please check out our Careers page for a more comprehensive overview of our perks and benefits.

About Us

We are a startup where priorities can change quickly, processes are still developing and several important initiatives often run in parallel. We are looking for someone who enjoys this environment and can bring structure, calm and reliable execution to a busy working day. Our work spans HR, finance, IT and marketing, with AI playing a practical role in how we organise information, coordinate work and improve processes.

Job Description

As Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will be a trusted right hand who turns priorities into clear actions and follows them through to completion. You will anticipate needs, organise competing demands, coordinate people and maintain a reliable overview of what requires attention across the business.

Inbox and calendar management form part of the role, alongside broader responsibility for organising projects, improving workflows, preparing decisions and keeping commitments on track.

You should bring practical experience using AI to accomplish meaningful work. This includes creating and using reusable AI skills: structured instructions, relevant context and tools that help an AI assistant perform recurring tasks consistently. You should be comfortable adapting these workflows, checking their outputs and recognising when human judgement or specialist input is needed.

You should be comfortable with the pace, uncertainty and pressure that can come with building a startup. This means adapting when plans change, handling competing requests and maintaining sound judgement under time pressure. You will help the CEO and team set realistic priorities, make trade-offs and identify when workload or deadlines need to be adjusted.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate the CEO's priorities into actionable plans with clear owners, deadlines and follow-up.
  • Maintain an overview of ongoing initiatives, identify dependencies and flag delays or decisions early.
  • Coordinate work across the startup team, external partners and service providers.
  • Prepare concise research, meeting briefs, comparisons and recommendations that support decisions.
  • Organise meetings, correspondence and schedules, capturing decisions and ensuring agreed actions are completed.
  • Support HR operations through recruitment coordination, onboarding, documentation and follow-up.
  • Support finance operations by organising invoices, expenses, payment schedules and information needed by accounting specialists.
  • Support marketing initiatives by organising briefs, assets, deadlines and collaboration with internal and external contributors.
  • Coordinate IT requests, access requirements, software subscriptions and communication with technical colleagues.
  • Organise and improve how the CEO and startup team use Microsoft 365, keeping communication, documents, tasks and shared information structured and accessible.

raw.title: Senior Campaign Manager
raw.excerpt: Seeq runs dedicated account-based experience (ABX) programs to win high-value new customers and expand existing customer relationships.
raw.description:
Seeq runs dedicated account-based experience (ABX) programs to win high-value new customers and expand existing customer relationships. These programs span our core verticals, including Oil & Gas, Power, Pharma, Mining, Metals & Materials (MMM), and Chemicals, as well as emerging ones. As Senior ABX Marketing Manager, you'll drive the execution of these programs and measure their impact.

You'll work at the center of a cross-functional account pod made up of Sales, a Business Development Representative (BDR), our Executive Engagement team, and Customer Success. The pod develops each account strategy together, and you lead the orchestration of the plays that bring it to life.

Together with the pod, you'll engage the influencing and buying committees across Operations, Operational Technology (OT), IT, and AI/data throughout the sales cycle. You and the pod share accountability for account engagement, executive relationships, pipeline, and expansion revenue, not lead volume. Your own goals tie to program execution and committee coverage

Requirements

You'll shape how Seeq wins and grows its most important accounts, with direct visibility to the executive team. Here's how:

Account strategy and planning

• Work with the pod to build and maintain a written account plan for every target account. Each plan covers business priorities, key initiatives, influencing and buying committees, competitive position, plays, and next steps.

• Partner with Sales leadership, RevOps, and the pod to tier accounts by value, fit, and engagement signals. Run 1:1 programs for the top tier and 1:few industry or use-case clusters for the rest. Recommend accounts to add or rotate out.

• Build account intelligence from annual reports, earnings calls, capital projects, energy-transition goals, digital and AI announcements, leadership changes, and each account's current technology stack. Share it with the pod and turn it into tailored points of view and business cases.

Stakeholder engagement and messaging

• With the pod, map the cross-functional influencing and buying committees at each account, including the executive sponsor.

• Find gaps in coverage and work with the pod to design plays that close them.

• Adapt Seeq's core and industry messaging to each account's priorities and stakeholders, drawing on insights from the pod, while keeping one consistent account story.

Pod and cross-functional orchestration

• Serve as the pod's day-to-day orchestrator. Coordinate who engages, when, and with what message, so each account has one consistent experience with Seeq.

• Run the pod's operating rhythm: weekly account standups (signals, actions, owners), monthly account reviews, and quarterly strategy reviews with leadership.

• With Sales: align plays to deal stage, and facilitate the pod's account-planning sessions.

• With the BDR: design outreach sequences by persona and plays triggered by buying signals such as intent spikes, new leadership, or initiative announcements. Provide talking points and content.

• With Executive Engagement: identify which executives to target, pair them with Seeq executives, and plan executive briefings, roundtables, dinners, and site visits.

• With Customer Success: use product-usage and site-adoption data to find whitespace in existing accounts. Run land-and-expand plays across sites, business units, and use cases. Build champion and advocacy programs.

• With partners: run joint plays with cloud, data-platform, and systems-integrator partners where they already have relationships in target accounts.

• With Product Marketing and Industry Marketing: draw on Seeq's core positioning, industry narratives, and proof points, and share account insights back to strengthen them.

Plays across the account lifecycle

• Breaking in: tailored points of view and outreach sequences that open doors with Operations and AI/data leaders.

• Proving value: use-case workshops, technical deep-dives, peer references, and pilot support (mutual value plans and business-case kits for champions) that move accounts from first interest to production.

• Expansion: value reviews that show realized impact, internal roadshows that carry wins from one site or business unit to the next, use-case workshops for new teams, and customer advisory boards.

Executive engagement runs throughout, from first access to sponsorship of expansion.

Personalized content and experiences

• Brief and direct content teams, agencies, and designers to produce account-specific assets, using AI to personalize at scale: microsites, points of view, ROI and business-case tools, persona one-pagers, targeted digital advertising, and direct mail.

• Plan and run account experiences such as executive briefings, private workshops, curated meetings at industry events, and webinars for a single account or a small group of accounts.

Measurement, budget and tools

• Work with RevOps to define and maintain account-level dashboards covering engagement, committee coverage, meetings, pipeline, deal velocity, win rate, and expansion.

• Report results to the pod and to leadership: what's working, where, and what will change.

• Feed what you learn back into plays, messaging, and account tiering.

• Own the ABX budget and allocate it by account tier.

• Get the most from our tool stack (6sense, Marketo, Salesforce, and AI-powered personalization tools), and define requirements for Marketing Ops and RevOps.

What You'll Bring

• 5+ years in B2B enterprise SaaS marketing, including at least 3 years running account-based programs (1:1 and 1:few).

That experience should include:

– A named list of large enterprise accounts (e.g., Fortune 1000 or global industrial companies)

– Multi-stakeholder buying committees spanning technical and business functions

– Multiple industry verticals

– Sales cycles of 6+ months

• A track record of creating and accelerating pipeline at the account level, and of driving expansion and net revenue retention across an existing SaaS customer base. Be ready to share examples with numbers.

• Experience working with Sales, BDR, Executive Engagement, Customer Success, and RevOps in a shared operating model: turning shared KPIs into joint plans, running the operating rhythm, and holding teams to commitments.

• Hands-on skill with ABX and intent platforms (6sense or similar), marketing automation (Marketo or similar), and Salesforce, plus comfort using AI tools to personalize content and analyze accounts.

• Strong analytical skills. You can turn engagement and intent data into clear decisions about where to focus.

• Excellent program management, written communication, and executive presence. You can influence without authority and present confidently to senior leaders, both internal and customer-side.

• Experience running global programs across regions and time zones.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Nice to Have

• Experience marketing industrial enterprise SaaS offerings, Industrial IoT (IIoT), asset performance management, or OT data solutions (historians, SCADA, manufacturing data platforms).

• Knowledge of one or more of our core verticals.

• Experience running executive engagement programs: executive sponsor programs, executive briefing centers, advisory boards.

• Experience co-marketing with cloud, data-platform, or systems-integrator partners.

• Experience scaling an established ABX program.

Benefits

Seeq is a remote-first (only) company founded by serial entrepreneurs. Our executive team and board of directors have extensive experience with successful startup ventures in high-growth environments.

We are founded on the idea that companies need better solutions for quickly and easily getting business insight from their industrial process data. Our mission is to provide software and services that convert that data into meaningful information that the business can use to improve profitability.

We have a wonderful, kind-hearted, talented team that loves to collaborate, lead by example, and exceed our customers’ expectations. We are certified as a great place to work, an emerging startup, the Technology Fast 500, and Inc. Magazine's Best Places to Work.

The Perks of Working at Seeq

  • Competitive salary plus bonus incentives
    • $126,000 USD base salary
  • Benefits:
    • 12-week paid Seeq family leave
    • Unlimited PTO
    • Internet and mobile phone reimbursements
    • Medical benefits
    • Group term life insurance
    • Short-term and long-term disability insurance pre-tax benefits
    • Voluntary vision and dental (ortho)
    • Vacation bonus program
    • Employee Assistance Program
    • Generous home office allowance
    • The best co-workers (we've analyzed the data, so we know it's true.)
    • Pet-friendly workspace (your dog will be so happy to have you home)
    • You love your job!

Seeq provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics.

You must be authorized to work in the country in which you reside. Seeq does not sponsor US F1 or H-1B work visas

raw.excerpt: DescriptionSprout Social is looking to hire a Business Analyst, GTM Systems to the Sales & Customer Experience team.
raw.description:
Description

Sprout Social is looking to hire a Business Analyst, GTM Systems to the Sales & Customer Experience team.

You’ll be the bridge between our revenue teams and the systems they run on. You’ll turn business needs into clear requirements, make sure what gets built actually works before it reaches the field, and work hand in hand with our Salesforce IT team. You’ll also play a leading role in our CPQ evaluation and in fixing how we measure marketing and pipeline attribution.

Why join Sprout’s Revenue Operations, Sales & Customer Experience team?

At Sprout Social, our Sales and Customer Experience team is the driving force behind how today’s most innovative brands use Sprout to power the future of customer connection. We sell and support the leading social intelligence platform for businesses, helping organizations unlock the full value of social data to drive strategic decisions. Through powerful social intelligence and trusted partnership, we enable teams to build authentic relationships and drive meaningful business impact.

As the strategic engine of our go-to-market organization, Revenue Operations builds the infrastructure that turns data into action. We specialize in architecting world-class processes and delivering the operational clarity that allows our teams to move with speed, anticipate market shifts, and optimize the entire customer lifecycle for sustainable growth.

In this role, you will collaborate with the brightest minds in the industry to support global giants like Salesforce, Airbnb, and Equifax. Just as importantly, we believe in the power of our people. You’ll find a culture that honors your ambition, encourages you to explore new horizons, and provides the framework for you to build a career that matters. If you’re ready to champion innovation and accelerate your impact, this is where you can do your best work.

What you’ll do

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Renewals and Deal Desk to turn business needs into clear requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Own intake and prioritization for GTM systems requests, working with the Director of GTM Systems & Applied AI and Salesforce IT to maintain a single, prioritized backlog.
  • Plan and run user acceptance testing, triage defects, and secure business-owner sign-off before changes reach the field.
  • Write release notes and field communications, and support reps and managers through changes.
  • Lead requirements, scenario design and scoring for our CPQ evaluation, and support delivery of the CPQ roadmap.
  • Define and fix marketing and pipeline attribution: requirements, source data capture in Salesforce, and validated reporting that Marketing and Sales both trust.
  • Monitor data quality on forecast, renewals and source fields, find root causes, and keep data and process definitions documented.
  • Use AI tools to draft, test and document, and spend your own time on judgment, review and decisions.

What you’ll bring

You know how revenue teams work and how to get the right thing built. You write requirements that engineers can build from, you’re rigorous about testing, and you earn trust with everyone from a frontline rep to a VP.

The minimum qualifications for this role include:

  • 4+ years of experience in business analysis, systems analysis or sales operations, supporting a B2B SaaS go-to-market team.
  • Hands-on Salesforce experience and a working understanding of the data model.
  • Proven ability to gather business requirements and write user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Experience planning and running UAT and managing releases with a central IT team that owns the platform.
  • Fluency in GTM data: pipeline, forecast, bookings and renewals.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with both frontline teams and executives.

Preferred qualifications for this role include:

  • Experience with Salesforce CPQ or quote-to-cash, or running a systems evaluation or vendor selection.
  • Experience with marketing or pipeline attribution.
  • Experience with Gong or another revenue intelligence platform.
  • Salesforce Administrator certification, or familiarity with SOQL.
  • Experience using AI tools to speed up analysis, documentation and testing.

How you’ll grow

Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:

  • Complete Sprout Social’s new hire training & onboarding program alongside other new Sprout team members. You’ll gain a broader understanding of our products and how your role fits into the organization.
  • Make a plan with your manager to set initial priorities, align on expectations for your role, plant goalposts for your career, and learn about Sprout’s approach to building and releasing GTM systems changes.
  • Learn our GTM stack, the Salesforce data model and Salesforce IT’s release process.
  • Meet your key stakeholders in Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Renewals and Deal Desk.

Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:

  • Build connections with members from other teams through active networking and community building.
  • Run intake and a standing cadence with Salesforce IT, and ship your first release end to end with stories, UAT and field communications.
  • Document the requirements baseline and evaluation criteria for CPQ.
  • Audit current attribution gaps and agree on requirements with Marketing and Sales leadership.

Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:

  • Have your first performance conversation with your manager, where you’ll discuss your accomplishments in your role and work together to build goals for your professional growth.
  • Lead the CPQ evaluation, including scenario scripts, demos or proofs of concept, and a scored recommendation.
  • Own UAT for our Gong Forecasting rollout.
  • Agree on attribution definitions and rules, and test the Salesforce changes with IT.

Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:

  • Surprise us! Use your unique ideas and abilities to change your team in beneficial ways that we haven’t even considered yet.
  • Own requirements and UAT for the first waves of the CPQ roadmap and our multiple contracts per account work.
  • Deliver pipeline attribution reporting that Marketing and Sales both accept.
  • Show a clear data quality trend and documented definitions that teams and AI agents can rely on.

Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.

Our Benefits Program

We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive, competitive benefits program:

  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Premium BCBSIL medical, dental (high/low plans), and vision (Eyemed) insurance for you and your eligible dependents.
  • Premium Mental Health Support: Full, free access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with a 50% company match on your first 6% of contributions (a 3% total match).
  • Financial Security: 100% employer-paid Life and Disability insurance for your peace of mind.
  • Flexible Paid Time Off: A flexible PTO policy, supplemented with additional company-wide Rest & Recharge days throughout the year.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Up to 16 weeks of paid leave for new parents to support you in expanding your family.
  • Annual Lifestyle Stipend: A $1,000 USD annual Lifestyle Spending Account to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being.
  • Work From Home Support: A one-time $550 USD stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD stipend for internet.
  • Giving Back: 16 hours of paid volunteer time annually, plus a $100 annual match for your charitable donations.
  • Additional Financial Perks: Access to pre-tax commuter benefits, subsidized child/eldercare (Care.com), discounted pet insurance (Figo), and no-cost personalized financial wellness support through Your Money Line.

*This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits.

Whenever possible, Sprout wants to provide our team with the flexibility to work in the location that makes the most sense for them. Sprout maintains a remote workforce in many places in the United States. However, we are not set up in all states, so please look at the drop-down box in our application to see whether your state is listed. Few roles require an office setting. If your position requires a physical presence in a Sprout office, it will be evident in the job listing and your offer letter.

Our salary ranges reflect the expected earning potential for this role. Individual pay is based on geographic zone, relevant experience, and skills.

Our current hiring range for this role: $90,400 – $113,000 annually. Offers are made within this range, with opportunities to grow within the broader band based on performance and impact.

We share both our current hiring range and our broader geographic salary bands to provide transparency into our compensation philosophy. This ensures you understand not only your starting potential but also the long-term growth potential available as you progress in your role.

We have two geographic pay zones in the United States:

These ranges were determined by a market-based compensation approach; we used data from trusted third-party compensation sources to set equitable, consistent, and competitive ranges. Qualifications

These state-of-the-art platforms are powered by proprietary in-house technology, a key component of PENN’s omnichannel gaming and entertainment strategy.

When you join PENN Entertainment’s digital team, you’ll not only work on these cutting-edge platforms through theScore and PENN Interactive, but you’ll also be part of a company that truly cares about your career growth. We’re committed to supporting you as you expand your skills and explore new opportunities.

With locations throughout North America, you can build a future at PENN Entertainment wherever you are. If you want to challenge conventions in gaming, media and entertainment, we want to talk to you.

About the Team We build backend services and real-time APIs that power what bettors and players see and do in theScore Bet, Hollywood Casino, and theScore Casino. We support iOS, Android, and web. Our work is moving closer to the apps themselves, and our engineers increasingly pair with the mobile teams.

We focus on outcomes, not ticket counts. A project starts with a goal we can measure. You own it until the goal is met.

About the Work

  • Design, scale, and tune APIs and the real-time delivery behind them.
  • Treat the API schema as a versioned contract with released mobile apps. Classify breaking changes, plan migrations with the iOS and Android leads, and keep client models in sync.
  • Build and operate services that stay fast and correct under high throughput, bursty load.
  • Find bottlenecks and risks in production and drive the changes that make the platform scale.
  • Set up and refine monitoring, alerting, and tracing in Datadog for the systems you own.
  • Develop native Android and iOS features in Swift or Kotlin when a feature needs it, alongside the mobile teams.
  • Write thorough tests for every feature and bug fix.
  • Own features end to end, from the API to the screen. Pair with iOS, Android, and web engineers, and learn enough of their code to make targeted changes when the feature needs it.
  • Debug problems that cross the client and server boundary.
  • Shape APIs from the client's point of view: what the app needs, how it caches, and how it behaves on a weak network.
  • Use AI coding agents, such as Claude Code, as your main way of building. You plan the work, direct the agent, and review its output to the same standard as any teammate's code.
  • Draft proposals, tech specs, and runbooks, and present them to leadership and partner teams.
  • Mentor teammates through code review, pairing, and writing things down.
  • Other duties as required.

About You

  • Hands-on, daily experience building software with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot agents, or similar). You can describe how you prompt, constrain, test, and review agent output, and where agents fail.
  • At least 5 years of experience in software engineering, with most of it on backend or API systems.
  • 2+ years designing and evolving APIs used by multiple clients (iOS, Android, web), including versioning and backward compatibility.
  • Willing to learn native iOS and Android development in Swift or Kotlin. Prior mobile shipping experience is a plus, not a requirement. You use AI coding agents to close the gap, and you review their mobile output with the mobile leads.
  • Experience building real-time features, such as subscriptions, streaming, or push-based updates.
  • A solid foundation in computer science, with strong competencies in data structures, distributed systems, algorithms, and software design.
  • Experience finding and fixing production performance regressions, including CPU, I/O, memory, and latency problems, through load testing and tracing.
  • Experience on an on-call rotation for a production service, and owning release cycles end to end.
  • Experience with a server framework such as Phoenix, Ruby on Rails, FastAPI, Laravel, or Node.
  • Clear writing. You have authored tech specs, runbooks, and cross-team design docs that stood up to scrutiny.
  • You care about clean architecture and about code you won't mind reading a year from now.
  • Comfortable working in the terminal, with Git and GitHub or similar, and in an editor of your choice.

Nice to have

  • Native mobile experience in Swift or Kotlin. You have shipped, or contributed to, an iOS or Android app, and you are comfortable pairing with mobile engineers.
  • GraphQL, including federated graphs
  • Elixir and Absinthe
  • Strong relational database skills, such as PostgreSQL or MySQL
  • Kubernetes and operating services in containers
  • Background job processing (Oban, Exq, Sidekiq, Celery) and event infrastructure (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS/SNS, Pub/Sub)

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Fun, relaxed work environment
  • Education and conference reimbursements.
  • Opportunities for career progression and mentoring others
Salary Range
$145,000—$193,000 CAD

We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Penn Interactive provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Additionally, Penn Interactive provides best-in-class benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality – to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life.

Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

To help our teams work effectively, this role is fully remote, but requires you to be located in within Australia/New Zealand.

Responsibilities

Your Future Org

The Growth Organization enables all Atlassian current and future users to easily discover, try, adopt and get value from Atlassian core products of Jira, Confluence, Loom and Teamwork Collection. The Growth Org combines product thinking, platforms and data analysis to drive experimentation across products resulting in greater engagement, use and long term value for customers.

As a Senior Principal Engineer in the Growth Organization, you will help turn this vision into reality by shaping the platforms that support new & upgrading customer flows, identifying technical strategy and driving the Atlassian AI transformation making our products the agent-native system of record. Your success will seen and felt by customers and will be achieved through combining data, product/market understanding and innovation to help customers capture the full value of their teamwork.

Your Future Team

The Growth Monetization team optimizes the services and experiences for customers in Atlassian core products. The team directly contributes to Atlassian Revenue by creating and testing customer interactions from first contact with the product through to purchase. Main areas of focus will be:

  • Guiding teams in Front End development to implement new Customer-facing experiments and instrument data collection

  • Understand the user journey and purchase funnel for Product Led Sales, using data to guide decisions

Responsibilities

  • Own the technical evolution and long-term architecture of the Growth Monetization services, customer experiences and experimentation platforms

  • Collaborate across Product teams defining forward roadmaps for multiple teams driving customer success

  • Maintain high standards of Operational Excellence in Growth Monetization platforms and services for performance, reliability, observability and data safety and security.

  • Continually raise technical standards and success through hands-on leadership in reviews, investigations, incidents and critical Product problem solving, mentoring Principal and Senior Engineers

  • Lead technical experimentation strategies across multiple teams driving product and engineering approaches

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Experience in Full Stack development converting designs into performant and reliable customer experiences

  • 12+ years of experience developing large scale distributed systems.

  • 4+ years of experience providing architectural oversight and technical leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven experience at department-level: shaping technical direction across teams and influencing architecture and product strategy beyond a single service.

  • Track record of leading major architectural initiatives and turning multi-year strategy into incremental delivery and measurable outcomes.

  • Extensive experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems, data streaming platforms and event-driven architecture

  • Broad knowledge of SaaS, PaaS, IaaS and hands-on experience with public clouds (ideally AWS and/or GCP).

  • Fluency in any modern object-oriented programming language (e.g., Java, Golang, Python, Javascript, go etc.) and in architecture patterns for distributed systems.

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers, leading technical reviews, and improving engineering quality and productivity.

  • Quick learner who excels in ambiguous environments.

Qualifications

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

Please visit go.atlassian.com/payzones for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits.

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh.

In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

ABOUT KOLSQUARE

Kolsquareis the #1 Influencer Marketing software solution in Europe, used by marketing professionals for managing KOL Marketing campaigns (K.O.L for Key Opinion Leaders, aka Influencers), and designed to optimize brand communication strategies in response to new digital challenges.
Using our technology, professionals can identify the best KOL profiles, fully manage their KOL Marketing campaigns and measure their results and performances.

Kolsquare offers hundreds of customers (Coca-Cola, Danone, Publicis, Orange, Sézane, Decathlon, etc.) the latest Big Data, AI and Machine Learning technologies to activate inspiring and genuine partnerships with over 3M KOLs (Key Opinion Leaders) with more than 5,000 followers in 180 countries on Instagram, TikTok, Twitter (now X), Facebook, Snap and YouTube.

In 2024, Kolsquare joined the team.blue group, one of the largest private tech companies in Europe, with a culture of innovation and excellence, to further fuel its impressive track record of outstanding profitable growth.

KOLSQUARE MISSION

Kolsquare is a Benefit Company, certified B-Corp in 2024.

Kolsquare exists to help you reach your greatest potential. And positively impact the world.

Influencer Marketing is today described as a revolution, a 30B$ market that is a major transformation in the media and digital world. It has also become a real gold mine, creating high hopes but also bringing its share of myths and legends. Everyone knows it works and can have an amazing impact on brand awareness or customer acquisition, but not everyone knows exactly how to do it. At Kolsquare, we firmly believe in this new media and are convinced that it's the best way for ideas, people and organisations to grow and reach their greatest potential. We also believe that it's a great way to create positive impacts for a better world. Our mission is therefore to give everyone access to the power of KOL Marketing.

KOLSQUARE CULTURE & VALUES

  • Deliver WOW

  • Be Responsible in your actions

  • Pursue Growth & Learning

  • Be passionate and determined

  • Share your Power, Knowledge & Wealth

  • Build Authentic relationships

We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers better business results.

📌 More info about culture here in our Culture Book.

WHY JOIN KOLSQUARE AS A BDR SPAIN ?

Spain is a key growth market for Kolsquare, and you'll play an important role in accelerating our expansion.

You'll join an established BDR team with a proven outbound strategy and a modern AI-powered tech stack. Over the past 12 months, we've grown outbound pipeline by 90% year over year.

With dedicated coaching and the autonomy to experiment, you'll sharpen your prospecting skills and contribute directly to Kolsquare's growth in Spain.

YOUR TEAM AND ECOSYSTEM

You'll join a fully remote, international team of around 18 BDRs across Europe and the US, sharing best practices and working together to drive pipeline growth.

You'll report to our Head of Business Development, who will support your development through regular 1:1s, hands-on coaching and structured onboarding.

You'll partner closely with our Account Executives covering the Spanish market, booking qualified discovery meetings on a round-robin basis, aligning on prospecting priorities, and ensuring smooth opportunity handovers with support from Sales RevOps.

Regular team rituals and quarterly in-person offsites across Europe help keep everyone connected.

YOUR ROLE

Outbound Prospecting & Account Research

  • Build targeted outreach sequences combining automated emails, LinkedIn, personalized video through Vidyard and cold calls.

  • Research Spanish brands, agencies and decision-makers using Salesforce, Outreach, Clay, Apollo, Cognism and AI tools such as Claude and Gemini

  • Own your lead sourcing and account mapping, identifying and prioritizing high-potential accounts.

Pipeline Generation & Lead Qualification

  • Generate qualified pipeline, with approximately 70% of leads coming from outbound prospecting and 30% from Marketing-generated inbound leads.

  • Work towards monthly targets of meetings booked and Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs).

  • Identify prospects' key challenges and assess their fit efficiently, prioritizing business relevance and a smooth handover to your Account Executive over lengthy qualification calls.

Inbound Leads & Industry Events

  • Follow up promptly on inbound leads allocated across the team.

  • Represent Kolsquare at marketing events, trade shows and industry conferences, building relationships and generating new opportunities.

Continuous Improvement

  • Test and refine messaging, email sequences and value propositions to improve conversion rates.

  • Share insights and best practices with the wider BDR team.

YOUR PROFILE

We're looking for a curious, results-driven BDR who enjoys building relationships, experimenting with new prospecting approaches and turning opportunities into qualified pipeline.

What you'll bring🫵

  • Languages: Native Spanish and professional fluency in English.

  • Sales experience: 1–2+ years in a BDR/SDR role in B2B SaaS, with evidence of working towards and achieving prospecting targets.

  • Outbound expertise: Experience with multi-channel prospecting, account research and personalized outreach.

  • Data-driven mindset: Ability to track your performance, understand conversion metrics and adapt your approach accordingly.

  • Autonomy: Comfortable organizing your work and managing priorities in a fully remote environment.

  • Market curiosity: A genuine interest in digital marketing, social media and the creator economy.

Nice to have✌️

  • Experience prospecting to marketing decision-makers, brands or agencies in Spain.

  • Familiarity with AI-powered prospecting, lead enrichment or personalized outreach.

  • Experience generating leads through industry events or trade shows.

WHAT WE OFFER?

  • Remote work & flexibility: Work remotely from eligible European locations, with quarterly in-person team offsites.

  • Work-from-home support:A dedicated home office budget and access to coworking spaces.

  • Uncapped commissions and achievable targets: Monthly commission for every Sales Qualified Lead (SQL) validated by your Account Executive, plus additional commission on revenue generated by your pipeline when deals close.

  • Scale-up mindset, group backing:The agility of a growing company, backed by the resources and stability ofteam.blue.

  • Career development:opportunities to progress into BDR Team Lead or Account Executive roles depending on individual performance and business needs.

  • Modern sales tech stack:Salesforce, Outreach, Clay, Apollo, Cognism, Vidyard, Claude and ChatGPT.

  • Team spirit & incentives: Collaborative challenges and short sales sprints with incentives.

  • Purpose-driven impact: Join a certified B Corp committed to making creator marketing a force for good.

THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

  1. Intro call with Agathe, Talent Acquisition Partner (20-30min)

  2. interview with Santiago, Head of Business Develoment (45-60min)

  3. Practical Case Study & Role Play (60 min) with Santiago and Robin, VP Sales

  4. Interview with Julien, CRO (30min)

  5. Final interview with Quentin, our CEO (30min)

  6. Reference checks

We help individuals from around the world connect with great companies that are looking for their specific skill set.
