Our client is looking for an experienced Head of Finance / CFO to take full ownership of the company's financial operations, reporting, and strategic financial planning. This person will build and manage all core financial models, ensure financial accuracy, and provide the founders with clear, reliable insights into the business's financial performance.

Responsibilities

  • Unit Economics: Build and maintain financial models for CAC, CAC targets, and LTV, specifically for a subscription-based business.
  • Financial Reporting: Own and manage the company's core financial statements, including P&L, cash flow, and cash flow forecasting.
  • Financial Modeling: Develop, maintain, and update all core financial models on a weekly basis to ensure accuracy and provide visibility into business performance.

  • Payment Management: Oversee and process payments to business partners, including 3PLs and manufacturers, while establishing clear approval processes and improving payment terms.
  • Founder Reporting: Prepare weekly financial reports for the founders, providing clear insights into key financial metrics, cash flow, and overall business performance.
  • Financial Strategy: Work closely with the founders to improve financial visibility, optimize unit economics, and support strategic business decisions.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in a senior finance leadership role, such as Head of Finance, Finance Director, or CFO.
  • Strong financial experience within DTC e-commerce businesses, particularly subscription-based brands.
  • Proven track record of building CAC, CAC target, LTV, P&L, and cash flow models from scratch.
  • Deep understanding of financial planning, analysis, forecasting, and business performance metrics.
  • Strong understanding of DTC business operations and how marketing, customer acquisition, fulfillment, and operational costs impact profitability.
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, payment processes, and operating expenses.
  • Ability to independently own the finance function and communicate financial insights clearly to founders.
  • Highly detail-oriented, analytical, and comfortable working in a fast-paced business environment.

First 90-Day Expectations

In-House Recruiter

Location: Remote - Dominican Republic
Work Arrangement: This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.
Worker Type: Contractor
Industry: Real Estate & Construction / Home Services
Compensation: $800-$1,500 USD/month
Schedule: Full-time, aligned to U.S. Pacific Time business hours
Start Date: January 1, 2027
Experience: 2+ years of recruiting or sourcing for U.S.-based roles
English Proficiency: Excellent spoken and written English required

About the Company
Our client is a U.S. home services company with local operations in Nevada, Washington, and Idaho. It works to modernize an industry that has been slow to change, combining technology with craftsmanship, integrity, and strong customer service. The company builds on the tradition of local trade businesses while embracing innovation, and it prioritizes keeping local teams in place and growing those operations with care.
Local managers hire plumbing technicians today, with HVAC hiring expected to follow, and they need a dedicated recruiter to keep a steady flow of qualified candidates moving to interview.

About the Role
This is a full-time, remote recruiter role, and recruiting is the whole job. You will keep a steady stream of qualified plumbing technicians, and later HVAC technicians, flowing to local managers in Nevada, Washington, and Idaho.
You will find candidates, reach out to them, screen them, and book interviews. Managers interview and hire. The ideal candidate is organized, comfortable calling candidates all day in English, and experienced in high-volume or hourly hiring for U.S.-based roles.

Why This Opportunity?
  • A dedicated recruiting role with clear ownership of the full top-of-funnel process.
  • Direct impact: local managers spend their time interviewing qualified candidates instead of hunting for them.
  • Build a bench of candidates in multiple U.S. states and help fill technician roles quickly.
  • Fully remote role, working U.S. Pacific Time hours from Latin America.
  • Long-term, full-time opportunity with a clear weekly scoreboard.
  • Join a company that values integrity, craftsmanship, and customer service, and invests in growing its local teams.
What You'll Do
Sourcing & Job Advertising
  • Source technicians every day on job boards (Indeed, ZipRecruiter), Facebook groups, Craigslist, LinkedIn, trade schools, apprenticeship programs, and referrals.
  • Write and post job ads for each location and keep them fresh.
Outreach & Screening
  • Reach out to candidates by phone, text, and email, including people who are not actively looking.
  • Run short phone screens covering license level, experience, location, pay expectations, and availability.
Interview Coordination & Candidate Follow-Up
  • Book interviews on managers' calendars and confirm with candidates so they show up.
  • Follow up with candidates throughout the process so no one falls through the cracks.
Pipeline Management & Reporting
  • Keep every candidate tracked in the applicant tracking system or pipeline sheet.
  • Send a short weekly report: candidates sourced, contacted, screened, interviews booked, interviews held, and hires.
  • Build a bench of candidates for each location so the team can hire quickly when a spot opens.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
  • 2+ years of recruiting or sourcing for U.S.-based roles.
  • Experience with high-volume or hourly hiring (trades, construction, logistics, healthcare, or similar).
  • Excellent spoken and written English; comfortable calling candidates all day.
  • Able to work U.S. Pacific Time business hours.
  • Hands-on experience with Indeed and at least one applicant tracking system.
  • Very organized: you follow up without being reminded and keep your pipeline clean.
  • Reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and a working phone or VoIP setup.
  • Based in Latin America.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Recruiting for home services or skilled trades (plumbing, HVAC, electrical).
  • Understanding of U.S. trade licenses (apprentice, journeyman, master) and how they differ by state.
  • Experience recruiting in Nevada, Washington, or Idaho.
  • Experience with text-based recruiting tools or sourcing automation.
  • Familiarity with ServiceTitan or other field service software.
How Success Is Measured
  • Managers spend their time interviewing qualified candidates instead of hunting for them.
  • Every location has interviews on the calendar every week.
  • Open technician roles are filled quickly.
  • Phone screens consistently confirm license level, experience, location, pay expectations, and availability.
  • Interview show-up rates stay strong because candidates are confirmed and followed up with.
  • The pipeline is clean, current, and visible, and weekly reports are accurate and on time.
  • Each location has a ready bench of candidates for faster hiring when a seat opens.
Why Join Us
  • Fully remote opportunity from Latin America.
  • Competitive compensation: $800-$1,500 USD/month, depending on experience.
  • Clear ownership of a full-time recruiting mandate, not a mixed admin role.
  • Direct impact on hiring speed for U.S. operations in Nevada, Washington, and Idaho.
  • A role where organization, follow-through, and high-volume execution are visible every week.
  • A culture built on integrity, craftsmanship, and customer service, with a focus on supporting and growing local teams.
Important Notes
This is a full-time recruiting role. You source, contact, screen, and book interviews. Managers interview and hire.
Applications may not be considered if candidates:
  • Cannot work U.S. Pacific Time business hours.
  • Do not have excellent spoken and written English, or are not comfortable calling candidates all day.
  • Do not have at least 2 years of recruiting or sourcing experience for U.S.-based roles.
  • Do not have experience with high-volume or hourly hiring.
  • Do not have reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and a working phone or VoIP setup.
Please submit your CV in English, highlighting your U.S. recruiting or sourcing experience, high-volume or hourly hiring background, and experience with Indeed and any ATS you have used.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

Overview The position of Development Engineer will provide technical direction to assigned design efforts pre-and post-award of projects and will report to the Engineering Department Manager. This position will play a critical role on the project development team and must have experience in mechanical design with a construction company in a construction environment. This role requires experience in the development of gas-fired Power Generation facilities including combined cycle experience!! Location and Travel Details: This is a remote role and can be based anywhere in the United States. Must be able to travel up to 30% of the time. Company Overview MasTec Industrial, along with sister companies Casey Industrial and Phoenix Industrial, has served the power industry since 1947. We support utilities, developers, and municipalities with EPC services and project development expertise. Ranked by ENR as the #1 Power Contractor, we specialize in natural gas, oil, biomass, and waste-to-energy projects. Our team brings over 30 years of experience in utility and industrial systems, including simple and combined cycle plants and reciprocating engines. We’re committed to delivering quality, safety, and value at every project phase, from concept to operations. At MasTec Industrial, we invest in top talent and foster a respectful, inclusive environment where employees thrive as innovative leaders. The MasTec Industrial market sector is part of the MasTec Clean Energy & Infrastructure business segment. MasTec’s Clean Energy & Infrastructure (CE&I) segment generates over $4 billion in annual revenue, providing construction services across industrial, renewables and infrastructure sectors. Sustainability and safety are foundational to our culture and influence everything we do. MasTec, a minority-owned Fortune 500 company, has shaped the construction industry for more than 90 years. With over 35,000 employees and 400 offices nationwide, we provide flexibility and career growth in dynamic work environments. Responsibilities Review RFP/RFQ/Contract packages for technical requirements Prepare and maintain proposal technical exceptions and clarifications during the proposal process Develop technical bid packages for equipment and subcontractors Prepare technical evaluations and technical recommendations for equipment and subcontractors Monitor, support and administer technical subcontractors Review engineering deliverables for accuracy and Contract compliance Manage 3rd party engineers for progress, quality, and cost for specific discipline Provide input to schedule development Provide input to estimating regarding quantities and scope Support development of project reports and status updates Facilitate constructability reviews with engineering and construction parties Support construction and commissioning during and after completion of design engineering, for example RFI responses Develop project division of responsibilities Development of technical elements of project execution plans Visit sites as needed to assist on-site as required Visit subcontractors and suppliers to monitor progress and quality as required Support project closeout Qualifications EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS: 4-8 years of relevant experience in engineering Bachelor’s degree in Engineering PE Certification and desire and ability to obtain PE Certification in other states as a required for projects Capable to visit construction sites and operating industrial plants KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES REQUIRED: Be knowledgeable of MIC Health and Safety programs and project specific regulations. When on-site, actively participate in daily toolbox meetings with crews and subcontractors. Set a personal example of safe behavior. Enthusiastic, willing to learn and flexible regarding day-to-day responsibilities Skilled in oral and written communication Passionate to be a technical team member to accomplish a high-quality product that satisfies the contractual requirements within budget and schedule Technical interdisciplinary communication and knowledge to enable other technical groups to produce a high-quality product Knowledgeable in industry standards, specifications and organizations Experience with execution of multiple EPC projects from bid through project completion Experience in developing, executing and presenting a high-quality proposal to management Other may duties may be assigned PHYSICAL DEMANDS: This position requires prolonged sitting at a desk and working at a computer. Must be able to lift up to 20 pounds at times. What's in it for you: Financial Wellbeing Compensation $140,000 - $180,000 per year, commensurate with experience. Competitive pay with ongoing performance review and merit increase 401(k) with company match & Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) Flexible spending account (Healthcare & Dependent care) Health & Wellness Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance (plan choice) - coverage for spouse, domestic partner, and children Diabetes Management, Telehealth Coverage, Prescription Drug Plan, Pet Insurance Family & Lifestyle Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, Bereavement Leave Military Leave, including Differential Pay and Benefits Continuation Employee Assistance Program Planning for the Unexpected Short and long-term disability, life insurance, and accidental death & dismemberment Voluntary life insurance, accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity coverage Emergency Travel Assistance Program Group legal plan Position may be subject to pre-employment screening, which may include background check and drug testing. Accessibility: If you need an accommodation as part of the employment process, contact . Due to the high volume of applications received, we are unable to respond to individual requests regarding application status. Please log into your candidate profile for up-to-date information. MasTec, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veteran. The Company's policy is not to unlawfully discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military status, or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state, or local laws. The Company also prohibits harassment of applicants and employees based on any of these protected categories. It is also MasTec's policy to comply with all applicable state, federal and local laws respecting consideration of unemployment status in making hiring decisions. Disclaimer: MasTec and our Subsidiaries will never ask prospective employees for any form of payment or money transfer as part of job application or onboarding. Join Kainos and Shape the Future

At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.

We believe in a people-first culture, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.

Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.

MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES IN THE BUSINESS:
As an experienced Content Designer (Consultant) at Kainos, you will be responsible for creating clear, user-centered content and making use of recognised content design guidelines and principles. You will be an advocate for user-centered design, design thinking and service design, and passionate about guiding others in content design. You may also manage, coach and develop a small number of staff, with a focus on managing employee performance and assisting in their career development.

You will be part of our growing Experience Design capability creating exemplary digital services. We are supportive, collaborative, talented, and hugely passionate about user-centred design. We are not about marketing and dark patterns; we are all about making a positive, measurable impact on millions of people through quality products and services.

MINIMUM (ESSENTIAL) REQUIREMENTS:

  • Lead and carry out the design of user-centred content experiences, owning specific work areas
    • Expertise in planning, commissioning, creating and editing digital content across various channels
    • Can develop content strategies and recommendations based on user needs, research and analysis
    • Comfortable writing style and tone of voice guides
    • Able to contribute to the definition of KPIs within a service
    • Comfortable running content workshops and able to recommend on best tools and methods for content delivery
    • Experience producing style, governance and workflow guidelines
    • We are passionate about developing people – a demonstrated ability in managing, coaching and developing senior members of your team and wider community
    • Able to communicate effectively at all levels
    • Excellent commercial awareness
    • Strong stakeholder management skills
    • Strong awareness of content design/strategy trends and best practices

    DESIRABLE
    • Experience in assisting with or conducting research and analysing findings to identify content needs
    • Experience of working in a full-service digital agency environment
    • Experience working with Agile delivery methodologies

Embracing our differences  

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

Our friendly talent acquisition team is here to support you every step of the way, so if you require any accommodations or adjustments, we encourage you to reach out.

We understand that everyone's journey is different, and by having a private conversation we can ensure that our recruitment process is tailored to your needs.

raw.description:
FICO (NYSE: FICO)is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

The Opportunity


As a Principal Applied AI Engineer on FICO’s Generative AI team, you will work at the frontier of language model applications, designing novel solutions that reach across the FICO platform, from fraud investigation and decision automation to process flow automation and optimization. You will be the architect of robust, scalable, and well-governed AI systems, ensuring they perform reliably at enterprise scale. Working alongside a dedicated team, you will apply your expertise in AI and machine learning to infuse the platform with next-generation capabilities and drive innovation that makes a meaningful, lasting impact.


What You’ll Contribute


  • Design and implement cutting-edge LLM-powered solutions for decision automation, fraud investigation, and process automation within FICO’s platform.
  • Develop sophisticated prompting strategies and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures tailored to high-stakes applications.
  • Apply advanced fine-tuning, in-context learning techniques, and custom evaluation frameworks to optimize AI model performance.
  • Build robust model evaluation and governance systems, ensuring compliance and reliability across applications.
  • Design and execute comprehensive backtesting methodologies to validate model predictions and performance.
  • Implement A/B testing frameworks to evaluate the impact of various AI interventions on system performance.
  • Monitor model performance and detect drift to maintain high accuracy and relevance over time.
  • Research and integrate the latest AI techniques to keep FICO’s platform at the forefront of innovation.
  • Evaluate new models, architectures, and training approaches, experimenting with emerging technologies to enhance platform capabilities.
  • Develop custom RAG implementations to enhance information retrieval within decision processes.
  • Write production-quality code, implementing machine learning systems with attention to scalability, reliability, and security.
  • Design scalable architectures that support FICO’s analytics and decisioning solutions.
  • Implement advanced monitoring techniques and system reliability checks to maintain operational excellence.

What We’re Seeking


  • Extensive industry experience in software, ML or data engineering, with a history of managing complex, large-scale projects and driving strategic technical decisions.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience in fine-tuning, model adaptation, and customization.
  • Solid foundation in machine learning evaluation and testing methodologies, including the development of custom evaluation frameworks.
  • Extensive experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures and familiarity with vector databases
  • Strong hands-on coding in Python, Go, Java, or similar languages.
  • Experience with PyTorch, JAX or similar deep learning frameworks.
  • Knowledge of backtesting methodologies to ensure reliability and robustness of model predictions.
  • Experience with A/B testing frameworks.
  • Expertise in model monitoring, drift detection, and governance to maintain compliance and operational integrity.
  • Proven expertise in modern Large Language Models (LLMs) and their applications preferred.
  • Strong skills in prompt engineering and chain-of-thought prompting techniques.
  • Familiarity with compliance and regulatory technology, particularly in AI-driven decisioning environments.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, with experience in writing production-quality code and designing scalable architectures.
  • Proven ability to mentor teams and collaborate across departments to deliver high-impact solutions.
  • Experience in fast-paced environments, with an ability to adapt and drive impact in high-growth, high-stakes settings.
  • Publications, patents, or open-source contributions that showcase thought leadership and technical expertise in AI and machine learning.
  • Bachelor's/Master's/PhD degree in computer science, or a related field with focus in Machine Learning.

Our Offer to You


  • An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
  • The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
  • Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
  • An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.
  • The targeted base pay range for this role is: $171,500 to $269,500 with this range reflecting differences in candidate knowledge, skills and experience.

Why Make a Move to FICO?

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.

FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:

• Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.

• Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.

• Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at

FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Research has shown that women and candidates from underrepresented communities may not apply for an opportunity if they don’t meet all stated qualifications. While our qualifications are clearly related to role success, each candidate’s profile is unique and strengths in certain skill and/or experience areas can be equally effective. If you believe you have many, but not necessarily all, of the stated qualifications we encourage you to apply.

Information submitted with your application is subject to the FICO Privacy policy at

raw.description:
Stronger Consulting | Remote | OTE $120,000–$150,000 (Base $60,000–$75,000)

ABOUT STRONGER CONSULTING

Stronger Consulting believes in the power of great leadership to drive positive change. We are dedicated to helping mission-aligned organizations find the right talent and strategies to maximize their impact. We imagine a future in which everyone can access fair and outstanding educational and life opportunities, and we partner with nonprofits, charter school networks, and social-sector organizations to make that vision real.

Our work is grounded in core values: Boundless Optimism, Equitable Empowerment, Informed Transparency, Compassionate Connection, and Respect. We approach every engagement with integrity, transparency, and customization, leveraging data and asking the right questions to produce quality insights for our partners.

We are a mission-driven search and strategic advisory firm with a strong track record of placing leaders of color and building diverse talent pipelines that connect equity-focused leaders with the organizations that need them most.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Stronger Consulting is seeking a driven and purpose-led Director of Business Development to fuel our next chapter of growth. In this full-cycle sales role, you will build and cultivate relationships with nonprofit and charter school leaders, identify new opportunities, and close enterprise-level consulting engagements. This is not a role for someone waiting to be told what to do. You must be a self-starter who brings their own network, thrives in consultative sales, and is genuinely energized by the mission behind the work.

OTE: $120,000–$150,000 | Base Salary: $60,000–$75,000
Location: Remote | Department: Business Development

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the full sales cycle from prospecting and outreach to proposal, negotiation, and close, targeting nonprofits and charter networks with $20M+ in revenue.
  • Build and leverage a pre-existing network in the nonprofit/social sector to generate pipeline and open doors to new engagements.
  • Drive consultative, advisory-style sales conversations with senior leaders, understanding client challenges and positioning Stronger Consulting's services as the strategic solution.
  • Develop and execute a multithreading strategy to engage multiple stakeholders within prospect organizations and manage complex, longer-cycle deals.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline activity in the CRM; use AI tools to enhance prospecting, outreach, and research efficiency.
  • Represent Stronger Consulting at sector conferences, convenings, and industry events to elevate brand visibility and cultivate relationships.
  • Collaborate with the leadership team on go-to-market strategy, refining messaging and identifying new market opportunities.
  • Provide regular pipeline updates and revenue forecasts to leadership; contribute to business development strategy and planning.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

  • Proven track record in full-cycle, consultative/advisory sales with demonstrated ability to source, develop, and close enterprise-level deals.
  • Direct experience selling into nonprofits and/or public school districts and charter school networks; familiarity with the decision-making dynamics of social-sector organizations.
  • Existing extensive national network within the nonprofit sector that can be activated from day one.
  • Strong relationship-building skills; able to build trust with executive and senior-level stakeholders over long sales cycles.
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms and AI-enabled sales tools.
  • Demonstrated understanding of multithreading and managing complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
  • A self-directed, proactive work style; comfortable driving activity without a playbook.
  • Mission alignment: genuine commitment to the work of strengthening nonprofits and social-sector organizations.

Preferred:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience (degree preferred but not required).
  • Experience at a consulting firm or professional services organization.
  • Background in selling services to organizations with $20M+ budgets.
  • Familiarity with the charter school, school district, or K-12 education sector.
  • Comfort attending and networking at national or regional nonprofit sector conferences.

WHY JOIN US?

  • Purpose-driven work: Every deal you close directly strengthens a nonprofit's ability to serve its community. The impact is real and tangible.
  • Ownership & autonomy: This role comes with genuine decision-making authority and room to build; you won't be micromanaged.
  • Competitive compensation: OTE of $120K–$150K with a base of $60K–$75K, rewarding performance meaningfully.
  • Remote flexibility: 100% remote position and must be based in the US, Canada, or Central/South America. You can work from anywhere while staying deeply connected to a collaborative, high-trust team.
  • Growth trajectory: Join during an exciting growth phase and help shape the business development function as the firm scales.
  • Inclusive, equity-centered culture: We are a team that leads with values; collaborative, humble, anti-racist, and mission-first.

Buscamos un/a Data Architect / Data Architecture Manager para incorporarse a la Oficina de Arquitectura del programa Casiopea R2C.

La persona será responsable de validar los diseños técnicos de los Bounded Contexts y microservicios desde la perspectiva de datos, así como de definir y supervisar la convivencia, sincronización, migración y gobierno de la información entre el monolito Casiopea y la nueva arquitectura R2C.

¿Qué buscamos?

Experiencia sólida como Data Architect / Data Architecture Manager.
Experiencia en arquitectura de datos y microservicios.
Conocimientos sólidos de Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
Experiencia con Change Data Capture (CDC).
Experiencia en arquitecturas orientadas a eventos.
Experiencia en migración y sincronización de datos.
Experiencia con SQL Server / Azure SQL.
Experiencia en patrones de convivencia entre sistemas legacy y arquitecturas cloud.

Capacidad de liderazgo y autonomía.

Experiencia en interlocución con cliente y proveedores.

Capacidad para revisar diseños técnicos y tomar decisiones con una orientación práctica.

📩 ¿Te interesa?

Si eres Data Architect y tienes experiencia en modernización, microservicios, DDD y convivencia entre arquitecturas legacy y cloud, ¡queremos conocerte!

raw.excerpt: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise.
raw.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

About the Role

As an Industry Principal at Snowflake, you will represent Snowflake to the Office of the CMO across non-regulated industries (e.g. Technology, Media and Manufacturing) at the intersection of marketing strategy, customer data, advertising, and AI. You will help marketing leaders at digitally sophisticated companies rethink how they measure, activate, and personalize engagement on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud and across its broad partner ecosystem, spanning MarTech, AdTech, Identity Resolution, Agentic Solutions, and Measurement partners.

Your mission is to turn marketing and advertising challenges into repeatable, scalable solutions, from AI-assisted measurement and clean room collaboration to real-time audience activation and agentic decisioning. You will pair deep marketing and analytics experience with modern data and AI capabilities, working alongside sales, solution engineering, product, and ecosystem partners across AdTech, MarTech, and identity to shape how Snowflake shows up for marketing leaders in fast-moving businesses. You report to the Global Head Business Solutions.

What You'll Do

Lead strategic engagements with marketing leaders Partner with CMOs, heads of growth, marketing analytics, audience strategy, marketing technology, and media on high-impact initiatives. You are credible in these conversations because you have built or operated the programs they care about, whether an attribution model, an incrementality practice, or a data-driven audience or advertising business.

Translate marketing outcomes into vision and solutions Connect business priorities in measurement, audience and first-party data strategy, personalization, identity resolution, and decisioning to practical roadmaps that create business, technical, and cultural value. Help customers see how a connected customer data foundation and integrated partner ecosystem accelerate growth.

Build for the business Use Snowflake's AI and data capabilities to create demonstrable, grounded examples of what is possible, such as:

  • Measurement and attribution on unified first-party and media data

  • Audience intelligence, propensity, and next-best-action models

  • AI assistants that help marketing teams explore performance and answer questions in natural language

  • Real-time personalization, agentic automation, identity resolution, and secure data collaboration with media, AdTech, and commerce partners

Scale through repeatable assets Package what works into reusable stories, frameworks, and assets that help field teams and partners engage marketing leaders with consistency and credibility.

Be a visible marketing and AI thought leader Share points of view and best practices through customer workshops, enablement, webinars, and industry events, helping customers and colleagues understand what great looks like for AI in marketing.

Who You Are

Marketing and advertising expertise

  • Meaningful experience inside a technology, media, or manufacturing organization in growth, marketing analytics, audience or data strategy, or marketing technology, ideally complemented by time advising or selling to that same audience

  • Familiarity with first-party data, identity resolution, programmatic AdTech, audience monetization, and B2B go-to-market data is a plus

Balanced across measurement, activation, and insights

  • Practical command of marketing measurement, such as mix modeling, attribution, and experimentation

  • Experience with audience strategy, customer data platforms, and real-time or event-driven activation

  • Ability to turn insight into decisions that changed budgets, programs, or customer outcomes

Hands-on with data and AI

  • Experience building, guiding, or evaluating predictive, generative, and agentic AI applications in marketing or advertising, with a clear sense of where AI and partner integrations create real value; complementary depth and understanding in Machine Learning (ML) ideal.

  • Comfort with modern data architecture and the ability to engage credibly with data and engineering teams

Commercial and executive presence

  • A record of measurable business impact, including revenue, pipeline, or programs you influenced

  • Confidence presenting to and advising senior executives, and navigating relationships where customers are also partners

Collaborative and scalable

  • Proven ability to partner with sales, solution engineering, product, and partners to win and expand strategic relationships

  • Energized by enabling others and scaling impact through reusable approaches

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, statistics, economics, computer science, or equivalent practical experience; MBA or advanced degree preferred

  • 15+ years of experience in marketing analytics, marketing technology, customer data, advertising, or related consulting

  • Willingness to travel for customer meetings, field events, and industry conferences

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information:

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

  • This role is eligible to participate in Snowflake's commission plan and it is common for employees in this role to receive total on-target earnings of $340,800 - $447,300. The estimated base salary for this role is $255,600 - $335,475.

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

About the Role

As an Industry Principal at Snowflake, you will represent Snowflake to the Office of the CMO across non-regulated industries (e.g. Technology, Media and Manufacturing) at the intersection of marketing strategy, customer data, advertising, and AI. You will help marketing leaders at digitally sophisticated companies rethink how they measure, activate, and personalize engagement on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud and across its broad partner ecosystem, spanning MarTech, AdTech, Identity Resolution, Agentic Solutions, and Measurement partners.

Your mission is to turn marketing and advertising challenges into repeatable, scalable solutions, from AI-assisted measurement and clean room collaboration to real-time audience activation and agentic decisioning. You will pair deep marketing and analytics experience with modern data and AI capabilities, working alongside sales, solution engineering, product, and ecosystem partners across AdTech, MarTech, and identity to shape how Snowflake shows up for marketing leaders in fast-moving businesses. You report to the Global Head Business Solutions.

What You'll Do

Lead strategic engagements with marketing leaders Partner with CMOs, heads of growth, marketing analytics, audience strategy, marketing technology, and media on high-impact initiatives. You are credible in these conversations because you have built or operated the programs they care about, whether an attribution model, an incrementality practice, or a data-driven audience or advertising business.

Translate marketing outcomes into vision and solutions Connect business priorities in measurement, audience and first-party data strategy, personalization, identity resolution, and decisioning to practical roadmaps that create business, technical, and cultural value. Help customers see how a connected customer data foundation and integrated partner ecosystem accelerate growth.

Build for the business Use Snowflake's AI and data capabilities to create demonstrable, grounded examples of what is possible, such as:

  • Measurement and attribution on unified first-party and media data

  • Audience intelligence, propensity, and next-best-action models

  • AI assistants that help marketing teams explore performance and answer questions in natural language

  • Real-time personalization, agentic automation, identity resolution, and secure data collaboration with media, AdTech, and commerce partners

Scale through repeatable assets Package what works into reusable stories, frameworks, and assets that help field teams and partners engage marketing leaders with consistency and credibility.

Be a visible marketing and AI thought leader Share points of view and best practices through customer workshops, enablement, webinars, and industry events, helping customers and colleagues understand what great looks like for AI in marketing.

Who You Are

Marketing and advertising expertise

  • Meaningful experience inside a technology, media, or manufacturing organization in growth, marketing analytics, audience or data strategy, or marketing technology, ideally complemented by time advising or selling to that same audience

  • Familiarity with first-party data, identity resolution, programmatic AdTech, audience monetization, and B2B go-to-market data is a plus

Balanced across measurement, activation, and insights

  • Practical command of marketing measurement, such as mix modeling, attribution, and experimentation

  • Experience with audience strategy, customer data platforms, and real-time or event-driven activation

  • Ability to turn insight into decisions that changed budgets, programs, or customer outcomes

Hands-on with data and AI

  • Experience building, guiding, or evaluating predictive, generative, and agentic AI applications in marketing or advertising, with a clear sense of where AI and partner integrations create real value; complementary depth and understanding in Machine Learning (ML) ideal.

Commercial and executive presence

  • Confidence presenting to and advising senior executives, and navigating relationships where customers are also partners

Collaborative and scalable

  • Proven ability to partner with sales, solution engineering, product, and partners to win and expand strategic relationships

  • Energized by enabling others and scaling impact through reusable approaches

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, statistics, economics, computer science, or equivalent practical experience; MBA or advanced degree preferred

  • 15+ years of experience in marketing analytics, marketing technology, customer data, advertising, or related consulting

  • Willingness to travel for customer meetings, field events, and industry conferences

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

raw.description:
We’re hiring a Senior Solutions Architect to drive technical engagement with customers and partners across our AI Software Segment Solutions Architecture team, focused on open-weight AI models. You’ll connect real-world customer workloads to NVIDIA’s open-weight model and software ecosystem, helping developers and enterprises adopt and scale our platforms. . We’re looking for someone with strong technical depth who can serve as a trusted advisor, bridge complex challenges to innovative solutions, and grow into a strategic resource for the customers and partners you support. If you’re passionate about applied technology and enabling others to succeed with advanced platforms, we’d love to hear from you!


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Serve as a trusted advisor who understands complex or large-scale customer workloads and maps them to NVIDIA’s technology stack to achieve measurable outcomes.
  • Co-design advanced, scalable architectures with customers and partners, defining technical direction, integration achievements, and deployment plans.
  • Engage hands-on with deep technical topics—designing, validating, and supporting solutions that enable customer and partner success.
  • Lead technical engagements, helping customers resolve sophisticated issues, and advocate for their technical needs.
  • Partner multi-functionally with engineering and product teams to ensure successful deployment and continuous improvement of NVIDIA solutions.
  • Run end-to-end post-training programs with enterprise customers. This includes supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning (GRPO, DPO, PPO), LoRA / PEFT, data curation, synthetic data generation, reward design, and evaluation design.
  • Build evaluation environments that give customers an objective measure of post-training progress. These environments feed field signal back to Product and Research, improving the next generation of open-weight models.
  • Scale our impact by building reusable recipes, reference pipelines, and playbooks that let other teams succeed. Senior Solutions Architects also mentor other SAs and raise the technical bar on review and customer-facing deliverables.

What We Need to See:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of professional experience in Industry background spanning software/hardware engineering, developer relations, technical partnerships, solutions architecture, or product management — with 3-5+ years of direct, hands-on experience in open-weight model customization — including supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning (GRPO, DPO, PPO), LoRA / PEFT, data curation, synthetic data generation, reward design, and evaluation design.
  • Deep technical expertise in AI/ML and open-weight model post-training, with a track record of driving customer engagements and contributing to software platforms, systems, and libraries.
  • Shown ability to communicate sophisticated technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, from engineers to C-level executives.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and a dedication to helping customers succeed.
  • Proven success in balancing insight for customer and partner needs with the ability to drive complex product decisions through positive relationships.
  • Experience leading complex, ambiguous customer engagements, proactively pushing them forward. Proficiency with agent-assisted model training workflows and comfort using AI agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex to build, debug, and iterate on training and evaluation pipelines. Expertise in distributed computing, including launching and debugging multi-node training and evaluation jobs on SLURM or Kubernetes.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • A hands-on technical expert and problem solver who can clearly describe solution paths for complex challenges.
  • History of enabling customers and/or partners to optimally adopt NVIDIA technologies and platforms.
  • A technical vision that influences research, product, and engineering decisions and drives production outcomes.
  • Experience with and/or contributions to open-source NVIDIA AI libraries and models, particularly Nemotron, NeMo, NeMo-RL, and NeMo Gym. Hands-on experience designing agent environments, synthetic data pipelines, and verifiable rewards for RL post-training, or using serverless post-training APIs such as Tinker.
  • Hands-on experience customizing open-weight models (Nemotron, Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi), or AI model training applied to multimodal data. Experience designing benchmarks and evaluation harnesses that were adopted by other teams.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:
184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4; and 224,000 USD – 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 14, 2026.

Job Summary

Position Summary

The Director of Quality is an execution-focused leader responsible for translating WellBe’s enterprise quality strategy into disciplined, measurable operations across markets and health plan contracts.

This role leads the day-to-day Quality function, manages and develops team members, and redesigns care-gap closure workflows to be simpler, standardized, scalable, and integrated into clinical practice.

The Director partners closely with market, clinical, pharmacy, analytics, technology, coding, and health plan stakeholders to improve HEDIS and Medicare Advantage Stars performance, strengthen data reliability, increase frontline accountability, and ensure the organization consistently converts quality insights into action.

Job Description

Essential Duties and ResponsibilitiesLead day-to-day execution of the Quality program across Part C and Part D, converting enterprise goals into clear workplans, owners, timelines, operating rhythms, and measurable results.Directly manage, coach, and performance-manage Quality team members; establish clear productivity, quality, service, and accountability standards.Map end-to-end care-gap closure workflows across measures, markets, and health plan contracts; identify handoffs, rework, manual steps, failure points, and unnecessary variation.Redesign and standardize workflows so care-gap identification, outreach, documentation, closure, submission, and reconciliation are consistently executed and sustainable at scale.Engage Markets using structured working sessions that diagnose barriers, assign actions, monitor commitments, and drive closure at the patient, provider, measure, and market levels.Partner with clinical operations and technology teams to surface prioritized care gaps at the point of care and embed closure activities into APP workflows.Lead implementation and adoption of Quality workflow tools, including in-house technologies, point-of-care solutions, telephony or workforce-management tools, and future AI-enabled capabilities.Oversee HEDIS chart abstraction, primary source validation, medical record retrieval, supplemental data submissions, and health plan audit support, with an emphasis on accuracy, timeliness, and reduced manual effort.Manage medication adherence and other Part D outreach operations; use performance and workflow data to improve productivity, assess capacity, and inform staffing decisions.Partner with analytics, IT, and health plan teams to strengthen WellBe-owned quality reporting using claims, EMR, pharmacy, and supplemental data; reconcile numerator, denominator, timing, and data-integrity differences.Use market-, provider-, measure-, and patient-level data to prioritize interventions, forecast performance, monitor outcomes, and adjust tactics quickly when results are off track.Evaluate and implement practical automation and AI-assisted solutions that reduce repetitive work, improve chart-review efficiency, and allow the team to focus on higher-value intervention and market partnership.Own point-of-care solution assessment and implementation, including identification of operational pain points, vendor coordination, rollout planning, training, adoption, and performance monitoring.Maintain current knowledge of NCQA, HEDIS, CMS, Stars, and applicable health plan requirements; ensure workflows, documentation, submissions, and controls remain compliant.Build effective cross-functional relationships and drive decisions with stakeholders across clinical operations, pharmacy, coding, analytics, technology, finance, compliance, markets, and external vendors.

Job Requirements

Required Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in nursing, healthcare administration, public health, health sciences, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

Experience: Seven or more years of progressive experience in healthcare quality, managed care, provider operations, population health, HEDIS, or Medicare Advantage Stars, including 3–5 years of people-management experience. Demonstrated experience setting expectations, coaching team members, managing performance, delivering measurable operational results, and mapping, redesigning, implementing, and sustaining complex workflows across multiple teams, markets, or contracts.

Skills: Strong working knowledge of NCQA HEDIS specifications, Medicare Advantage Stars, care-gap closure, medical record review, supplemental data, and quality operations. Proven ability to move between strategy and execution, manage multiple priorities, remove barriers, and deliver results in a fast-paced, matrixed organization. Strong people leadership, change-management, project-management, process-improvement, problem-solving, and written and verbal communication skills. Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and presentation tools; experience with workflow platforms, reporting tools, automation, or AI-enabled healthcare solutions preferred. High attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to maintain confidentiality.

Physical and Mental Requirements

  • Ability to stand or sit for extended periods.

  • Visual acuity and fine motor.

  • Ability to travel locally or nationally as needed.

Work Environment

This role operates in a corporate, primarily remote environment and requires frequent collaboration across functions, markets, and external partners. Occasional travel and schedule flexibility may be required to support market operations, implementations, audits, and business priorities. No routine on-call responsibilities are expected.

Sponsorship Statement

WellBe does not offer employment-based visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Pay Transparency Statement

Compensation for this position will be disclosed in accordance with applicable state and local pay transparency laws.

Safety-Sensitive Statement

This position has been designated as safety-sensitive. As such, the employee must be able to perform job duties in a manner that ensures the safety of themselves, coworkers, patients, and the public. The role requires full cognitive and physical functioning at all times.

Employees in safety-sensitive positions are subject to drug and alcohol testing, including for substances that may impair judgment or motor function, in accordance with applicable federal and state laws and company policy. Due to the safety-sensitive nature of this role and in alignment with federal law and workplace safety standards, the use of marijuana—including medical or recreational use—is prohibited. WellBe Senior Medical will comply with applicable state laws regarding medical marijuana and reasonable accommodations, where such laws do not conflict with safety requirements or federal regulations.

Drug Screening Requirement

As a condition of employment, WellBe Senior Medical requires all candidates to successfully complete a pre-employment drug screening. Ongoing employment may also be contingent upon compliance with the company’s Drug-Free Workplace Policy, which includes random, post-accident, and reasonable suspicion drug testing. The company reserves the right to test for substances that may impair an employee’s ability to safely and effectively perform their job duties.

Background Check Statement

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, as permitted by law. As a healthcare organization, WellBe conducts monthly FACIS (Fraud and Abuse Control Information System) checks on all employees. Continued employment is contingent upon satisfactory results of these checks, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

WellBe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Americans with Disabilities Act

WellBe Senior Medical is committed to complying with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. If you require an accommodation during the application, interview or employment process, please contact Human Resources at

At-Will Employment Statement

Employment with WellBe is at-will unless otherwise specified by contract. This job description does not constitute an employment contract.

Disclaimer

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties as necessary.

raw.description:
CIVCO Medical Solutions is seeking an Upstream Product Manager to drive strategic innovation and product development for our ultrasound-based specialty device portfolio. Exciting innovation is expected in our existing markets (urology, women’s health, radiology, point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS), and probe disinfection procedures) as well as new and growing ultrasound-guided procedure markets.

The Upstream Product Manager will play a pivotal role in expanding and modernizing our product portfolio by building and managing a strong ideation and innovation pipeline. This individual will focus on translating unmet clinical needs into commercially successful new products. The ideal candidate will bring deep market and clinical insights and have a passion for identifying opportunities that shape the future of ultrasound-guided procedures and deliver meaningful clinical and business impact.

Your Responsibilities

Strategic Product Leadership

  • Construct an upstream product development roadmap aligned with CIVCO’s innovation and growth objectives.
  • Build and maintain an innovation pipeline from product concept to project activation, ensuring a continuous flow of high-potential opportunities.
  • Lead opportunity assessments, voice-of-customer research, and early feasibility studies for new product concepts.

Market Insight & Trend Analysis

  • Conduct ongoing market, technology, and competitive landscape analyses within ultrasound-guided procedure markets, including urology, women’s health, radiology, POCUS, and probe disinfection.
  • Identify emerging trends in ultrasound systems, probe technologies, and procedural workflows that impact CIVCO’s strategic direction.

Customer & KOL Engagement

  • Establish and nurture relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs) and strategic clinical partners to guide ideation and validate new concepts.
  • Facilitate advisory boards, customer interviews, and clinical observation sessions to uncover unmet procedural needs and workflow improvements.
  • Represent CIVCO Medical Solutions at trade shows, conferences, and symposia for ongoing personal education and to maintain deep awareness of the ultrasound device market trends.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with CIVCO’s product strategy organization, business development, and R&D to translate market opportunities into clear business cases and product requirements.
  • Support portfolio prioritization decisions through robust financial modeling, customer insight, and market potential analysis.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

What Skills You Need

  • Minimum 7 years’ Experience in Medical Device or Ultrasound-Based Product Management, Upstream Product Marketing, or Product Development. Deeply familiar with product management strategy and new product development. Has a keen sense for product desirability that addresses unmet needs. Demonstrated ability to drive innovative pipelines and launch high-revenue products.
  • Strategic Acumen and Market Validation. Proven success in building business cases and assessing new product opportunities with evidence-based justification (market data, industry trends, competitive intelligence, voice of customer, etc.).
  • Customer Intimacy and Clinical Acumen. Knows how to “think like a customer”, hear customer feedback objectively, and make recommendations in the best interest of CIVCO’s customers. Understands clinical workflows of image-guided procedures intimately. Comfortable with clinical data and leading KOL discussions.
  • Bold and courageous thinker, but clear and impactful communicator. Has an innate tendency to think “How could this be done?” instead of “This cannot be done”. Sees the possibility in every unique and wild idea. Enjoys evangelizing a vision and can articulate that vision with clarity and conviction to other stakeholders. Exceptionally good at simplifying the complex.
  • Comfortable working in ambiguity and with minimal guidance. Capable of turning large initiatives into small, daily tasks with clear goals, and holding oneself accountable. Has a strong ability to be a self-starter with clear initiative and ownership.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Prior clinical or industry-based ultrasound experience.
  • Prior experience with single-use procedural medical devices and consumable products.
  • Working knowledge of hospital environments including organizational structures and administration.
  • Global / international business experience.
  • Highly proficient in Microsoft Office with demonstrated willingness to learn and incorporate AI-tools into daily work.

Additional Requirements

  • Willing, able, and committed to travel up to 30%. Consistent time spent with customers is essential.
  • Ability to meet vendor credentialing requirements for all healthcare systems (including COVID-19 vaccine, where required).

What You’ll Get

  • At CIVCO, you are empowered to create a career that will take you where you want to go. Here, you’ll enjoy the freedom to explore new projects, support to think outside the box, and autonomy to lead from any position within the company.
  • CIVCO is driven by a mission to "Make Ultrasound-Guided Procedures Safer” through innovative ultrasound solutions. This role provides a unique opportunity to shape the future of ultrasound-guided procedures, collaborate with global leaders, and make a tangible impact on healthcare innovation.
  • An Equal Opportunity Employer, CIVCO requires a diversity of people, perspectives, and ideas to address the complex challenges of our global business. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other things, race, religion, color, national origin, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a protected veteran or status as a qualified individual with disability.

  • CIVCO offers a complete benefits package including company-sponsored health plans and 401k plans with company matching starting day one, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, lifestyle and tuition reimbursements, paid leave, generous vacation plans (minimum of 17 days annually), and the advantages of an environment that encourages your development, recognizes your achievements, and supports a work-life balance.

  • The anticipated compensation for this role includes an annualized base salary range of $110,000 - $165,000 plus a 20% variable incentive compensation target. The provided base salary range is used nationally. The rate offered is compliant with federal/local regulations and may vary by experience, certification/education, market conditions, location, etc. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including demonstrable level of experience and training, pertinent education including licensure and certifications, and other relevant business or organizational needs.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit and talk or hear. The employee is also required to stand and walk. The employee is required to travel by automobile and other means. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Bilingual Field Operations Coordinator (English/Spanish) to support the field operations department of a construction and landscaping company.

This fully remote position serves as the primary communication link between the office and field crews working across multiple job sites throughout the United States. The coordinator will oversee daily administrative activities, crew communications, production reporting, timekeeping, travel arrangements, and operational documentation.

The ideal candidate is comfortable communicating with field personnel in both English and Spanish, managing multiple priorities, navigating different software platforms, and ensuring that operational information is accurate, organized, and delivered on time.

This role requires someone who takes ownership of follow-ups, anticipates operational needs, and can work independently in a fast-paced, field-driven environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Field Crew Communication & Coordination

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day communication link between the office and field crews through phone calls, text messages, and email in both English and Spanish.

  • Communicate job details, bid information, project updates, and operational instructions to field personnel.

  • Assist crews with completing required paperwork and submitting operational documentation.

  • Respond to crew inquiries and coordinate with the appropriate office personnel to resolve issues.

  • Proactively follow up on pending requests, missing information, and outstanding deliverables.

2. Daily Production Reporting & Documentation

  • Collect and monitor daily production reports submitted by field crews.

  • Follow up on missing or incomplete reports and ensure timely submission.

  • Review reports for accuracy and completeness before forwarding them to the appropriate department.

  • Maintain accurate and organized project documentation and operational records.

3. Payroll & Timekeeping Administration

  • Verify employee hours against assigned projects, job codes, and available records.

  • Assist with payroll preparation, timekeeping reviews, and approval workflows through designated payroll platforms.

  • Identify and flag discrepancies, missing entries, or inconsistencies for resolution.

  • Maintain accurate timekeeping records and support payroll-related administrative processes.

4. Travel & Accommodation Coordination

  • Arrange transportation and hotel accommodations for field crews as they move between project locations.

  • Coordinate travel plans according to project schedules, crew assignments, and operational requirements.

  • Handle itinerary changes, booking adjustments, and last-minute travel issues.

  • Maintain updated records of crew locations, accommodations, and travel arrangements.

  • Ensure field personnel receive all necessary travel and lodging information before transitioning to their next assignment.

5. Administrative & Financial Support

  • Assist with monitoring and organizing company credit card transactions and field-related expenses.

  • Support expense tracking, transaction reviews, and reconciliation processes.

  • Organize invoices, receipts, and supporting financial documentation.

  • Provide administrative assistance with invoice reviews, approval workflows, and accounting-related tasks as needed.

  • Maintain accurate financial and administrative records while ensuring deadlines are met.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish, including professional verbal and written communication skills in both languages. (C1 or High)

  • Previous experience in administrative support, operations coordination, dispatch, travel coordination, or a similar role.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple crews, projects, deadlines, and requests simultaneously.

  • Comfortable communicating directly with field personnel over the phone.

  • Strong computer skills and the ability to navigate multiple software platforms efficiently.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.

  • Excellent attention to detail, follow-up, and information management.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle changing priorities.

  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment with minimal supervision.

  • Professional communication skills and the ability to build rapport with different teams.

  • Reliable, high-speed internet connection and a dedicated professional workspace.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience supporting construction, landscaping, golf installation, or field-service operations.

  • Experience coordinating travel, hotels, and accommodations for distributed teams.

  • Familiarity with payroll systems, timekeeping platforms, and expense management software.

  • Experience managing project documentation and shared folders through Microsoft Teams.

  • Previous experience handling invoices, expense reconciliation, or basic accounting administration.

  • Paycom: Payroll administration, time verification, and approval workflows.

  • RAMP: Company credit card transactions and expense management.

  • SitePhotos: Field reporting, project photos, and operational documentation.

  • AccuBuild: Potential future accounting and invoice-related support.

Success Expectations

  • Maintain consistent, timely, and professional communication with field crews in both English and Spanish.

  • Ensure daily production reports are collected, reviewed, and properly documented.

  • Maintain accurate crew timekeeping records and ensure payroll information is submitted within established deadlines.

Contractor Perks

raw.excerpt: A Pagaleve é uma empresa do setor de “Buy Now Pay Later”.
raw.description:
A Pagaleve é uma empresa do setor de “Buy Now Pay Later”. Somos uma das primeiras empresas a oferecer pagamento parcelado no PIX, sem juros, e sem a necessidade de usar cartão de crédito. Temos como objetivo oferecer aos lojistas um novo método de pagamento, para aumentar suas vendas de um jeito simples, descomplicado e ágil, mas também temos como objetivo oferecer às pessoas a oportunidade de comprar aquilo que desejam, sem se comprometerem com os altos juros do cartão de crédito.

A Pagaleve foi fundada em 2021 e já conta com uma trajetória acelerada de crescimento, e conta, entre os investidores, fundos como Our Innovation Fund, da Austrália, Founder Collective, dos Estados Unidos, e Entrée Capital.

O time de Cyber Security tem Red Team e Blue Team, reporta ao Head de Cyber Security e já tem um programa maduro. Agora queremos alguém sênior para puxar os temas técnicos mais avançados de defesa.

A missão

Você vai trabalhar com o time de engenharia para resolver a segurança cloud e ser a referência técnica em resposta a incidentes. Mais do que operar ferramentas, você vai construir: detecções, automações e produtos internos que reduzem tempo de resposta e risco de forma mensurável.

Usamos IA como ferramenta de trabalho do dia a dia. Esperamos que você codifique com ela e entregue em semanas o que antes levava trimestres.

O que você vai fazer

Resposta a incidentes

  • Liderar a resposta técnica a incidentes, da triagem à contenção, erradicação e post-mortem.
  • Conduzir investigação e forense em ambientes AWS, endpoints e identidade (CloudTrail, GuardDuty, VPC Flow Logs, logs de IdP).
  • Escrever e manter playbooks e runbooks, e transformar os repetitivos em automação.
  • Apoiar a comunicação de incidentes exigida pela regulação do Banco Central.

Segurança cloud

  • Fortalecer a postura de segurança da AWS: IAM e menor privilégio, acesso just-in-time, WAF, segmentação de rede e gestão de segredos.
  • Revisar e escrever IaC seguro (Terraform ou equivalente) junto com SRE e engenharia.
  • Criar e afinar detecções para ameaças em cloud, medindo falso positivo e cobertura.

Construir com IA

  • Desenvolver ferramentas e agentes internos que automatizem triagem, enriquecimento de alertas e resposta.
  • Tratar cada ferramenta como produto: problema claro, usuário definido, métrica de sucesso e iteração.
  • Compartilhar o que construir para elevar o nível técnico do time.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência prévia comprovada conduzindo resposta a incidentes reais, não só em laboratório. Você vai ser perguntado sobre casos concretos.
  • Experiência prévia comprovada em segurança AWS em produção: IAM, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, VPC, KMS.
  • Programação no dia a dia, em Python, Go ou TypeScript, com código seu em produção.
  • Uso fluente de IA para desenvolver (assistentes de código, agentes, LLMs via API).
  • Histórico de ter criado algo — ferramenta, automação ou produto — e de ter medido o resultado que ele trouxe.
  • Autonomia para levar um problema do diagnóstico até a entrega sem precisar de alguém puxando.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em fintech, instituição de pagamento ou ambiente regulado pelo Banco Central.
  • Detection engineering: regras como código (Sigma, KQL, SPL ou similar) e pipelines de logs.
  • Infraestrutura como código e Kubernetes.
  • Forense de endpoint e memória; familiaridade com EDR.
  • Identidade e SSO: SAML, OIDC, acesso condicional.
  • Certificações como AWS Security Specialty, GCIH ou GCFA.
  • Projetos open source, artigos ou palestras em segurança.

Informações adicionais

  • Modelo de contratação PJ;
  • Remuneração competitiva;
  • Pensando no seu bem-estar e no de sua família, oferecemos plano de saúde com cobertura 100% do titular e 75% para o primeiro dependente;
  • Day off no mês do aniversário
  • Cupom de desconto mensal nas lojas que aceitam o Pix Parcelado
  • Modelo REMOTO de trabalho.
