raw.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Job Summary

As a Regional Sales Manager, you are a significant driver of company revenue and growth. In this role, you will lead and drive complex sales engagements, motivated by the desire to solve critical security challenges for our customers. You will be responsible for meeting and exceeding quota by crafting and implementing strategic territory plans, actively displacing competing technologies, and connecting clients with the Palo Alto Networks Next Generation Security Platform.


Key Responsibilities

  • Drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles, proactively collaborating with internal partners and teams to ensure customer success.
  • Develop and implement strategic account plans focused on attaining enterprise-wide deployments and expanding our footprint.
  • Utilize consultative selling skills to initiate and nurture long-standing relationships with prospective customers and executive sponsors.
  • Engage a programmatic and data-driven approach to demand generation to develop, grow, and expand your territory.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of the strategic competitive landscape and customer needs to effectively position Palo Alto Networks.
  • Leverage customer success stories to create compelling value propositions with insights tailored to each specific account.
  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services.
  • Travel as necessary within your territory to foster relationships and to company-wide meetings to ensure alignment.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Proven experience selling complex SaaS-based technology solutions, consistently meeting or exceeding sales quotas.

Demonstrated ability to lead all aspects of a complex sales cycle, including uncovering, qualifying, developing, and closing new accounts.

Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security context.

Deep knowledge and sales experience within the specified territory (e.g., U.S. DOD, intelligence community, or Civilian Agencies).

Excellent time management skills, with the ability to work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction.


Preferred Qualifications

Experience cultivating mutually beneficial relationships with channel partners to execute a channel-centric go-to-market strategy.

A highly competitive, adaptive, and resilient mindset with a track record of ramping up quickly in new roles.

Do you have a passion for network engineering technologies?

Are you looking for the freedom to innovate and help shape the next generation of the network?

Join our Network Engineering team

The Network Engineering team designs, automates, and supports the global network powering Akamai's products and services. Using advanced technologies, the team ensures optimal connectivity and performance for customers and the compute platform.

Partner with the best

As a Senior Network Engineer, you will lead efforts in designing, implementing, and automating Akamai's global network infrastructure. You will address complex issues in routing, data center fabrics, DDoS defense, and automation to ensure scalability, reliability, and security. This role involves driving the evolution of network infrastructure, from initial architecture through to implementation.

As a Senior Network Engineer, you will be responsible for:

  • Designing, building, and maintaining our global network infrastructure
  • Designing and implementing automated detection and mitigation strategies for inbound and outbound DDoS attacks
  • Developing and maintaining Akamai's core network configuration templates using Jinja2
  • Implementing new hardware platforms and network features within the automation framework
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to define data models and functional requirements.
  • Serving as a subject matter expert for complex network issues, performing deep-dive troubleshooting and analysis
  • Creating and maintaining clear documentation & procedures

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have 8 years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's in computer science or equivalent experience.
  • Demonstrate extensive experience in IP network design and implementation of scalable BGP routing architecture
  • Understand Data Center architecture, including CLOS Fabric and overlay technologies such as VxLAN and EVPN
  • Have experience in managing and troubleshooting multi-vendor environments like Juniper, Cisco & routing platforms like BIRD, FRR and Cumulus
  • Possess solid experience with DDoS detection and mitigation platforms to safeguard inbound and outbound traffic
  • Have the ability to understand end-to-end data flows and traffic patterns
  • Have experience developing and managing network configuration templates utilizing automation tools like Python, Ansible, and Jinja2 effectively and efficiently

About us

At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.

Our focus is simple:

Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
Security: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
Content Delivery: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
AI: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.

Benefits at Akamai: We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.

FlexBase adapts to your job's needs

Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.

Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!

Compensation

Akamai is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For US based candidates only - the base salary for this position ranges from $112,500 - $202,500/year; a candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and location. Compensation for candidates outside the US will vary. The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of annual bonus or incentives, equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). Akamai provides industry-leading benefits including healthcare, 401K savings plan, company holidays, vacation (in the form of PTO), sick time, family friendly benefits including parental leave and an employee assistance program including a focus on mental and financial wellness; Eligibility requirements apply.

Principal Product Manager, Quote-to-Cash

Business Systems | Remote (US)


What you would be taking on

You would own our quote-to-cash process, from quote through contract, order, billing and revenue reporting. Salesforce CPQ is the main application today, and Revenue Cloud (now called Agentforce Revenue Management) is where Salesforce is heading. You would be the main contact for Sales, Deal Desk, Finance and Revenue Operations on how we quote and get paid, and you would run the programs and projects that keep a high-volume sales team moving. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Quote-to-cash is your focus, but you may also lead one-off projects in other parts of Business Systems.


What you will do

  • Own the roadmap and backlog for quote-to-cash in Salesforce CPQ and Revenue Cloud.
  • Own the business stakeholder relationships and the quote-to-cash process, and decide what gets prioritized.
  • Manage products, pricing, discounts and approvals for new deals, upsells, amendments and renewals.
  • Plan and run projects from start to finish: requirements, timelines, testing and go-live.
  • Make sure ACV, TCV, ARR and bookings are calculated the same way from quote to billing.
  • Work with the Salesforce, Zuora (billing) and Boomi (integration) teams on releases.
  • Lead other Business Systems projects when needed.

What we need

All of these are required:

  • 10 or more years in product management or business systems program management, including 5 or more years working on quote-to-cash or revenue systems.
  • Bachelor's Degree, in a technical or business discipline, or equivalent work experience (Required)
  • Master's Degree / MBA, in Business Administration or related field (Preferred)
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ, such as product and price rules, bundles, approvals, amendments and renewals.
  • Experience supporting a high-volume B2B sales team, ideally in SaaS or subscription sales.
  • A strong working knowledge of ACV, TCV, ARR, bookings, proration and renewals.
  • Experience managing senior Sales and Finance stakeholders, including pushing back when needed.
  • Experience running projects in Agile using Jira and Confluence.

What helps

The first two help most:

  • Experience with Salesforce Revenue Cloud, or moving from CPQ to Revenue Cloud.
  • Experience with billing systems such as Zuora, and integration tools such as Boomi.
  • Salesforce certifications, such as CPQ Specialist or Revenue Cloud Consultant.
  • Experience in healthcare technology.

Compensation Range:

$130,241-$189,502

Compensation for this job is subject to market conditions, geographic considerations, the candidate’s unique skills and experience, state and local laws, and budget. Our commitment to pay transparency is a testament to our dedication to creating a fair, equitable, and inclusive workplace. By continuously analyzing market trends, staying abreast of changes in state laws, and making budgetary adjustments accordingly, we strive to ensure that our compensation practices reflect the value we place on our associates’ unique contributions and support their professional growth.
